academia-politie|Facultatea de Poliție.name: Faculty of Police
academia-politie|Facultatea de Poliție.about: Here you become an officer for the police, the border police or the gendarmerie. There are two programmes: Law, which lasts four years, and Public Order and Safety, which lasts three years. Besides police training, you study a lot of law (criminal, civil, constitutional, administrative). When you graduate you receive an officer's diploma as well and are assigned to a unit.
academia-politie|Facultatea de Poliție.admission: You apply through the recruitment unit, not at the academy, and you go through a psychological evaluation. The competition has three stages: a physical performance test, a multiple-choice test in history, Romanian and a foreign language (English, French or German), and a medical examination. The admission grade is made up of the grade from the physical test and the grade from the multiple-choice test, which counts for more.

academia-politie|Facultatea de Pompieri.name: Faculty of Firefighters
academia-politie|Facultatea de Pompieri.about: The faculty trains firefighter officers for the emergency situations units (IGSU). The programme Building Installations - Firefighters lasts four years: you graduate as an installations engineer and, at the same time, as an officer. You learn engineering and fire safety, in addition to military and physical training.
academia-politie|Facultatea de Pompieri.admission: You apply through the recruitment unit, not at the academy, and you go through a psychological evaluation. The competition has three stages: a physical performance test, a multiple-choice test in mathematics (algebra and elements of mathematical analysis) and physics, and then the medical examination. The admission grade is made up of the grade from the physical test and the grade from the multiple-choice test, which counts for more.

adventus|Facultatea de Teologie și Știin.name: Faculty of Theology and Social Sciences
adventus|Facultatea de Teologie și Știin.about: It is the university's only faculty and has four full-time bachelor's programmes: Pastoral Adventist Theology, which lasts four years, and Social Work, Primary School Pedagogy and Early Education, which last three years each. You can train to be a pastor, a social worker, a primary school teacher or an early-years educator. The Early Education programme is newer and operates with provisional authorisation.
adventus|Facultatea de Teologie și Știin.admission: For all programmes there is first an eliminatory interview, graded admitted or rejected. For Theology, written tests in English, biblical knowledge and Romanian follow, and you must be a baptised member of the Adventist Church. For the other programmes, after the interview only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts; for the two pedagogy programmes you also write a motivation essay on the day of the interview.

afa-brasov|Facultatea de Management Aero.name: Faculty of Aeronautical Management
afa-brasov|Facultatea de Management Aero.about: This is where the army's future aviation officers are trained. Admission is to two four-year programmes: Aeronautical Management, for pilots, and Airspace Management, for non-flying aviation (this includes air traffic controllers) and military intelligence. The official list also still shows the older three-year programmes: Aviation Management and Air Traffic Management.
afa-brasov|Facultatea de Management Aero.admission: First you go through recruitment and selection: psychological evaluation, physical tests, an interview and a medical examination, all eliminatory. Then you take a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics; places are filled in the order of the test average. Some specialisations also have additional medical examinations or special aptitude tests.

afa-brasov|Facultatea de Sisteme de Secu.name: Faculty of Air Security Systems
afa-brasov|Facultatea de Sisteme de Secu.about: The faculty trains officers for anti-aircraft defence and airspace surveillance. It has two four-year programmes: Management of Anti-Aircraft Missile and Artillery Systems and Management of Air Surveillance Systems, with specialisations in radiolocation and electronic warfare.
afa-brasov|Facultatea de Sisteme de Secu.admission: First you go through recruitment and selection: psychological evaluation, physical tests, an interview and a medical examination, all eliminatory. Then you take a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics; places are filled in the order of the test average.

aft-sibiu|Facultatea de Management Milit.name: Faculty of Military Management
aft-sibiu|Facultatea de Management Milit.about: It trains officers for the technical arms of the Land Forces: artillery and missiles, engineers, tanks and motor vehicles, CBRN defence, communications and information technology. The programmes combine management with military equipment engineering.
aft-sibiu|Facultatea de Management Milit.admission: First you go through recruitment and selection: psychological evaluation, physical tests, an interview and a medical examination. Then you take a written test, a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics, and places are filled in the order of the average at this test.

aft-sibiu|Facultatea de Științe Economic.name: Faculty of Economic and Administrative Sciences
aft-sibiu|Facultatea de Științe Economic.about: It trains officers for quartermaster services, financial-accounting management and military police. The bachelor's programmes are accounting and management information systems, economic-financial management, public administration and management of special protection and guard systems.
aft-sibiu|Facultatea de Științe Economic.admission: First you go through recruitment and selection: psychological evaluation, physical tests, an interview and a medical examination. Then you take a written test, a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics, and places are filled in the order of the average at this test.

aft-sibiu|Facultatea de Științe Militare.name: Faculty of Military Sciences
aft-sibiu|Facultatea de Științe Militare.about: It trains officers for the combat arms of the Land Forces: infantry, mountain troops, reconnaissance and paratroopers. It has a single bachelor's programme, Military Leadership.
aft-sibiu|Facultatea de Științe Militare.admission: First you go through recruitment and selection: psychological evaluation, physical tests, an interview and a medical examination. Then you take a written test, a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics, and places are filled in the order of the average at this test.

agora-oradea|Facultatea de Științe Econo.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
agora-oradea|Facultatea de Științe Econo.about: Here you study Management or Accounting and Management Information Systems, three years each. In Management you start with economics, mathematics, accounting and statistics, then move on to marketing, project management, quality management and human resources management. In the second year you also do a work placement.
agora-oradea|Facultatea de Științe Econo.admission: There is no exam: admission to fee-paying places is based on your application file, according to your Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You can also apply online. The university also offers tuition-free places, through the Agora scholarships.

agora-oradea|Facultatea de Științe Jurid.name: Faculty of Legal and Administrative Sciences
agora-oradea|Facultatea de Științe Jurid.about: Here you study Law (four years), Public Administration or Local Police (three years each). In Law you learn civil, criminal, constitutional and European law, with practical placements in the final year. In Local Police you study law, public order, police investigation and the regime of minor offences.
agora-oradea|Facultatea de Științe Jurid.admission: There is no exam: admission to fee-paying places is based on your application file, according to your Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You can also apply online. The university also offers tuition-free places, through the Agora scholarships.

amgd-cluj|Facultatea de Interpretare Muz.name: Faculty of Music Performance
amgd-cluj|Facultatea de Interpretare Muz.about: Here you train to perform on stage: on an instrument (strings, wind, percussion, piano, organ and others) or with your voice, in singing. Musical theatre directing and choreography are also studied here. Instruments and singing can also be studied in English.
amgd-cluj|Facultatea de Interpretare Muz.admission: You enter through a competition with practical tests, all eliminatory. For instruments you take instrumental technique and solfeggio, then a performance test; for singing, vocal aptitude and solfeggio, then performance. For musical theatre directing and choreography the tests are different. The final average is the average of the tests; the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts only as a tie-breaker.

amgd-cluj|Facultatea Teoretică.name: Theoretical Faculty
amgd-cluj|Facultatea Teoretică.about: Here you study music from its creative and intellectual side: composition, conducting (orchestra or choir), musicology and the Music programme, which also prepares you to teach. The Music programme is also available in English. The faculty has two departments: composition and conducting, and musicology.
amgd-cluj|Facultatea Teoretică.admission: You take a competition with music tests: solfeggio and vocal ability, then a written test in music theory and musical dictation; the average is made up of these two tests. For Music Composition, Musicology and Conducting there is one more specific aptitude test, graded admitted or rejected (for example, in composition you present a portfolio of your own works). The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts only as a tie-breaker.

andrei-saguna|Facultatea de Psihologie ș.name: Faculty of Psychology and Behavioural Sciences
andrei-saguna|Facultatea de Psihologie ș.about: Here you study Psychology, three years: how the mind works, how people develop from childhood to old age, personality, social psychology, psychological testing and the basics of psychotherapy. The programme has the approval of the College of Psychologists of Romania. On the university's website the faculty now appears under the name "Psychology, Behavioural and Legal Sciences".
andrei-saguna|Facultatea de Psihologie ș.admission: The admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, with no additional exams. For some programmes you also have a motivation talk of a few minutes with a professor, which is not an eliminatory test. You can apply online.

andrei-saguna|Facultatea de Științe Juri.name: Faculty of Legal, Economic and Administrative Sciences
andrei-saguna|Facultatea de Științe Juri.about: Here are the programmes in Law (four years), Public Administration, Management and Accounting and Management Information Systems (three years each). In Law you learn civil, criminal and constitutional law and work on cases in a legal clinic; in the others you learn economics, accounting, management and how public institutions work. On the university's website, Law now appears under the faculty of psychology, and the others under "Economic and Administrative Sciences".
andrei-saguna|Facultatea de Științe Juri.admission: The admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, with no additional exams. For some programmes you also have a motivation talk of a few minutes with a professor, which is not an eliminatory test. You can apply online.

ani-bucuresti|Facultatea de Informații.name: Faculty of Intelligence
ani-bucuresti|Facultatea de Informații.about: The faculty has the programme Intelligence Operations, which trains operational intelligence officers: those who gather information and build operations. Studies last three years, full-time only and on state-funded places, and include military training.
ani-bucuresti|Facultatea de Informații.admission: First you go through a selection carried out by the institution you are applying to: interviews, tests, psychological and medical examination, security checks. Then you take the academy's competition: a general knowledge test and an aptitude test, which counts the most. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of your high-school years also count a little towards the average.

ani-bucuresti|Facultatea de Studii de In.name: Faculty of Intelligence Studies
ani-bucuresti|Facultatea de Studii de In.about: The faculty has the programme Security and Intelligence Studies, which trains analyst intelligence officers: those who interpret information and make forecasts for national security. Studies last three years, full-time only and on state-funded places.
ani-bucuresti|Facultatea de Studii de In.admission: First you go through a selection carried out by the institution you are applying to: interviews, tests, psychological and medical examination, security checks. Then you take the academy's competition: a general knowledge test and an aptitude test, which counts the most. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of your high-school years also count a little towards the average.

anmb|Facultatea de Inginerie Marină.name: Faculty of Marine Engineering
anmb|Facultatea de Inginerie Marină.about: The faculty trains engineer officers for the navy and engineers for civilian ships. The military section has the programmes Navigation, Hydrography and Naval Equipment, Naval Electromechanics and Electromechanics; the last two can also be followed in the civilian section. All last four years.
anmb|Facultatea de Inginerie Marină.admission: For the military section you first go through recruitment and selection, with a medical visit, then take a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics; an English certificate is also required. The civilian section is an application-file competition: mostly the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, and a little your mathematics grade from the bac.

anmb|Facultatea de Navigație și Manageme.name: Faculty of Navigation and Naval Management
anmb|Facultatea de Navigație și Manageme.about: Here deck officers for the merchant navy and engineers for ships and ports are trained. The four-year bachelor's programmes are Navigation and Maritime and River Transport and Naval and Port Engineering and Management. The latter also has a military variant, with the specialisation in naval logistics.
anmb|Facultatea de Navigație și Manageme.admission: The civilian section is an application-file competition: mostly the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, and a little your mathematics grade from the bac. For the military variant (naval logistics) you go through recruitment and selection, with a medical visit, and take a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics.

apollonia|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
apollonia|Facultatea de Medicină.about: The faculty trains future dentists, dental technicians, nurses, dental prophylaxis assistants and specialists in balneology, physiotherapy and rehabilitation. There are five bachelor's programmes, and the faculty says it combines theory and practice in a balanced way.
apollonia|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: You take a knowledge test in the form of a multiple-choice test and an interview, in biology (human anatomy and physiology), which counts the most towards the admission average. The rest comes from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. The syllabus is published for each programme.

apollonia|Facultatea de Științe ale comu.name: Faculty of Communication Sciences
apollonia|Facultatea de Științe ale comu.about: Here you study Journalism or Communication and Public Relations and prepare for jobs in the press, public relations and communication. Practical work takes place right at the university, at Apollonia TV, Radio Apollonia, the student magazine and the news agency, as well as in partner institutions.
apollonia|Facultatea de Științe ale comu.admission: There is no exam: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal, the tie is broken by the grade from the written Romanian language and literature exam of the bac and then by the average of the high-school years.

arte-iasi|Facultatea de Arte Vizuale și.name: Faculty of Visual Arts and Design
arte-iasi|Facultatea de Arte Vizuale și.about: Here you study painting, sculpture, graphic art, photo-video, mural art, design, fashion, textile arts, art pedagogy, conservation and restoration, or art history and theory. The faculty has its origins in 1860.
arte-iasi|Facultatea de Arte Vizuale și.admission: For most specialisations you take two tests, and the first is eliminatory. They are usually practical tests (drawing, composition, modelling or a project sketch); for some, the second test is an interview based on your portfolio. For Art History and Theory a letter of intent and an interview count. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average also counts, with a small weight, in the final average.

arte-iasi|Facultatea de Interpretare, Co.name: Faculty of Performance, Composition and Theoretical Music Studies
arte-iasi|Facultatea de Interpretare, Co.about: It is the university's music faculty: here you study an instrument or singing, composition (classical or jazz and light music), choir or orchestra conducting, musicology, music pedagogy or religious music. In parallel you can follow the pedagogical module, so that you can teach music.
arte-iasi|Facultatea de Interpretare, Co.admission: You take musical aptitude tests, and the first is eliminatory. For instruments and singing you perform a recital or chosen pieces; for the other programmes your musical ear is checked and you do sight-singing solfeggio, usually also melodic dictation and a music theory test. For these programmes (not for instruments and singing) the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average also counts a little.

arte-iasi|Facultatea de Teatru.name: Faculty of Theatre
arte-iasi|Facultatea de Teatru.about: Here you train for the stage: acting, puppetry and marionettes, directing or choreography. There is also the programme Theatre Studies (Cultural Management), for those who want to work around the performance, not necessarily on stage.
arte-iasi|Facultatea de Teatru.admission: Admission has two stages, the first eliminatory. For Acting and Puppets-Marionettes you recite verse, a story and a monologue and have an interview about theatre; for Directing and Choreography you have practical specialist tests. For Theatre Studies you take an eliminatory interview, then the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts.

artifex|Facultatea de Finanțe și Contabi.name: Faculty of Finance and Accounting
artifex|Facultatea de Finanțe și Contabi.about: The faculty trains economists for banks, finance and accounting. It has two bachelor's programmes, three years each: Finance and Banking and Accounting and Management Information Systems, plus two master's programmes in the same fields.
artifex|Facultatea de Finanțe și Contabi.admission: There is no exam: you enter based on your application file. The admission average is the average of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years.

artifex|Facultatea de Management- Market.name: Faculty of Management-Marketing
artifex|Facultatea de Management- Market.about: The faculty trains specialists in running companies, marketing and business. It has three bachelor's programmes: Management, Marketing and Economics of Trade, Tourism and Services, plus master's programmes in the same fields.
artifex|Facultatea de Management- Market.admission: There is no exam: you enter based on your application file. The admission average is the average of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Administrare.name: Faculty of Business Administration in Foreign Languages
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Administrare.about: You learn how a business is run and developed, with all courses in a foreign language. The Business Administration programme can be followed in English, French or German.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Administrare.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years count (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay written in the language of instruction, graded admitted/rejected. You also take an online language test (admitted/rejected) if you do not have a recognised certificate.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Administrați.name: Faculty of Public Administration and Management
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Administrați.about: It prepares you for work in state institutions and town halls, and also for working with people in an organisation. It has two bachelor's programmes: Public Administration and Human Resources.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Administrați.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay graded admitted/rejected.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Business și.name: Faculty of Business and Tourism
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Business și.about: It prepares you for business in trade, tourism and services and for working with product quality. The bachelor's programme, Business Administration in Trade, Tourism, Services, Commodity Science and Quality Management, is taught in Romanian or in English.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Business și.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay graded admitted/rejected. For programmes in foreign languages you also take an online language test (admitted/rejected) if you do not have a recognised certificate.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Cibernetică,.name: Faculty of Cybernetics, Statistics and Economic Informatics
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Cibernetică,.about: The faculty that combines economics with IT and working with data. The bachelor's programmes are Economic Informatics (also in English), Economic Cybernetics, Economic Statistics and Data Science and Artificial Intelligence Applied in Economics and Business.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Cibernetică,.admission: You take a multiple-choice test in mathematics, which counts for half of the admission average; the other half comes from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years. A motivational essay (admitted/rejected) is also required, and for the programme in English a language test.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Contabilitat.name: Faculty of Accounting and Management Information Systems
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Contabilitat.about: You learn to keep a company's financial records, to read its financial statements and to use the computer programs made for this. The Accounting and Management Information Systems programme can be followed in Romanian or in English.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Contabilitat.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay graded admitted/rejected. For programmes in foreign languages you also take an online language test (admitted/rejected) if you do not have a recognised certificate.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Drept.about: You learn the laws and how they are applied, in a law faculty that is part of an economics university. The bachelor's programme Law lasts four years.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Drept.admission: You take a multiple-choice test in Romanian and economics, and the admission average is given by the score on this test. A motivational essay, graded admitted/rejected, is also required.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Economie Agr.name: Faculty of Agri-Food and Environmental Economics
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Economie Agr.about: You study economics applied to agriculture, food and environmental protection. The bachelor's programme is called Agri-Food and Environmental Economics and emphasises an economy that takes care of resources.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Economie Agr.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay graded admitted/rejected.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Economie și.name: Faculty of Economics and Business Communication
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Economie și.about: Here you learn how the economy works and how to communicate and negotiate in the business world. The faculty has a single bachelor's programme: Economics and Economic Communication in Business.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Economie și.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay graded admitted/rejected.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Finanțe, Asi.name: Faculty of Finance, Insurance, Banking and Stock Exchanges
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Finanțe, Asi.about: You learn about money, banks, insurance, investments and the stock exchange. The bachelor's programme Finance and Banking can be followed in Romanian or in English.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Finanțe, Asi.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay graded admitted/rejected. For programmes in foreign languages you also take an online language test (admitted/rejected) if you do not have a recognised certificate.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Management.name: Faculty of Management
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Management.about: You learn how a company or a team is organised and led. The bachelor's programme Management can be followed in Romanian or in English.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Management.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay graded admitted/rejected. For programmes in foreign languages you also take an online language test (admitted/rejected) if you do not have a recognised certificate.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Marketing.name: Faculty of Marketing
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Marketing.about: You study how to find out what customers want and how to promote and sell a product or a service. The bachelor's programme Marketing can be followed in Romanian or in English.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Marketing.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay graded admitted/rejected. For programmes in foreign languages you also take an online language test (admitted/rejected) if you do not have a recognised certificate.

ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Relații Econ.name: Faculty of International Economic Relations
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Relații Econ.about: You study trade and business between countries. It has the programme Economics and International Business (in Romanian or in English) and the programme Applied Modern Languages (English and French), for those who want to work with foreign languages in business.
ase-bucuresti|Facultatea de Relații Econ.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years (the bac weighs more), plus a motivational essay graded admitted/rejected. For the programme in English and for Applied Modern Languages you also take an online language test (admitted/rejected) if you do not have a recognised certificate.

athenaeum|Facultatea de Administrație Pu.name: Faculty of Public Administration
athenaeum|Facultatea de Administrație Pu.about: The faculty has a single bachelor's programme, Public Administration, lasting three years, focused on public administration and on how institutions are run. There is also a master's on executive power and public administration and postgraduate programmes here.
athenaeum|Facultatea de Administrație Pu.admission: There is no exam: you submit your application file, and candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal, the average of the four high-school years decides.

athenaeum|Facultatea de Științe Economic.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
athenaeum|Facultatea de Științe Economic.about: The faculty has three bachelor's programmes, three years each: Accounting and Management Information Systems, Economic Informatics and Management. It also has master's programmes in accounting, audit and accounting information systems.
athenaeum|Facultatea de Științe Economic.admission: There is no exam: you submit your application file, and candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal, the average of the four high-school years decides.

atm|Facultatea de Aeronave și Autovehicu.name: Faculty of Military Aircraft and Vehicles
atm|Facultatea de Aeronave și Autovehicu.about: Here you become an engineer officer for aviation or for military vehicles. The programmes last 4 years: aircraft and aviation engines, aviation equipment and installations, armoured vehicles, cars and tractors, command and control equipment for motor vehicles. At the end you receive an engineer's diploma and an officer's commission.
atm|Facultatea de Aeronave și Autovehicu.admission: For state-funded places you first go through the recruitment and selection carried out by the institution you are applying to (for example the Ministry of National Defence), then take a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics. For fee-paying places, the ranking is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

atm|Facultatea de Comunicații și Sisteme.name: Faculty of Communications and Electronic Systems for Defence and Security
atm|Facultatea de Comunicații și Sisteme.about: Here specialists in military communications and electronics are trained: you learn how the army's communications systems and electronic equipment, including aviation equipment, are designed and used. The faculty has a tradition of more than 50 years and two research centres.
atm|Facultatea de Comunicații și Sisteme.admission: For state-funded places you first go through the recruitment and selection carried out by the institution you are applying to (for example the Ministry of National Defence), then take a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics. For fee-paying places, the ranking is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

atm|Facultatea de Sisteme Informatice și.name: Faculty of Information Systems and Cyber Security
atm|Facultatea de Sisteme Informatice și.about: Here you learn computers and cyber security for defence: the faculty has a single bachelor's programme, Computers and Information Systems for Defence and National Security. The academy has trained computer engineers for more than 50 years, and the faculty has a cyber security research centre.
atm|Facultatea de Sisteme Informatice și.admission: For state-funded places you first go through the recruitment and selection carried out by the institution you are applying to (for example the Ministry of National Defence), then take a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics. For fee-paying places, the ranking is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

atm|Facultatea de Sisteme Integrate de A.name: Faculty of Integrated Weapon Systems, Engineering and Mechatronics
atm|Facultatea de Sisteme Integrate de A.about: Here engineer officers are trained in four directions: weapons, missiles and ammunition; combat engineering (minefields, demolitions and camouflage); military construction, roads and bridges; and topography and geodesy. The faculty also carries out defence research.
atm|Facultatea de Sisteme Integrate de A.admission: For state-funded places you first go through the recruitment and selection carried out by the institution you are applying to (for example the Ministry of National Defence), then take a multiple-choice test in mathematics, computer science and physics. For fee-paying places, the ranking is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

bioterra|Facultatea de Asistență Medical.name: Faculty of General Nursing
bioterra|Facultatea de Asistență Medical.about: It trains general nurses, over four years of study. You learn anatomy, physiology, patient care and notions of psychology and ethics, and you do practical work in hospital wards. The programme is offered in Bucharest and in Buzău.
bioterra|Facultatea de Asistență Medical.admission: Admission is based on your application file, without an exam: the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the overall average of the high-school years.

bioterra|Facultatea de Controlul și Expe.name: Faculty of Food Product Control and Expertise
bioterra|Facultatea de Controlul și Expe.about: Here you learn how to check that food is safe, from the raw material to the shelf. You study food chemistry, biochemistry and microbiology and quality control, over four years, with practical work in the university's centres.
bioterra|Facultatea de Controlul și Expe.admission: You enter with the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, without an exam: candidates are ranked by this average. If averages are equal, the average of the high-school years is taken into account.

bioterra|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
bioterra|Facultatea de Drept.about: Here you study Law, in Bucharest or in Buzău, and there is also the programme European and International Law. The faculty was founded in 1998 and trains future lawyers, notaries, magistrates or civil servants.
bioterra|Facultatea de Drept.admission: You enter with the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, without an exam: candidates are ranked by this average. If averages are equal, the average of the high-school years is taken into account.

bioterra|Facultatea de Management Agrotu.name: Faculty of Agritourism Management
bioterra|Facultatea de Management Agrotu.about: It has the programme Engineering and Management in Public Catering and Agritourism: you learn how to run a guesthouse, a restaurant or a rural tourism business. The programme belongs to the field of engineering and management in agriculture and rural development.
bioterra|Facultatea de Management Agrotu.admission: You enter with the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, without an exam: candidates are ranked by this average. If averages are equal, the average of the high-school years is taken into account.

bioterra|Facultatea de Management Agrotu.name: Faculty of Agritourism Management in Buzău
bioterra|Facultatea de Management Agrotu.about: It is the Buzău faculty of Bioterra University, with the same programme as in Bucharest: Engineering and Management in Public Catering and Agritourism. You learn about public catering, agritourism and rural development without moving to the capital.
bioterra|Facultatea de Management Agrotu.admission: You enter with the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, without an exam: candidates are ranked by this average. If averages are equal, the average of the high-school years is taken into account.

bogdan-voda|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
bogdan-voda|Facultatea de Drept.about: The faculty, founded in 1992, has the bachelor's programme Law, full-time or part-time. You study civil, criminal, commercial and international law, and in practical work you take part in mock trials and do placements in legal institutions.
bogdan-voda|Facultatea de Drept.admission: There is no exam: the admission average is calculated equally from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years.

bogdan-voda|Facultatea de Educație Fizic.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
bogdan-voda|Facultatea de Educație Fizic.about: The faculty, founded in 1994, trains specialists in physical education and sport through a full-time bachelor's programme. You learn the theoretical and practical foundations of the field and teaching methods, and you do practical work in cooperation with sports organisations.
bogdan-voda|Facultatea de Educație Fizic.admission: You take an eliminatory practical test of sports aptitude: a 50 m sprint, a standing long jump and push-ups. The admission average is made up of the grade from the sports test, which weighs more, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

bogdan-voda|Facultatea de Științe Econom.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
bogdan-voda|Facultatea de Științe Econom.about: The faculty, founded in 1993, has the bachelor's programme Management, full-time or part-time. You learn about strategy, human resources, marketing and financial management, as well as communication, negotiation and entrepreneurship.
bogdan-voda|Facultatea de Științe Econom.admission: There is no exam: the admission average is calculated equally from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years.

cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Drept.about: The faculty was founded in 1991 and has the four-year, full-time bachelor's programme Law. You learn civil, criminal, constitutional and administrative law and European Union law, as well as forensics and legal English. You take part in mock trials and do placements in courts, law offices, notaries and bailiffs; the faculty also has a forensics laboratory.
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Drept.admission: You enter based on the average obtained in the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) exam, with no admission exam.

cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Geografie.name: Faculty of Geography
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Geografie.about: The faculty has the three-year, full-time bachelor's programme Tourism Geography. You learn about natural and man-made tourist resources, tourism economics and marketing, destination planning and tourism that protects the environment. You also work with digital maps (GIS) and do practical work at partner institutions and companies.
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Geografie.admission: You enter based on the average obtained in the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) exam, with no admission exam.

cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Medicină.about: The faculty has a single bachelor's programme, Dental Medicine, which lasts six years, full-time, and prepares you to become a dentist. In the first years you learn anatomy, physiology and biochemistry, then specialist subjects such as prosthodontics, endodontics, orthodontics and oral surgery. You do specialist practical work every year, and the university has its own dental clinic.
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: Admission is through a multiple-choice test, taken at the university's premises, in biology (human anatomy and physiology, grade 11) and chemistry (grades 10 and 11), following a bibliography published by the faculty.

cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Psihologi.name: Faculty of Psychology
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Psihologi.about: The faculty has the three-year, full-time bachelor's programme Psychology, taught in Romanian. You learn to assess people and plan psychological interventions, in three directions: educational psychology, work and organisational psychology, and clinical psychology. After the bachelor's you can continue here with a master's in human resources or in clinical psychology and psychotherapy.
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Psihologi.admission: You enter based on the average obtained in the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) exam, with no admission exam.

cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Științe E.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Științe E.about: The faculty has the three-year, full-time bachelor's programme Economics of Trade, Tourism and Services. You learn economics, finance and how to run a business in trade, tourism or services, with practical applications for companies and institutions. Students can go abroad to study through Erasmus+.
cantemir-tgmures|Facultatea de Științe E.admission: You enter based on the average obtained in the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) exam, with no admission exam.

danubius|Facultatea de Afaceri Globale ș.name: Faculty of Global Business and Leadership
danubius|Facultatea de Afaceri Globale ș.about: It is the university's economics faculty. It has three three-year bachelor's programmes: Finance and Banking, Accounting and Management Information Systems, and Economics of Trade, Tourism and Services. You learn to work with money, budgets and financial reports, to keep a company's accounts or to run a trade and tourism business; some programmes can also be followed part-time or by distance learning.
danubius|Facultatea de Afaceri Globale ș.admission: There is no exam: admission is a file-based competition in which only the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the tie is broken by a grade from the written tests of the bac.

danubius|Facultatea de Drept și Guvernan.name: Faculty of Law and International Governance
danubius|Facultatea de Drept și Guvernan.about: Here you study law and relations between states. It has two bachelor's programmes: Law, which lasts four years, and International Relations and European Studies, which lasts three years. Both can be followed full-time or by distance learning, and Law also part-time; students also have a mock trial club.
danubius|Facultatea de Drept și Guvernan.admission: There is no exam: admission is a file-based competition in which only the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the tie is broken by a grade from the written tests of the bac.

danubius|Facultatea de Educație Smart și.name: Faculty of Smart Education and Training of Innovative Teachers
danubius|Facultatea de Educație Smart și.about: The faculty trains future primary school teachers through the bachelor's programme Primary School Pedagogy, a new programme. You learn how to teach in the early grades, with an emphasis on digital tools and modern methods, and you do practical work in partner schools. The department that trains teachers also operates here.
danubius|Facultatea de Educație Smart și.admission: First you pass two eliminatory aptitude tests, graded admitted or rejected: communication skills in Romanian and physical education. Then only the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. Graduates of a pedagogical high school do not take the aptitude tests.

danubius|Facultatea de Media, Design și.name: Faculty of Media, Design and Technology
danubius|Facultatea de Media, Design și.about: The faculty brings together communication, digital media and computer science. It has three three-year bachelor's programmes: Communication and Public Relations, Digital Media and Computer Science. You can learn journalism and online communication, multimedia content production and interactive design, or programming, data analysis and IT security.
danubius|Facultatea de Media, Design și.admission: There is no exam: admission is a file-based competition in which only the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the tie is broken by a grade from the written tests of the bac.

danubius|Facultatea de Științe ale Vieți.name: Faculty of Life Sciences and Human Development
danubius|Facultatea de Științe ale Vieți.about: The faculty has two bachelor's programmes: Psychology and Social Work. In Psychology you train to work with people in mental health, education, organisations or justice. In Social Work you learn how to support vulnerable people and communities. The emphasis is on combining theory with practice.
danubius|Facultatea de Științe ale Vieți.admission: There is no exam: admission is a file-based competition in which only the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the tie is broken by a grade from the written tests of the bac.

dragan-lugoj|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
dragan-lugoj|Facultatea de Drept.about: The faculty has a single bachelor's programme, Law, lasting four years, full-time. It prepares you for careers such as legal adviser, lawyer, notary, judge, prosecutor, bailiff or police officer.
dragan-lugoj|Facultatea de Drept.admission: There is no exam: you submit your application file, and the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. Candidates are admitted in the order of their averages. If averages are equal, the average of the high-school years is taken into account.

dragan-lugoj|Facultatea de Științe Econo.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
dragan-lugoj|Facultatea de Științe Econo.about: The faculty has a single bachelor's programme, Finance and Banking, lasting three years, full-time. It prepares you to work as an economist in finance, banking, insurance or public administration, for example as a financial and banking analyst.
dragan-lugoj|Facultatea de Științe Econo.admission: There is no exam: you submit your application file, and the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. Candidates are admitted in the order of their averages. If averages are equal, the average of the high-school years is taken into account.

emanuel-oradea|Facultatea de Management.name: Faculty of Management
emanuel-oradea|Facultatea de Management.about: Here you study Management or Economic Informatics, three years each, at a Christian Baptist university. Management prepares you for companies, banks or non-profit organisations, and Economic Informatics for jobs such as web developer or database administrator.
emanuel-oradea|Facultatea de Management.admission: You have a motivation interview with a test on the Baptist Confession of Faith (admitted/rejected). For Management you also take a written test in English, economics and aptitudes, and for Economic Informatics a computer test in English, logic and creativity. As a rule you must be a baptised member of an evangelical church and bring a recommendation from your pastor.

emanuel-oradea|Facultatea de Teologie.name: Faculty of Theology
emanuel-oradea|Facultatea de Teologie.about: Besides Pastoral Baptist Theology (four years), which trains pastors, missionaries and religion teachers, the faculty also has programmes in Music, Social Work and Romanian Language and Literature – English Language and Literature (three years each). It is a faculty of a Christian Baptist university.
emanuel-oradea|Facultatea de Teologie.admission: For all programmes you have a motivation interview with a test on the Baptist Confession of Faith (admitted/rejected). For Music an oral test of musical aptitude (voice and solfeggio) is added, and for Romanian-English an interview in English. As a rule you must be a baptised member of an evangelical church and bring a recommendation from your pastor.

george-bacovia|Facultatea de Științe Eco.name: Faculty of Economic, Legal and Administrative Sciences
george-bacovia|Facultatea de Științe Eco.about: It is the university's only faculty. Here you can study management, economics of trade, tourism and services, law, public administration or computer science. The courses include seminars, practical work and work placements.
george-bacovia|Facultatea de Științe Eco.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without an exam: candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You can apply online, by email or at the university's premises.

hyperion|Facultatea de Arte.name: Faculty of Arts
hyperion|Facultatea de Arte.about: Here you study acting (4 years) or film: film and TV directing and film and TV cinematography (3 years each). Admission is through practical tests, not an application file.
hyperion|Facultatea de Arte.admission: You enter through aptitude tests. For Acting: an eliminatory test (improvisation, poems, a song, sight reading) and a graded test (storytelling and a monologue). For Directing and Cinematography: an eliminatory oral stage (a discussion about a film and about your photographs), then a written test and a practical one. The admission average is calculated from the grades in the tests.

hyperion|Facultatea de Jurnalism.name: Faculty of Journalism
hyperion|Facultatea de Jurnalism.about: Here you learn journalism for the print press, radio and television, with theory and practice, and you get to know public relations, advertising and the online press. The bachelor's lasts 3 years.
hyperion|Facultatea de Jurnalism.admission: Admission is based on your application file, without an exam: candidates are admitted in the order of their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

hyperion|Facultatea de Psihologie și Ști.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
hyperion|Facultatea de Psihologie și Ști.about: Here you study Psychology, in full-time courses. It is one of the two faculties of the university that hold an admission exam.
hyperion|Facultatea de Psihologie și Ști.admission: You take a written multiple-choice test based on the grade 10 psychology textbook. In the admission average the grade from the test counts first, then the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you study international business, accounting and management information systems, economics of trade, tourism and services, finance and banking, or management. The bachelor's lasts 3 years, full-time or by distance learning; accounting can also be studied in Satu Mare.
hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: Admission is based on your application file, without an exam: candidates are admitted in the order of their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Exacte și.name: Faculty of Exact and Engineering Sciences
hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Exacte și.about: Here you study Computer Science or Physics (3 years each) or Automation and Applied Informatics (4 years), where you learn programming, microcontrollers and control systems. Students have made drones, robotic arms and 3D scanners as bachelor's projects.
hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Exacte și.admission: Admission is based on your application file, without an exam: candidates are admitted in the order of their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Juridice.name: Faculty of Legal Sciences
hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Juridice.about: Here you study Law, 4 years, full-time or by distance learning. Besides courses, the faculty has student circles in administrative law, criminal procedure, public and private law, and a forensics laboratory.
hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Juridice.admission: Admission is based on your application file, without an exam: candidates are admitted in the order of their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Sociale,.name: Faculty of Social, Humanistic and Natural Sciences
hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Sociale,.about: Here you study political science, geography or philology: Romanian language and literature together with a modern language, English or Japanese.
hyperion|Facultatea de Științe Sociale,.admission: Admission is based on your application file, without an exam: candidates are admitted in the order of their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ioan-slavici|Facultatea de Inginerie.name: Faculty of Engineering
ioan-slavici|Facultatea de Inginerie.about: The faculty has a single bachelor's programme, Information Technology, lasting four years, in the field of computers. The practical part takes place in laboratories with high-performance computers.
ioan-slavici|Facultatea de Inginerie.admission: There is no written exam. At enrolment you take a knowledge-testing interview, graded admitted or rejected, then the committee assesses the files and draws up the ranking, taking the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average into account.

ioan-slavici|Facultatea de Științe Econo.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
ioan-slavici|Facultatea de Științe Econo.about: Here you study Finance and Banking or Accounting and Management Information Systems, three years each. You learn to keep a company's financial records and to analyse financial information using a computer. Students can do practical work and applied projects together with companies.
ioan-slavici|Facultatea de Științe Econo.admission: There is no written exam. At enrolment you take a knowledge-testing interview, graded admitted or rejected, then the committee assesses the files and draws up the ranking, taking the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average into account.

itb-bucuresti|Facultatea de Teologie.name: Faculty of Theology
itb-bucuresti|Facultatea de Teologie.about: It trains ministers for Baptist churches, through the programme Pastoral Baptist Theology, full-time or by distance learning. Over the four years you study the Bible, Greek and Hebrew, church history, preaching, counselling and mission, with pastoral practice every semester.
itb-bucuresti|Facultatea de Teologie.admission: Admission is a competition based on your application file: an essay on a given topic is graded, which counts the most, along with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For the full-time programme there is first an eliminatory oral test, with an interview and questions from the Baptist Confession of Faith; you also need recommendations from your church.

itp-bucuresti|Facultatea de Teologie Pen.name: Faculty of Pentecostal Theology
itp-bucuresti|Facultatea de Teologie Pen.about: It is the institute's only faculty and has a single bachelor's programme: Pastoral Pentecostal Theology, full-time, four years. It trains ministers for Pentecostal churches.
itp-bucuresti|Facultatea de Teologie Pen.admission: There are two tests: an interview with public communication, oral and eliminatory, and a written test of biblical knowledge from the Old and New Testaments. You must be a baptised member of a Pentecostal church and have recommendations from the church.

itp-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie.name: Faculty of Theology
itp-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie.about: The institute's only faculty: it trains pastors for the Reformed, Evangelical-Lutheran and Unitarian churches of Transylvania. The bachelor's in pastoral Protestant theology lasts four years, and the admission tests are taken in Hungarian.
itp-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie.admission: Each church has its own rules. For the Reformed line you go to a pre-admission camp with an interview, then take oral tests on the Bible and the catechism and a church singing test; Hungarian also counts. For the Unitarian line you have an eliminatory discussion and oral tests on the Bible and the catechism, and for the Lutheran line an eliminatory discussion and a written paper; for both, your high-school grades and Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grades also count. You must be a member of the church and have the recommendation of your parish.

iuls|Facultatea de Agricultură.name: Faculty of Agriculture
iuls|Facultatea de Agricultură.about: Here you learn how land is cultivated and how a farm is run. The engineering programmes last four years: Agriculture, Mountain Agriculture, Operation of Machinery and Installations for Agriculture and the Food Industry, Agricultural Business Engineering and Management, Agricultural Product Processing Technology, Consumer and Environmental Protection. There is also Biology, lasting three years. The faculty continues the first agriculture courses given in Iași by Ion Ionescu de la Brad.
iuls|Facultatea de Agricultură.admission: You enter without an exam, through a competition based on your Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grades: the grade from the written Romanian language and literature exam and the grade from another written exam, of your choice, count in equal parts.

iuls|Facultatea de Horticultură.name: Faculty of Horticulture
iuls|Facultatea de Horticultură.about: It has four four-year bachelor's programmes, from which you graduate as an engineer. In Horticulture you learn to grow grapevines, fruit trees, vegetables and flowers and to make wine. In Landscape Architecture you design and look after parks and gardens. In Environmental Engineering you learn about water treatment, pollution control and recycling, and in Agricultural Biotechnology about propagating plants in the laboratory and improving them.
iuls|Facultatea de Horticultură.admission: You enter without an exam, through a competition based on your Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grades: the grade from the written Romanian language and literature exam and the grade from another written exam, of your choice, count in equal parts.

iuls|Facultatea de Ingineria resurselor.name: Faculty of Animal and Food Resources Engineering
iuls|Facultatea de Ingineria resurselor.about: It is the former Faculty of Animal Science, founded in 1951, which has had its current name since 2021. It has three four-year bachelor's programmes, from which you graduate as an engineer: Animal Science (animal husbandry), Food Product Control and Expertise, and Engineering and Management in Public Catering and Agritourism.
iuls|Facultatea de Ingineria resurselor.admission: You enter without an exam, through a competition based on your Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grades: the grade from the written Romanian language and literature exam and the grade from another written exam, of your choice, count in equal parts.

iuls|Facultatea de Medicină Veterinară.name: Faculty of Veterinary Medicine
iuls|Facultatea de Medicină Veterinară.about: Here you train to become a veterinarian. The Veterinary Medicine programme lasts six years and has curricula in Romanian and in English. You start with anatomy, physiology and biochemistry, then move on to medical clinic, surgery, reproduction and food safety. The faculty, founded in 1961, has a veterinary hospital with emergency services, clinics, imaging and laboratories.
iuls|Facultatea de Medicină Veterinară.admission: You enter without an exam, through a competition based on your Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grades: the grade from the written Romanian language and literature exam and the grade from another written exam, of your choice, count in equal parts.

ovidius|Facultatea de Arte.name: Faculty of Arts
ovidius|Facultatea de Arte.about: Here you study music, singing, acting, choreography or pedagogy of the visual and decorative arts. The faculty started from music and theatre programmes and has three fields: music, theatre and visual arts. Most of the training is practical: you sing, act, dance or draw.
ovidius|Facultatea de Arte.admission: You enter based on aptitude tests, different for each programme: an eliminatory test graded admitted or rejected, then graded practical tests (for example a monologue and improvisation for acting, musical pieces for singing, drawing and colour for visual arts). The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts only as a tie-breaker.

ovidius|Facultatea de Construcții.name: Faculty of Civil Engineering
ovidius|Facultatea de Construcții.about: Here you become a construction engineer: you learn to design, carry out and manage construction works. You can choose civil, industrial and agricultural buildings, hydrotechnical works (dams, ports, canals, water networks) or construction engineering and management, a dual programme in which part of the training takes place in partner companies.
ovidius|Facultatea de Construcții.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You also submit a letter of intent, which is assessed only as admitted or rejected.

ovidius|Facultatea de Drept și Științe A.name: Faculty of Law and Administrative Sciences
ovidius|Facultatea de Drept și Științe A.about: Here you study law or administrative sciences: Law, Public Administration, Local Police and Managerial and Administrative Assistance. The faculty trains future lawyers and people who work in public institutions. Law lasts four years, and the other programmes three years.
ovidius|Facultatea de Drept și Științe A.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You also write a motivation essay, which is assessed only as admitted or rejected.

ovidius|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
ovidius|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și.about: Here you train to be a physical education teacher, a coach or a physiotherapist. The programmes are Physical Education and Sport, Sport and Motor Performance, and Physiotherapy and Special Motricity, all three years. You do a lot of sports practice, alongside subjects about the human body and training.
ovidius|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și.admission: First you take an eliminatory motor-capacity test, a timed applied course, graded admitted or rejected. Then you take a graded sports test of your choice (athletics, gymnastics, tennis or a team game); its grade is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ovidius|Facultatea de Farmacie.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
ovidius|Facultatea de Farmacie.about: Here you learn about medicines: how they are prepared, how they act and how they are correctly dispensed. Besides Pharmacy, the faculty also has the programme Medical Cosmetics and Cosmetic Product Technology. You work a lot in laboratories, in the faculty building on the campus.
ovidius|Facultatea de Farmacie.admission: For Pharmacy you take a written multiple-choice test in Anatomy and Organic Chemistry. For Medical Cosmetics there is no exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts together with the average of the high-school years, plus a letter of intent assessed as admitted or rejected.

ovidius|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică.name: Faculty of Mechanical, Industrial and Maritime Engineering
ovidius|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică.about: Here you become an engineer in fields related to machines, industry and the sea: road vehicles, industrial energy, mechanical engineering (a dual programme, with part of the training in companies), applied informatics in industrial engineering or economic engineering in the mechanical field. Studies last four years, and the faculty works with shipyards and companies in the port and in energy.
ovidius|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You also submit a letter of intent, which is assessed only as admitted or rejected.

ovidius|Facultatea de Istorie și Științe.name: Faculty of History and Political Sciences
ovidius|Facultatea de Istorie și Științe.about: Here you study History, Political Science or International Relations and European Studies. You learn how societies have evolved, how states work and how decisions are made in politics and diplomacy. The faculty has its own libraries and works with museums and research institutes.
ovidius|Facultatea de Istorie și Științe.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You also write a motivation essay, which is assessed only as admitted or rejected.

ovidius|Facultatea de Litere.name: Faculty of Letters
ovidius|Facultatea de Litere.about: Here you study languages and literatures: Romanian, English or French, together with a second language (for example German, Italian or Turkish). You can also choose American Studies or Journalism. The faculty continues the tradition of the former Faculty of Philology in Constanța.
ovidius|Facultatea de Litere.admission: For the language programmes and American Studies the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, and the letter of intent (written in the language of the programme) is assessed as admitted or rejected. For Journalism, the motivation essay is graded and counts alongside the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ovidius|Facultatea de Matematică și Info.name: Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science
ovidius|Facultatea de Matematică și Info.about: Here you study Computer Science (in Romanian or in English) or Mathematics and Computer Science. You learn programming, algorithms, databases, networks and artificial intelligence, on a solid base of mathematics. Graduates work mostly as programmers, analysts or systems administrators.
ovidius|Facultatea de Matematică și Info.admission: There is no exam. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts for the most part, to which is added the best of your bac grades in Mathematics and Computer Science. The letter of intent is assessed as admitted or rejected.

ovidius|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
ovidius|Facultatea de Medicină.about: Here you train to become a doctor, a nurse or a rehabilitation specialist. The programmes are Medicine (in Romanian and in English), General Nursing, and Balneology, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation. The faculty has existed since the university was founded.
ovidius|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: You enter through a written multiple-choice exam. For Medicine, most questions are in Biology, and the rest in Organic Chemistry or Physics, of your choice. For General Nursing and for Balneology and Physiotherapy the test is in Biology only. Medicine in English has separate rules: an English language test and a file-based competition, according to the faculty's methodology.

ovidius|Facultatea de Psihologie și Știi.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
ovidius|Facultatea de Psihologie și Știi.about: Here you study psychology, social work or educational sciences. You can become a psychologist, a social worker, a primary school teacher or a specialist who works with children with special needs. The programmes are Psychology, Social Work, Primary School Pedagogy, Early Education and Special Psychopedagogy.
ovidius|Facultatea de Psihologie și Știi.admission: For all programmes the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. In addition, Psychology and Early Education have an eliminatory interview, Primary School Pedagogy an eliminatory test of communication skills and aptitudes, and Social Work and Special Psychopedagogy a motivation essay; all are assessed as admitted or rejected.

ovidius|Facultatea de Stomatologie.name: Faculty of Dental Medicine
ovidius|Facultatea de Stomatologie.about: Here you train to become a dentist or a dental technician. The programmes are Dental Medicine (six years, in Romanian or in English) and Dental Technology (three years). Besides courses, you do a lot of practical work, in the faculty and in partner hospitals.
ovidius|Facultatea de Stomatologie.admission: For Dental Medicine you take a written multiple-choice exam, mostly in Biology, plus Organic Chemistry or Physics, of your choice. For Dental Technology you take an aptitude test, which counts together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. The programme in English is for foreign citizens, who enter based on their file.

ovidius|Facultatea de Științe ale Naturi.name: Faculty of Natural Sciences and Agricultural Sciences
ovidius|Facultatea de Științe ale Naturi.about: Here you study nature and agriculture: Biology, Ecology and Environmental Protection, Geography, Tourism Geography and Agriculture. It is one of the oldest faculties of the university in Constanța. Agriculture lasts four years and can also be followed part-time or in a dual system; the other programmes last three years.
ovidius|Facultatea de Științe ale Naturi.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You also submit a letter of intent, which is assessed only as admitted or rejected.

ovidius|Facultatea de Științe Aplicate ș.name: Faculty of Applied Sciences and Engineering
ovidius|Facultatea de Științe Aplicate ș.about: Here you study chemistry, physics and chemical engineering applied in industry: Medical Chemistry, Food Chemistry and Biochemical Technologies, Oil Processing and Petrochemistry, Technological Physics and Environmental Protection in Industry. Some programmes are in the dual system, meaning part of the training takes place in companies.
ovidius|Facultatea de Științe Aplicate ș.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You also submit a letter of intent, which is assessed only as admitted or rejected.

ovidius|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
ovidius|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you study economics and business: accounting, finance and banking, management, marketing, international business, economics of the firm or of trade, tourism and services. There is also a Business Administration programme taught in English. Some programmes can also be followed by distance learning.
ovidius|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You also submit a letter of intent, assessed as admitted or rejected. For the programme in English you also need a language proficiency certificate.

ovidius|Facultatea de Teologie.name: Faculty of Theology
ovidius|Facultatea de Teologie.about: Here you study Orthodox theology: Pastoral Theology (for future priests), Didactic Theology (for future religion teachers) or Religious Music. The faculty trains priests and theologians and has its own library and choirs that sing at services and cultural events.
ovidius|Facultatea de Teologie.admission: You have a motivational interview, assessed as admitted or rejected, and the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

partium|Facultatea de Litere și Arte.name: Faculty of Letters and Arts
partium|Facultatea de Litere și Arte.about: The faculty has two departments, Language and Literature and Arts, and courses are taught in Hungarian. You can study Hungarian or English language and literature, graphic art (graphic design and animation) or classical singing (opera, lied, oratorio). There is a lot of work on practical projects.
partium|Facultatea de Litere și Arte.admission: For Hungarian Language and Literature, your Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade in Hungarian and the bac average count; for Hungarian–English, the bac grades in Hungarian and in English. For Graphic Art you take a drawing test, a creative test and a portfolio interview, plus the bac average. For Singing you take tests in vocal technique and music theory and an interview. Admission is held in Hungarian.

partium|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic and Social Sciences
partium|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here are the economic programmes (Management, Finance and Banking, Economic Informatics, Economics of Trade, Tourism and Services) and the socio-humanistic ones (Social Work, Sociology, Primary School Pedagogy). Courses are taught in Hungarian, and students do work placements at companies in Romania and abroad.
partium|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: There is no exam: the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and a grade from one bac exam (for Primary School Pedagogy, the grade from the written Hungarian language exam). If you studied in another language, you may have an eliminatory Hungarian test.

rau|Facultatea de Afaceri Internaționale.name: Faculty of International Business
rau|Facultatea de Afaceri Internaționale.about: Here you learn how business is done between countries: international economic relations, strategy, entrepreneurship and working with people from different cultures. The bachelor's programme lasts three years and can be followed in Romanian or in English. The faculty also has double-degree programmes with universities in the United States.
rau|Facultatea de Afaceri Internaționale.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade of a certificate or professional qualification from high school count, in equal parts. If you do not have such a certificate, you take, as you choose, an essay or a motivation interview. For the programme in English you have an online interview and prove that you know the language.

rau|Facultatea de Arhitectură.name: Faculty of Architecture
rau|Facultatea de Arhitectură.about: It has a single programme, Architecture, taught in English, which lasts six years and combines the bachelor's with the master's. You learn to design buildings and spaces, using digital tools such as 3D modelling from the start. The programme is new and for now operates with provisional authorisation.
rau|Facultatea de Arhitectură.admission: You take an aptitude test: you upload a portfolio of drawings on three themes online, then have an interview about it. The grade from the aptitude test and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade count in equal parts.

rau|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
rau|Facultatea de Drept.about: You study law for four years, full-time or part-time: civil, criminal and administrative law and European rules. Besides the classic subjects there are also courses such as American constitutional history and law. From the second year you can do practical work in law offices, notary offices, courts and prosecutors' offices.
rau|Facultatea de Drept.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade of a certificate or professional qualification from high school count, in equal parts. If you do not have such a certificate, you take, as you choose, an essay or a motivation interview.

rau|Facultatea de Educație Fizică, Sport.name: Faculty of Physical Education, Sport and Physiotherapy
rau|Facultatea de Educație Fizică, Sport.about: It has two three-year programmes: Physical Education and Sport, where you learn to lead sports lessons and activities, and Physiotherapy and Special Motricity, where you learn to design recovery programmes through movement. The emphasis is on practice, in cooperation with sports clubs, medical units and schools.
rau|Facultatea de Educație Fizică, Sport.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts for half, and the other half is the grade in the competition test, which you choose: a motor aptitude test (a timed course), an essay, an interview, or a certificate or sports results. You also need a medical certificate.

rau|Facultatea de Finanțe și Contabilita.name: Faculty of Finance and Accounting
rau|Facultatea de Finanțe și Contabilita.about: You learn how money circulates and how it is recorded: finance, banking, accounting, financial analysis and the computer programs used in the field. It has the programmes Finance and Banking (also in English) and Accounting and Management Information Systems, three years each. Graduates work as financial analysts, accountants, auditors or in banks.
rau|Facultatea de Finanțe și Contabilita.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade of a certificate or professional qualification from high school count, in equal parts. If you do not have such a certificate, you take, as you choose, an essay or a motivation interview. For the programme in English you have an online interview and prove that you know the language.

rau|Facultatea de Informatică Managerial.name: Faculty of Managerial Informatics
rau|Facultatea de Informatică Managerial.about: It combines computer science with economics: you learn programming, databases and applications used in companies. The Economic Informatics programme lasts three years and also has a variant in English. You work in laboratories, and practical work takes place at software and IT consultancy companies.
rau|Facultatea de Informatică Managerial.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade of a certificate or professional qualification from high school count, in equal parts. If you do not have such a certificate, you take, as you choose, an essay or a motivation interview. For the programme in English you have an online interview and prove that you know the language.

rau|Facultatea de Management- Marketing.name: Faculty of Management-Marketing
rau|Facultatea de Management- Marketing.about: Here you learn how a company is run and how a product is promoted and sold. It has the programmes Management and Marketing, three years, full-time or part-time; Marketing can also be followed in English. Courses involve a lot of work with case studies, projects and simulations.
rau|Facultatea de Management- Marketing.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade of a certificate or professional qualification from high school count, in equal parts. If you do not have such a certificate, you take, as you choose, an essay or a motivation interview. For the programme in English you have an online interview and prove that you know the language.

rau|Facultatea de Psihologie și Științel.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
rau|Facultatea de Psihologie și Științel.about: It has two three-year programmes. In Psychology you learn about the mind and behaviour, assessment and counselling, with practical work in clinics, schools and organisations. In Early Education you train to work with young children, in nurseries and kindergartens, with practical work from the first year. The programmes for now operate with provisional authorisation.
rau|Facultatea de Psihologie și Științel.admission: For Psychology you take a multiple-choice test in psychology, which counts for more than the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Early Education you first have an eliminatory test of communication and aptitudes, then the bac average and an interview, an essay or a certificate count in equal parts.

rau|Facultatea de Științe Medicale.name: Faculty of Medical Sciences
rau|Facultatea de Științe Medicale.about: It has a single programme, General Nursing, lasting four years, which trains nurses. You learn anatomy, physiology, pharmacology, patient care and medical emergencies. Practical work is done gradually, in laboratories and in partner hospitals. The programme for now operates with provisional authorisation.
rau|Facultatea de Științe Medicale.admission: You take a written multiple-choice test in biology. In the admission average, the test counts for more than the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

rau|Facultatea de Turism și Managementul.name: Faculty of Tourism and Hospitality Management
rau|Facultatea de Turism și Managementul.about: You learn economics and business applied to tourism: how hotels and travel agencies work and how events are organised. The programme Economics of Trade, Tourism and Services lasts three years and also has a variant in English. Practical work takes place in hotels, travel agencies, airports and airlines.
rau|Facultatea de Turism și Managementul.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade of a certificate or professional qualification from high school count, in equal parts. If you do not have such a certificate, you take, as you choose, an essay or a motivation interview. For the programme in English you have an online interview and prove that you know the language.

sapientia|Facultatea de Științe ale Vieț.name: Faculty of Life Sciences and Sport in Sfântu Gheorghe
sapientia|Facultatea de Științe ale Vieț.about: It is the faculty of Sapientia University in Sfântu Gheorghe, taught in Hungarian. It has three bachelor's programmes: Agriculture and Forestry (4 years each) and Sport and Motor Performance (3 years).
sapientia|Facultatea de Științe ale Vieț.admission: For Agriculture and Forestry the admission grade is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Sport and Motor Performance you take an eliminatory practical test of motor aptitudes, which counts for more than the bac average.
