sapientia|Facultatea de Științe Economic.name: Faculty of Economic, Socio-Humanistic and Engineering Sciences in Miercurea Ciuc
sapientia|Facultatea de Științe Economic.about: It is the faculty of Sapientia University in Miercurea Ciuc, taught in Hungarian. It has very different programmes: economics, marketing, accounting and economic informatics, sociology, human resources, communication, languages and literatures, food product engineering, genetic engineering, physical education and sport.
sapientia|Facultatea de Științe Economic.admission: For most programmes the admission grade is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Food Product Engineering you also pass an eliminatory motivation interview, and for the languages and literatures programmes you also take an oral language test. For Physical Education and Sport you take a practical test of motor aptitudes, which counts for more than the bac average.

sapientia|Facultatea de Științe și Arte.name: Faculty of Sciences and Arts
sapientia|Facultatea de Științe și Arte.about: It is the faculty of Sapientia University in Cluj-Napoca, taught in Hungarian. Here you can study film and media (directing, cinematography, audiovisual communication), choreography, law, international relations and European studies, environmental science and environmental engineering.
sapientia|Facultatea de Științe și Arte.admission: It depends on the programme. For Law only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For International Relations, Environmental Science and Environmental Engineering the bac average also counts, after an eliminatory motivation interview. For film and media the grade comes only from tests: an aptitude test with a portfolio and a written one (the analysis of a film excerpt). For Choreography you pass an eliminatory test of musical ear, then take a dance test and an interview.

sapientia|Facultatea de Științe Tehnice.name: Faculty of Technical and Human Sciences in Târgu Mureș
sapientia|Facultatea de Științe Tehnice.about: It is the faculty of Sapientia University near Târgu Mureș (in Corunca), taught in Hungarian. Here you mostly learn engineering and computer science: computers, automation, mechatronics, telecommunications, mechanical engineering. It also has horticulture, landscape architecture, translation and interpreting, communication and public health.
sapientia|Facultatea de Științe Tehnice.admission: For the technical programmes and Computer Science, mostly your highest grade in mathematics, computer science or physics counts, from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) or from the faculty's admission exam (which you take if you do not have such a grade or want a better one), plus the bac average. For Horticulture, Landscape Architecture and Public Health only the bac average counts. For Communication the average and the grade in Hungarian or Romanian count, and for Translation the bac grades in languages.

snspa|Facultatea de Administrație Public.name: Faculty of Public Administration
snspa|Facultatea de Administrație Public.about: It prepares you to work in public institutions in Romania and in the European Union. It has the programmes Public Administration (full-time and by distance learning) and European Administration, three years each. The faculty emphasises integrity, transparency and accountability to citizens.
snspa|Facultatea de Administrație Public.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, with no exam. If averages are equal, the Romanian grade is compared, then the grade in the compulsory exam of the profile. Enrolment is online.

snspa|Facultatea de Comunicare și Relați.name: Faculty of Communication and Public Relations
snspa|Facultatea de Comunicare și Relați.about: You learn how companies, institutions and public figures communicate: public relations, advertising, mass media, social media and crisis communication. It has three three-year programmes: Communication and Public Relations, Advertising and Emerging Communication and Media (in English). Practical work can be done in agencies, companies, public institutions or newsrooms.
snspa|Facultatea de Comunicare și Relați.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts; if averages are equal, the Romanian grade is compared. For the programme in English you also upload a language certificate or a motivation letter in English, graded admitted/rejected.

snspa|Facultatea de Management.name: Faculty of Management
snspa|Facultatea de Management.about: It has a single bachelor's programme, Management, lasting three years, with applied courses on running companies, finance, marketing and projects. Students can do work placements and have the faculty's career centre.
snspa|Facultatea de Management.admission: Admission is a file-based competition, online: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the Romanian grade is compared, then the grade in the compulsory exam of the profile.

snspa|Facultatea de Științe Politice.name: Faculty of Political Sciences
snspa|Facultatea de Științe Politice.about: It has four three-year bachelor's programmes: Political Science, International Relations and European Studies, Sociology and Psychology. You learn how states, politics, society and human behaviour work, with a theoretical and research base.
snspa|Facultatea de Științe Politice.admission: You take an online multiple-choice test in a single subject, chosen by you from a list (for example history, economics, philosophy, logic, Romanian, mathematics, psychology or sociology). The ranking is made by the grade in the test; the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average is used only as a tie-breaker.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Educație Fizic.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Educație Fizic.about: Here you study Physical Education and Sport or Physiotherapy and Special Motricity, in Bucharest. Graduates can work as sports teachers, instructors or sports coaches, or as physiotherapists, respectively.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Educație Fizic.admission: You take a practical test: an applied course that checks your motor aptitudes. For Physical Education and Sport only this test counts; for Physiotherapy the test and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average count, in equal parts.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Inginerie și I.name: Faculty of Engineering and Computer Science
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Inginerie și I.about: A faculty in Bucharest where the bachelor's programme is Computer Science. You learn programming and how applications and information systems are built.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Inginerie și I.admission: You submit your file and take an interview-style test assessing knowledge and cognitive abilities, graded by a committee. The grade from this test is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Medicină Veter.name: Faculty of Veterinary Medicine
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Medicină Veter.about: It trains veterinarians: studies last 6 years, full-time, and end with the title of doctor of veterinary medicine. Practical work takes place in laboratories, in the faculty's veterinary clinics (pets and farm animals) and at partner farms and units.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Medicină Veter.admission: You submit your file and take an interview-style test assessing knowledge and cognitive abilities, graded by a committee. The grade from this test is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Psihologie și.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Psihologie și.about: A faculty in Bucharest with two directions: Psychology (full-time, part-time or by distance learning) and Primary School Pedagogy, for those who want to become primary school teachers.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Psihologie și.admission: You submit your file and take an admission interview; the grade from the interview is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Pedagogy, before the interview there is an eliminatory test of communication and aptitudes, graded admitted or rejected.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Psihologie și.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences, Brașov
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Psihologie și.about: A faculty in Brașov where you can study Psychology, Primary School Pedagogy or Early Education. It is a choice for those who want to work with people or become primary school teachers or early-years educators.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Psihologie și.admission: You submit your file and take an oral, interview-style test; the grade is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Primary School Pedagogy there is first an eliminatory test of communication and aptitudes, graded admitted or rejected.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Econom.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Econom.about: A faculty in Bucharest with programmes in Management, Accounting and Management Information Systems and Marketing (taught in English). Management can be followed full-time, part-time or by distance learning.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Econom.admission: You submit your file and take an interview-style test assessing knowledge and cognitive abilities, graded by a committee. The grade from this test is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Econom.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences, Câmpulung
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Econom.about: A faculty of "Spiru Haret" University, in Câmpulung, with a single bachelor's programme: Accounting and Management Information Systems. You learn accounting and how computers are used to keep a company's financial records.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Econom.admission: You submit your file and take an interview-style test assessing knowledge and cognitive abilities, graded by a committee. The grade from this test is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.name: Faculty of Legal and Administrative Sciences
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.about: The law faculty of "Spiru Haret" University in Bucharest. The bachelor's programme is Law and can be followed full-time or part-time.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.admission: You submit your file and take an interview-style test assessing knowledge and cognitive abilities, graded by a committee. The grade from this test is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.name: Faculty of Legal and Economic Sciences, Brașov
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.about: A faculty in Brașov with two bachelor's programmes: Law and Management. You can choose between legal training and training in running and organising companies.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.admission: You submit your file and take an interview-style test assessing knowledge and cognitive abilities, graded by a committee. The grade from this test is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.name: Faculty of Legal and Economic Sciences, Constanța
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.about: A faculty in Constanța with bachelor's programmes in Law and Management; Management can also be followed in English.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.admission: You submit your file and take an interview-style test assessing knowledge and cognitive abilities, graded by a committee. The grade from this test is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.name: Faculty of Legal, Economic and Administrative Sciences, Craiova
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.about: A faculty in Craiova with a wide offer: Law, Public Administration, Management, Accounting and Management Information Systems and Psychology. Law and Public Administration can be followed full-time, part-time or by distance learning.
spiru-haret|Facultatea de Științe Juridi.admission: You submit your file and take an interview-style test assessing knowledge and cognitive abilities, graded by a committee. The grade from this test is combined with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

tibiscus|Facultatea de Calculatoare și I.name: Faculty of Computers and Applied Informatics
tibiscus|Facultatea de Calculatoare și I.about: Here you learn computer science: the faculty has one bachelor's programme, Computer Science, and a computer science department with a research centre. It has operated since the 2000-2001 academic year and was founded by a group of mathematics teachers and engineers.
tibiscus|Facultatea de Calculatoare și I.admission: There is no exam. According to the latest methodology published by the faculty, the admission average is the average of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the mathematics grades from the high-school years (or computer science, if you did not have mathematics). Check the faculty's website for the rule for the year in which you apply.

tibiscus|Facultatea de Drept și Administ.name: Faculty of Law and Public Administration
tibiscus|Facultatea de Drept și Administ.about: Here you study law and prepare for a legal career. Theoretical courses are combined with judicial practice, and the teachers include people with experience in the judiciary and the bar.
tibiscus|Facultatea de Drept și Administ.admission: There is no exam: the admission grade is the average of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average in Romanian from all the high-school years, taken from the transcript.

tibiscus|Facultatea de Psihologie.name: Faculty of Psychology
tibiscus|Facultatea de Psihologie.about: Here you study psychology: the bachelor's lasts 3 years, full-time, and you can continue with a master's. The faculty was founded in 1991, has a sport psychology centre and sends students on Erasmus mobilities.
tibiscus|Facultatea de Psihologie.admission: There is no exam: the admission average is the average of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the Romanian grades from the high-school years, taken from the transcript.

tibiscus|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
tibiscus|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you learn applied economics, in two full-time bachelor's programmes of 3 years each: Accounting and Management Information Systems and Business Administration. The faculty has operated in the economics field since 1997.
tibiscus|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: There is no exam: the admission grade is the average of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the mathematics average from the high-school years, taken from the transcript (or computer science, if you did not have mathematics).

timotheus|Facultatea de Teologie Pastora.name: Faculty of Pastoral Theology
timotheus|Facultatea de Teologie Pastora.about: The institute was founded by the Christian Church According to the Gospel in Romania and has a single bachelor's specialisation, Pastoral Christian Theology According to the Gospel, lasting four years. The courses presented on the website include pastoral theology, systematic theology, church history and apologetics.
timotheus|Facultatea de Teologie Pastora.admission: You enrol online, then have an eliminatory interview, also online. You also write an essay on a given topic; in the average, the essay grade counts (more) along with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade. Church members need a recommendation from the local church.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Arhitectură \"G. M..name: Faculty of Architecture "G. M. Cantacuzino"
tuiasi|Facultatea de Arhitectură \"G. M..about: Here you learn to design buildings. The faculty has a single programme, Architecture, which lasts six years and combines the bachelor's with the master's. It is named after G. M. Cantacuzino.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Arhitectură \"G. M..admission: You take a drawing test, which counts the most in the admission average. The rest of the average comes from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Automatică și Calcu.name: Faculty of Automatic Control and Computers
tuiasi|Facultatea de Automatică și Calcu.about: Here you learn programming, computers and automatic systems. Studies last four years, in two fields: Computers and Information Technology, and Automatic Control, Applied Informatics and Intelligent Systems. At the end you receive the title of engineer.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Automatică și Calcu.admission: You take a multiple-choice test in mathematics or computer science, of your choice, which counts the most in the admission average. The rest of the average comes from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Construcții de Mași.name: Faculty of Machine Building and Industrial Management
tuiasi|Facultatea de Construcții de Mași.about: Here you learn how parts and machines are designed and manufactured: machine-building technology, welding, digital production systems, precision mechanics, hydraulic and pneumatic systems. It also has programmes in economic engineering and in manufacturing for the aerospace industry. Studies last four years.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Construcții de Mași.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. Prizes at certain olympiads and school competitions can bring extra points.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Construcții și Inst.name: Faculty of Civil Engineering and Building Services
tuiasi|Facultatea de Construcții și Inst.about: Here you learn to design and build buildings, roads, bridges and railways, as well as building services. Studies last four years, and civil engineering can also be studied in English. In civil engineering, you choose your specialisation after the first two years.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Construcții și Inst.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. Prizes at certain olympiads and school competitions can bring extra points.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Design Industrial ș.name: Faculty of Industrial Design and Business Management
tuiasi|Facultatea de Design Industrial ș.about: Here you learn industrial design, the technology and design of textile products, knitwear and leather goods, as well as economic engineering and business management. Industrial design can also be studied in English. Students do practical work in industrial companies.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Design Industrial ș.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Electronică, Teleco.name: Faculty of Electronics, Telecommunications and Information Technology
tuiasi|Facultatea de Electronică, Teleco.about: Here you learn applied electronics, microelectronics and telecommunications: how the circuits, devices and networks through which we communicate are designed. Studies last four years, and the telecommunications programme is also offered in English.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Electronică, Teleco.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam. What counts the most is the highest of your Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grades in mathematics, computer science and physics, and the rest of the average comes from the bac average. For the programme in English you also take an English test, graded admitted or rejected; you are exempt if you have a recognised certificate or the level required in the English exam of the bac.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Hidrotehnică, Geode.name: Faculty of Hydrotechnical Engineering, Geodesy and Environmental Engineering
tuiasi|Facultatea de Hidrotehnică, Geode.about: Here you learn about water-related construction (hydrotechnical works), land improvement and rural development, land surveying and cadastre, and environmental protection in agriculture. The programmes last eight semesters, that is four years.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Hidrotehnică, Geode.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Inginerie Chimică ș.name: Faculty of Chemical Engineering and Environmental Protection "Cristofor Simionescu"
tuiasi|Facultatea de Inginerie Chimică ș.about: Here you learn chemical engineering and environmental engineering: how substances and materials are produced in industry and how the environment is protected. It also has a programme in economic engineering in the chemical industry. Studies last four years and are in Romanian. The faculty has research centres and publishes a scientific journal of environmental engineering.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Inginerie Chimică ș.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. Prizes at certain olympiads and science competitions can bring extra points.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Energetics and Applied Informatics
tuiasi|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.about: Here you learn electrical engineering, energetics and informatics applied in these fields: from electrical machines and drives to energy production and distribution. Studies last four years. The faculty's history is linked to the academicians Dragomir Hurmuzescu and Ștefan Procopiu.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. Winners of the "Ștefan Procopiu" competition receive extra points.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Mecanică.name: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering
tuiasi|Facultatea de Mecanică.about: Here you learn engineering in three fields: automotive engineering, mechanical engineering and mechatronics and robotics. You find out how machines, engines, equipment and robots are designed and work.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Mecanică.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

tuiasi|Facultatea de Știința și Ingineri.name: Faculty of Materials Science and Engineering
tuiasi|Facultatea de Știința și Ingineri.about: Here you learn about the materials used in industry and how they are processed, as well as industrial equipment and safety in industry. The faculty trains engineers in three fields: materials engineering, mechanical engineering and industrial engineering.
tuiasi|Facultatea de Știința și Ingineri.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

uab|Facultatea de Drept și Științe Socia.name: Faculty of Law and Social Sciences
uab|Facultatea de Drept și Științe Socia.about: A faculty with varied programmes: Law, Public Administration, Sociology, Social Work, Human Resources, Occupational Therapy, as well as General Nursing, Physical Education and Sport and Physiotherapy. Law and Nursing last four years, the others three. The faculty was founded in 2003.
uab|Facultatea de Drept și Științe Socia.admission: For almost all programmes only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Physical Education and Sport and for Physiotherapy you first take a sports aptitude test, graded admitted/rejected.

uab|Facultatea de Informatică și Inginer.name: Faculty of Computer Science and Engineering
uab|Facultatea de Informatică și Inginer.about: It is the university's youngest faculty. You can study Computer Science (also in English), for three years, or four-year engineering programmes: Applied Electronics, Land Surveying and Cadastre, Environmental Engineering, Urban Engineering and Regional Development. The faculty keeps in touch with companies in the region.
uab|Facultatea de Informatică și Inginer.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Computer Science in English a language test is added, graded admitted/rejected, and for Applied Electronics in the dual system a motivation interview, also graded admitted/rejected.

uab|Facultatea de Istorie, Litere și Ști.name: Faculty of History, Letters and Educational Sciences
uab|Facultatea de Istorie, Litere și Ști.about: Here you study History, Romanian Language and Literature together with English Language and Literature, Translation and Interpreting, or pedagogy for primary school teachers and early-years educators. History and philology are among the university's oldest specialisations. Studies last three years; pedagogy can also be followed by distance learning, in Alba Iulia or in Deva.
uab|Facultatea de Istorie, Litere și Ști.admission: For History, Romanian-English and Translation and Interpreting only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Primary School Pedagogy you first take a vocational aptitude test, graded admitted/rejected, then the bac average counts.

uab|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
uab|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: You can study Business Administration (also in English), Accounting and Management Information Systems, Finance and Banking, Marketing or Economics of Trade, Tourism and Services. Studies last three years, and some programmes can also be followed by distance learning. The faculty has had this name since 2014.
uab|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Business Administration in English a language test is added, graded admitted/rejected, and for Operational Logistics in the dual system a motivation interview, also graded admitted/rejected.

uab|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.name: Faculty of Orthodox Theology
uab|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.about: The faculty has existed since 1991 and trains future priests in Pastoral Orthodox Theology, a four-year programme. Here you can also study, in three-year programmes, Religious Music, Sacred Art or Cinematography, Photography, Media.
uab|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.admission: For Pastoral Theology, Religious Music and Sacred Art you have a motivation interview graded admitted/rejected (for Sacred Art you also bring a portfolio of works), then the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Cinematography, Photography, Media, the bac average, a written creativity test and an interview are combined.

uad-cluj|Facultatea de Arte Decorative ș.name: Faculty of Decorative Arts and Design
uad-cluj|Facultatea de Arte Decorative ș.about: Here you study design, fashion and clothing design, textile arts, ceramics-glass-metal, or art history and theory. The studio programmes combine artistic and practical training, and art history and theory is a theoretical programme about the visual arts.
uad-cluj|Facultatea de Arte Decorative ș.admission: For the studio programmes you take a practical aptitude test and an interview based on your portfolio, with equal weight. For Art History and Theory there is no practical test: a motivation letter is assessed, and the other half of the average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

uad-cluj|Facultatea de Arte Plastice.name: Faculty of Fine Arts
uad-cluj|Facultatea de Arte Plastice.about: Here you study painting, sculpture, graphic art, photography and video, conservation and restoration of painting, or pedagogy of the visual and decorative arts. The faculty has five departments: Painting, Sculpture, Graphic Art, Photo-Video and Conservation-Restoration.
uad-cluj|Facultatea de Arte Plastice.admission: You take two tests that count equally: a practical test checking specialist aptitudes and an interview based on your portfolio. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average is used only as a tie-breaker.

uaic|Facultatea de Biologie.name: Faculty of Biology
uaic|Facultatea de Biologie.about: Here you study the living world: plants, animals, genetics, microbiology, biochemistry and environmental protection. You can choose between Biology, Biochemistry, and Ecology and Environmental Protection. Part of the practical work is done in the field, at the faculty's stations, for example at the marine one in Agigea.
uaic|Facultatea de Biologie.admission: You enter based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is the whole admission average. There is no exam at the faculty.

uaic|Facultatea de Chimie.name: Faculty of Chemistry
uaic|Facultatea de Chimie.about: Here you learn chemistry, with many laboratory hours. You can choose between Chemistry, Medical Chemistry and Food Chemistry. Graduates work in analysis laboratories, in research, in the pharmaceutical and chemical industries or as teachers.
uaic|Facultatea de Chimie.admission: You enter based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is the whole admission average. If averages are equal, your high-school Chemistry grade counts.

uaic|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
uaic|Facultatea de Drept.about: Here you study law: the laws, how justice works and how people's rights are defended. The faculty presents itself as the oldest law faculty in Romania, with beginnings in a law course given in Iași in 1830. It has full-time and part-time courses.
uaic|Facultatea de Drept.admission: The admission average is made up half of the grade in a written Romanian test (you must get at least 5) and half of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

uaic|Facultatea de Economie și Administr.name: Faculty of Economics and Business Administration
uaic|Facultatea de Economie și Administr.about: Here you study economics and business: accounting, finance and banking, management, marketing, economic informatics, international business and public administration. It also has a business administration programme taught in English.
uaic|Facultatea de Economie și Administr.admission: You enter based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is the whole admission average. For the programme in English you also take an English test or bring a recognised language certificate.

uaic|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Sp.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
uaic|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Sp.about: Here you train to be a physical education teacher, a coach, a physiotherapist or a sports manager. The faculty was founded in 1960 and has sports halls, a fitness room and an athletics track. Former students include European and world champions.
uaic|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Sp.admission: For Physical Education and Sport and for Sport Management, the sports test of your choice counts for more than the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Physiotherapy, the sports test is eliminatory (admitted/rejected), and the admission average is the bac average.

uaic|Facultatea de Filosofie și Științe.name: Faculty of Philosophy and Social-Political Sciences
uaic|Facultatea de Filosofie și Științe.about: Here you study people and society: philosophy, sociology, political science, international relations and European studies, social work, human resources, communication and public relations. The faculty has its beginnings in 1860, together with the University of Iași.
uaic|Facultatea de Filosofie și Științe.admission: You enter based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is the whole admission average. There is no exam at the faculty.

uaic|Facultatea de Fizică.name: Faculty of Physics
uaic|Facultatea de Fizică.about: Here you study physics and its applications. You can choose between Physics, Medical Physics, Computational Physics and Technological Physics. The faculty has four research centres, and the European Physical Society has awarded it the status of "historic site".
uaic|Facultatea de Fizică.admission: You enter based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is the whole admission average. If averages are equal, the grade in Physics or in Mathematics/Computer Science counts.

uaic|Facultatea de Geografie și Geologie.name: Faculty of Geography and Geology
uaic|Facultatea de Geografie și Geologie.about: Here you study geography, tourism, the environment, meteorology and hydrology, spatial planning and geology. You learn a lot in the field and in laboratories, and the faculty has three stations for students' practical work.
uaic|Facultatea de Geografie și Geologie.admission: For the geography and environmental science programmes, half of the average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and half is the bac grade in a written exam of your choice. For geology only the bac average counts. For programmes in a foreign language there is also a language interview, graded admitted/rejected.

uaic|Facultatea de Informatică.name: Faculty of Computer Science
uaic|Facultatea de Informatică.about: Here you learn programming and computer science: algorithms, databases, artificial intelligence, cyber security, software engineering. The faculty was founded in 1992, has links with IT companies, and its students take part in programming competitions.
uaic|Facultatea de Informatică.admission: You take a three-hour written test in Computer Science or in Mathematics (you choose at the start of the test); it has the greatest weight in the average. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average also counts, together with the bac grade in Computer Science or Mathematics (or, if it is higher, the test grade again). For the programme in English there is also an English interview, graded admitted/rejected.

uaic|Facultatea de Istorie.name: Faculty of History
uaic|Facultatea de Istorie.about: Here you study history, from archaeology to the contemporary era. Graduates become teachers, researchers, museum curators, archivists or work in international relations and the press. The faculty has an archaeology research platform called ARHEOINVEST.
uaic|Facultatea de Istorie.admission: You enter based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is the whole admission average. There is no exam at the faculty.

uaic|Facultatea de Litere.name: Faculty of Letters
uaic|Facultatea de Litere.about: Here you study Romanian language and literature, foreign languages (English, French, German, Italian, Russian, Spanish), classical languages, comparative literature, translation and interpreting, American studies or journalism. The faculty has existed since 1860, since the founding of the University of Iași.
uaic|Facultatea de Litere.admission: You enter based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is the whole admission average. If averages are equal, the grade from the written Romanian Language and Literature exam counts. For American Studies you must have studied English for at least two years in high school.

uaic|Facultatea de Matematică.name: Faculty of Mathematics
uaic|Facultatea de Matematică.about: Here you study mathematics or mathematics and computer science; the mathematics and computer science programme also exists in English. The faculty continues the mathematical school of Iași and has a research library founded in 1910, an astronomical observatory and a planetarium.
uaic|Facultatea de Matematică.admission: There is no exam at the faculty. The admission average is made up of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade in Mathematics or Computer Science (the larger part) and the bac average. For the programme in English you need at least level B1 in English.

uaic|Facultatea de Psihologie și Științe.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
uaic|Facultatea de Psihologie și Științe.about: Here you study psychology or educational sciences: Psychology, Pedagogy, Special Psychopedagogy and Primary School Pedagogy (for future primary school teachers). The faculty has research laboratories and is known for social psychology and for its clinical side.
uaic|Facultatea de Psihologie și Științe.admission: You enter based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is the whole admission average. For Primary School Pedagogy you first take an online test of communication skills and aptitudes, graded admitted/rejected.

uaic|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă „Sf.name: Faculty of Orthodox Theology "Saint Dumitru Stăniloae"
uaic|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă „Sf.about: Here you study Orthodox theology: Pastoral Theology (for future priests), Theology – Social Work and Sacred Art. The faculty has a laboratory for restoring old books and documents, and students can use the "Dumitru Stăniloae" library of the Archdiocese of Iași.
uaic|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă „Sf.admission: For Pastoral Theology you take an eliminatory test of diction and musical aptitudes and a written exam in Orthodox Teaching of the Faith; the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average has the greater weight. For Theology – Social Work and for Sacred Art you take no test: you enter through a file-based competition, with only the bac average.

uaic|Facultatea de Teologie Romano - Cat.name: Faculty of Roman Catholic Theology
uaic|Facultatea de Teologie Romano - Cat.about: Here you study Roman Catholic theology, in Pastoral Theology (4 years) or Theology – Social Work (3 years). The faculty was founded in 2002, and students can use the library of the Roman Catholic Theological Institute in Iași and volunteer at the Caritas centre.
uaic|Facultatea de Teologie Romano - Cat.admission: You enter based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is the whole admission average. There is no exam at the faculty.

uat-tgmures|Facultatea de Arte în Limba.name: Faculty of Arts in Hungarian
uat-tgmures|Facultatea de Arte în Limba.about: Here you study in Hungarian the same arts as at the faculty in Romanian: acting, puppets-marionettes, directing, choreography, theatre studies, stage design, music and audiovisual communication (here also with film studies). The faculty also has a version of its website in Hungarian.
uat-tgmures|Facultatea de Arte în Limba.admission: The tests differ by specialisation. For acting, puppets-marionettes, directing, choreography, stage design and music you take aptitude tests in two stages, the first eliminatory. For theatre studies the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, a graded motivation letter and an oral exam in theatre culture count. For audiovisual communication you take a written exam in Hungarian language and literature and an oral one.

uat-tgmures|Facultatea de Arte în Limba.name: Faculty of Arts in Romanian
uat-tgmures|Facultatea de Arte în Limba.about: Here you study, in Romanian, theatre and the performing arts: acting, puppets-marionettes, directing, choreography and theatre studies. The faculty also has programmes in stage design, audiovisual communication (screenwriting, media advertising) and music.
uat-tgmures|Facultatea de Arte în Limba.admission: The tests differ by specialisation. For acting, puppets-marionettes, choreography, directing and stage design you take aptitude tests in two stages (for example musical and rhythm aptitudes, poems, monologue, improvisation, and for stage design drawing and set sketches). For audiovisual communication you have a presentation interview, for music oral music tests, and for theatre studies a colloquium on theatre culture; for these three the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average also counts.

uauim|Facultatea de Arhitectură.name: Faculty of Architecture
uauim|Facultatea de Arhitectură.about: Here you train to become an architect: the Architecture programme lasts 6 years (bachelor's and master's together) and can be followed in Romanian or in English. The faculty also has a 3-year programme, Architectural Conservation and Restoration, in Sibiu.
uauim|Facultatea de Arhitectură.admission: You take a single practical test of graphic representation (drawing), which counts the most; the rest of the average comes from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Architecture in English there is also an eliminatory English test.

uauim|Facultatea de Arhitectură de Inter.name: Faculty of Interior Architecture
uauim|Facultatea de Arhitectură de Inter.about: It is the university's newest faculty. Here you learn to design interior spaces and objects: Interior Architecture and Product Design last 5 years each (bachelor's and master's together), while Furniture and Interior Design lasts 3 years and is practice-oriented.
uauim|Facultatea de Arhitectură de Inter.admission: You take a single practical test of graphic representation (drawing), which counts the most; the rest of the average comes from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

uauim|Facultatea de Urbanism.name: Faculty of Urban Planning
uauim|Facultatea de Urbanism.about: Here you learn how cities and landscapes are planned: urban design and planning, landscape design and planning (4 years each) and urbanism and territorial administration (3 years, in Sibiu). Besides design and drawing, you study demography, urban economics, sociology and urban law. The faculty was founded in 1997.
uauim|Facultatea de Urbanism.admission: For Urban Design and Planning and for Landscape Design and Planning you take a practical test of graphic representation (drawing), which counts the most, plus the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Urbanism and Territorial Administration (Sibiu) you pass an eliminatory online interview, and the ranking is made by the bac average.

uav-arad|Facultatea de Design.name: Faculty of Design
uav-arad|Facultatea de Design.about: You study applied visual arts, in one of the programmes Design, Environmental Design (design of spaces) and Fashion – Clothing Design. The bachelor's lasts three years, and Design can also be followed in English. The faculty gives free preparation courses for admission.
uav-arad|Facultatea de Design.admission: Admission is only through aptitude tests: a folder of your works (eliminatory test), a portfolio with drawing, colour study and projects on given themes, then an interview in which you present them. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average does not count towards the final grade.

uav-arad|Facultatea de Educație Fizică ș.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
uav-arad|Facultatea de Educație Fizică ș.about: It has two bachelor's programmes: Physical Education and Sport, for those who want to be sports teachers or work in sport, and Physiotherapy and Special Motricity, where you learn recovery through movement.
uav-arad|Facultatea de Educație Fizică ș.admission: For Physical Education and Sport you take sports tests (a sprint, a standing long jump, an endurance run and an applied course), which count for more than the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade. For Physiotherapy you have an eliminatory test of motor aptitudes, then the bac average counts.

uav-arad|Facultatea de Inginerie.name: Faculty of Engineering
uav-arad|Facultatea de Inginerie.about: It trains engineers over four years, in programmes such as Automation and Applied Informatics (also in English), Road Vehicles, Machine-Building Technology, Welding Engineering and Industrial Economic Engineering. It also has a programme in the dual system, run together with companies.
uav-arad|Facultatea de Inginerie.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, with no written exam. For the dual programme you also submit a letter of intent, graded admitted/rejected, and for the programme in English you prove that you know the language.

uav-arad|Facultatea de Inginerie Aliment.name: Faculty of Food Engineering, Tourism and Environmental Protection
uav-arad|Facultatea de Inginerie Aliment.about: You learn how food is produced and checked, how the environment and the consumer are protected and how to run a business in public catering and agritourism; it also has the Nutrition and Dietetics programme. Practical work takes place in the faculty's own laboratories, including one for meat processing and one for gastronomy.
uav-arad|Facultatea de Inginerie Aliment.admission: For the engineering programmes the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts and, to a lesser extent, the grade in the compulsory exam of the profile. For Nutrition and Dietetics you take a written multiple-choice test in biology and organic chemistry, which is averaged with the bac grade.

uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe ale Educa.name: Faculty of Educational Sciences, Psychology and Social Work
uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe ale Educa.about: It prepares you to work with people: as a primary school teacher or early-years educator (Primary School Pedagogy, Early Education), with children with special needs (Special Psychopedagogy), as a psychologist (Psychology) or as a social worker (Social Work).
uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe ale Educa.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, with no written exam. For Primary School Pedagogy and Early Education you first pass an eliminatory test of communication and aptitudes, graded admitted/rejected; graduates of a pedagogical high school do not take it.

uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: It has four bachelor's programmes of three years each: Management, Accounting and Management Information Systems, Finance and Banking, and Economics of Trade, Tourism and Services. You learn how a company works, how money is recorded and how economic decisions are made.
uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, with no exam. If averages are equal, the grades in the profile exams of the bac are compared.

uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe Exacte.name: Faculty of Exact Sciences
uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe Exacte.about: You study computer science and mathematics, in the programmes Computer Science (in Romanian or in English) and Mathematics and Computer Science. The faculty organises the "Caius Iacob" mathematics and computer science competition for pupils and a fair of IT placements and traineeships for students.
uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe Exacte.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts; if averages are equal, the bac mathematics grade is compared. Winners of the "Caius Iacob" competition or of the national olympiad in mathematics or computer science receive an average of 10. For the programme in English you prove that you know the language.

uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe Umaniste.name: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe Umaniste.about: It brings together very different programmes: Romanian Language and Literature – English Language and Literature, Public Administration, Journalism, Didactic Pentecostal Theology, Music and Music Performance – Singing. Most last three years, and singing four.
uav-arad|Facultatea de Științe Umaniste.admission: For most programmes only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Music and for Music Performance – Singing you take practical tests (an eliminatory aptitude test, then solfeggio, musical ear and theory, or a recital), and the bac counts very little.

uav-arad|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.name: Faculty of Orthodox Theology "Ilarion V. Felea"
uav-arad|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.about: It has the four-year programme Pastoral Orthodox Theology, which trains future priests, deacons and, with the pedagogical module, religion teachers. You study the Bible, the teaching and history of the Church, services and church music.
uav-arad|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.admission: At the faculty you have a motivation interview, graded admitted/rejected, which checks musical and diction aptitudes and knowledge of dogmatic theology. If you pass it, the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. The file is submitted at the faculty's secretariat.

ub-bacau|Facultatea de Inginerie.name: Faculty of Engineering
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Inginerie.about: A faculty with 4-year engineering programmes: information technology, mechatronics, robotics, energetics, machine building, environmental protection, food engineering, biochemical engineering and others. Some programmes can also be followed in the dual system. The faculty has operated since 1976.
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Inginerie.admission: Admission is a file-based competition, without a written test: the admission average is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years.

ub-bacau|Facultatea de Litere.name: Faculty of Letters
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Litere.about: Here you study Romanian, English or French language and literature, Communication and Public Relations, or train to be a primary school teacher or early-years educator (Primary School Pedagogy, Early Education). All bachelor's programmes last 3 years, in full-time courses.
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Litere.admission: The admission average is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years. For languages and literatures you also take an eliminatory test of language skills, and for pedagogy and early education an eliminatory aptitude test (motivation essay and drawing); for communication you have no other test.

ub-bacau|Facultatea de Științe.name: Faculty of Sciences
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Științe.about: The faculty has three bachelor's programmes, each of 3 years: Mathematics, Computer Science and Biology. In Computer Science you learn, among other things, software development, artificial intelligence and systems security; this programme can also be followed part-time.
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Științe.admission: There is no exam: the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which weighs more, and the average of the high-school years.

ub-bacau|Facultatea de Științe ale Mișcă.name: Faculty of Movement, Sport and Health Sciences
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Științe ale Mișcă.about: The faculty deals with physical education and sport, sports performance, physiotherapy and occupational therapy. The 3-year bachelor's programmes are Physical Education and Sport, Sport and Motor Performance, Physiotherapy and Special Motricity, and Occupational Therapy.
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Științe ale Mișcă.admission: For Physical Education and for Sport and Motor Performance you pass an eliminatory assessment of functional indices and take a psychomotor aptitude test, which is added to the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Physiotherapy the bac average and the average of the high-school years count, plus an eliminatory applied course. For Occupational Therapy only the two averages count.

ub-bacau|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you study Business Administration, Accounting and Management Information Systems or Marketing; each programme lasts 3 years. Accounting can also be followed part-time, and Marketing also by distance learning. Graduates can work, for example, as entrepreneurs, accountants or marketing specialists.
ub-bacau|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: There is no exam: the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which weighs more, and the average of the high-school years.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Biologie și Geolo.name: Faculty of Biology and Geology
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Biologie și Geolo.about: Here you study biology, biochemistry, ecology and environmental protection, industrial biotechnology, geology or geological engineering. The faculty provides the scientific coordination of the university's museums of zoology, botany, mineralogy and palaeontology and of the Vivarium. Some programmes are also taught in Hungarian.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Biologie și Geolo.admission: For the programmes in Romanian and for Geology you submit a motivation letter (admitted/rejected) and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Biology and Ecology in Hungarian, the bac average and a multiple-choice test count in equal parts. Results from the faculty's competitions can be used instead of these.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Business.name: Faculty of Business
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Business.about: Here you learn how a business is run: the programmes are Business Administration and Business Administration in Hospitality Services (hotels, restaurants, tourism). It is taught in Romanian and English, in Cluj-Napoca, and Business Administration can also be followed in Bistrița, in Romanian.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Business.admission: You write a motivation essay in the language of the programme you chose, graded admitted or rejected, and the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If you take part in the faculty's knowledge competition and get a good grade, you receive a bonus on your average.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Chimie și Inginer.name: Faculty of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Chimie și Inginer.about: Here you study chemistry (including pharmaceutical chemistry) or chemical engineering, from food chemistry to biochemical engineering and nanosciences. The chemistry programmes last three years, and the engineering ones and the double specialisation Chemistry-Physics four years; some are also taught in Hungarian.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Chimie și Inginer.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts above all, to which is added, with a smaller weight, a multiple-choice test in a subject chosen by you. The grade from the "Candin Liteanu" competition can, on request, replace the admission average.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Drept.about: Here you study law for four years: civil, criminal and administrative law and the other branches you need for the legal professions. The faculty has two departments, public law and private law, and can be followed full-time or by distance learning.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Drept.admission: The admission average is made up in equal parts of a test of logical reasoning and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Educație Fizică ș.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Educație Fizică ș.about: Here you train to become a physical education teacher, a coach or a physiotherapist. The programmes are taught in Romanian and Hungarian in Cluj-Napoca; Physical Education and Sport can also be followed in Bistrița and Reșița, in Romanian.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Educație Fizică ș.admission: For Physical Education and Sport, the admission average is the grade from an applied course that checks your motor aptitudes. For Physiotherapy, the course is graded only admitted or rejected, and the average is the grade from a multiple-choice test in Biology.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Fizică.name: Faculty of Physics
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Fizică.about: Here you study physics, computational physics, medical physics or technological physics, in Romanian or Hungarian. Students work in laboratories alongside professors and researchers, and practical work is also done at partner companies and hospitals.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Fizică.admission: The admission average is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade (the overall average or the grade in physics, computer science or mathematics, of your choice) and the grade from a written Physics test, based on the bac syllabus. There is also an alternative route through the "Augustin Maior" physics competition and olympiads.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Geografie.name: Faculty of Geography
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Geografie.about: Here you study geography, tourism geography, cartography, spatial planning or hydrology and meteorology, with practical work in the field and in institutions. The seat is in Cluj-Napoca, and Tourism Geography can also be followed in Bistrița, Gheorgheni, Sighetu Marmației and Zalău. Some programmes also have a line in Hungarian.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Geografie.admission: You submit a motivation letter, graded admitted or rejected, and the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. Winners of the geography olympiad and of certain competitions receive the maximum average.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Inginerie.name: Faculty of Engineering
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Inginerie.about: The faculty is not in Cluj-Napoca but in Reșița, at the UBB Reșița University Centre. Here you study for four years mechanical engineering, electromechanics, informatics applied in electrical engineering or industrial informatics, in Romanian. Some programmes can also be followed in the dual system, with practical work at partner companies.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Inginerie.admission: You write a motivation letter, graded admitted or rejected. The admission average is the average of the grades from the second and third written exams of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) (the profile exam and the exam of your choice).

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Istorie și Filoso.name: Faculty of History and Philosophy
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Istorie și Filoso.about: Here you study history, archaeology, art history, archival studies, philosophy, ethnology, cultural tourism, international relations and European studies, or security studies. Most programmes are taught in Romanian and Hungarian, and Security Studies also in English.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Istorie și Filoso.admission: You write a motivation letter in the language of the programme you chose, graded admitted or rejected, and the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. Prizes from olympiads and specialist competitions can bring advantages.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Litere.name: Faculty of Letters
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Litere.about: Here you study languages and literatures, usually two at a time: Romanian, Hungarian, English, French, German, Nordic languages, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Latin and others. You can also choose comparative literature, applied modern languages or, in Hungarian, ethnology and cultural studies.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Litere.admission: You include in your file a letter of intent (this is the "aptitude test"), graded admitted or rejected. The admission average is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the average of the high-school years.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Matematică și Inf.name: Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Matematică și Inf.about: Here you study mathematics, computer science, artificial intelligence or information engineering. The programmes last three or four years and are taught in Romanian, Hungarian, German or English, depending on the specialisation.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Matematică și Inf.admission: The admission average is the grade from a written multiple-choice test, which you take in Mathematics or in Computer Science, of your choice. Very good results at olympiads or at the Mate-Info UBB Competition can bring advantages.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Psihologie și Ști.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Psihologie și Ști.about: Here you study psychology, special psychopedagogy, pedagogy or train to become a primary school teacher or early-years educator. The programmes are taught in Romanian, Hungarian, German or English, depending on the specialisation. Primary School Pedagogy can also be followed in Năsăud, Sighetu Marmației, Târgu Mureș, Satu Mare, Odorheiu Secuiesc and Reșița.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Psihologie și Ști.admission: It differs by programme: for Psychology (Romanian and English), the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and a written test of cognitive abilities count in equal parts; for Special Psychopedagogy, the bac and an essay; for the Hungarian lines of these programmes, an oral test counts above all, alongside the bac. For Pedagogy and for the programmes for primary school teachers and early-years educators the ranking is made by the bac average, with an essay or an oral test graded admitted/rejected.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Sociologie și Asi.name: Faculty of Sociology and Social Work
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Sociologie și Asi.about: Here you study sociology, anthropology, human resources or social work, that is, how society works and how people in difficulty can be helped. In Cluj-Napoca the programmes are taught in Romanian and Hungarian; Social Work can also be followed in Reșița, in Romanian.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Sociologie și Asi.admission: You send a motivation letter, graded admitted or rejected, and the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. Participants and winners of the faculty's competitions or of olympiads have advantages.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Studii Europene.name: Faculty of European Studies
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Studii Europene.about: Here you study international relations and European studies, business diplomacy, management or European administration. The programme International Relations and European Studies is taught in Romanian, English or German.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Studii Europene.admission: You submit a motivation letter online, graded admitted or rejected; for the lines in English and German you write it in that language and also take an online interview in that language. The admission average is the average of two grades from the written exams of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), chosen by you.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Știința și Ingine.name: Faculty of Environmental Science and Engineering
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Știința și Ingine.about: Here you learn how the environment is studied and protected: environmental science, environmental management and audit, or environmental engineering. Environmental Science can also be followed in Hungarian, in Cluj-Napoca and in Sfântu Gheorghe.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Știința și Ingine.admission: You write a motivation essay, graded admitted or rejected, and the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. A good result in the faculty's Enviro-Pass competition or at olympiads can raise your admission average.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economics and Business Administration
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you study economics and business: accounting, finance and banking, management, marketing, economic informatics, statistics and data science, international business. The programmes are taught in Romanian, Hungarian, German or English, in Cluj-Napoca, and some also in Sfântu Gheorghe, Sighetu Marmației and Reșița.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: At enrolment you submit a handwritten paper on an economic topic (a presentation with a graphic representation), graded admitted or rejected. The ranking is then made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Științe Medicale.name: Faculty of Medical and Health Sciences
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Științe Medicale.about: Here you study four-year health programmes, in Romanian: Podiatry (foot care), in Cluj-Napoca, and Medical Engineering, which takes place in Reșița and is organised by the Faculty of Engineering. The faculty's seat is in Cluj-Napoca.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Științe Medicale.admission: For Podiatry a written test in Biology counts above all, alongside the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Medical Engineering you write a motivation letter (admitted/rejected), and the admission average is the average of the grades from the second and third written exams of the bac.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Științe Politice,.name: Faculty of Political, Administrative and Communication Sciences
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Științe Politice,.about: Here you study communication and public relations, journalism, advertising, digital media, public administration, public health or political science. The programmes are taught in Romanian, Hungarian, German or English, depending on the specialisation, and Public Administration can also be followed in Bistrița and Reșița.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Științe Politice,.admission: First you write a motivation letter in the language of the programme, graded admitted or rejected; for the programmes in English or German the language is also checked, by interview or written test, if you do not have a certificate. Those admitted at this stage are then ranked by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teatru și Film.name: Faculty of Theatre and Film
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teatru și Film.about: Here you study acting, theatre directing, theatre studies, film and TV directing, film cinematography, sound and editing, or film studies. The faculty has departments of theatre and of cinematography and media, in both Romanian and Hungarian.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teatru și Film.admission: It differs by programme: for Acting and Directing you take practical and oral tests in two stages (improvisation, monologue). For the film programmes a portfolio, a practical test and a written film analysis exam count; for Film Studies, an interview and the same type of written exam. For Theatre Studies the motivation letter and the interview count, and for the Romanian line also the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Greco- C.name: Faculty of Greek-Catholic Theology
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Greco- C.about: Here you study Greek-Catholic theology, in the pastoral, didactic and social work directions, in Romanian. The faculty has three departments: in Cluj-Napoca, in Blaj and in Oradea; in the last two cities only Pastoral Theology is offered.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Greco- C.admission: You write a motivation essay, graded admitted or rejected, and the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.name: Faculty of Orthodox Theology
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.about: Here you study Orthodox theology, in three directions: pastoral (for future priests), didactic and social work. The Sacred Art programme is also here, where you learn painting and church art.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.admission: It differs by programme: for Pastoral Theology you take a musical aptitude test and a vocational interview, then an oral theology test, alongside the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Didactic Theology and Social Work the bac average counts, after a vocational interview. For Sacred Art the interview with the assessment of a portfolio of works and the bac average count.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Reformat.name: Faculty of Reformed Theology and Music
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Reformat.about: Here you study, in Hungarian, didactic Reformed theology (for future religion teachers) or music. The faculty aims to train teachers for the communities of Transylvania.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Reformat.admission: For Didactic Reformed Theology you write a motivation essay (admitted/rejected), and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts together with the grade in a subject chosen by you. For Music a practical vocal test counts above all, plus the bac average, after an interview with a musical aptitude test.

ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Romano-C.name: Faculty of Roman Catholic Theology
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Romano-C.about: Here you study Roman Catholic theology, in Hungarian. Didactic Theology takes place in Cluj-Napoca and lasts three years, and Pastoral Theology takes place in Alba Iulia and lasts four years.
ubb-cluj|Facultatea de Teologie Romano-C.admission: For Didactic Theology, the admission average is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade for the motivation letter. For Pastoral Theology (Alba Iulia), instead of the letter you take an oral exam. Winners of certain olympiads and religion competitions are exempt from the test.

ucb-pitesti|Facultatea de Management, Ma.name: Faculty of Management, Marketing in Economic Affairs in Brăila
ucb-pitesti|Facultatea de Management, Ma.about: It is the university's faculty in Brăila. It has bachelor's programmes in management, accounting and management information systems and public administration. Students do specialist practical work, visit companies and public institutions and can go on Erasmus+ mobilities.
ucb-pitesti|Facultatea de Management, Ma.admission: There is no exam: the selection criterion is passing the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) and the average obtained in this exam, within the available places. You submit the enrolment file at the faculty.

ucb-pitesti|Facultatea de Management, Ma.name: Faculty of Management, Marketing in Economic Affairs in Râmnicu Vâlcea
ucb-pitesti|Facultatea de Management, Ma.about: It is the university's faculty in Râmnicu Vâlcea. It trains economists in management and accounting, and specialists in public administration and in trade, tourism and services – a field linked to the tourism of Vâlcea county. There is also a Law programme here.
ucb-pitesti|Facultatea de Management, Ma.admission: There is no exam: the selection criterion is passing the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) and the average obtained in this exam, within the available places. You submit the enrolment file at the faculty.

ucb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe Econom.name: Faculty of Economic and Legal Sciences
ucb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe Econom.about: It is the university's faculty in Pitești, formed in 2024 by merging three older faculties. It has bachelor's programmes in management (also part-time), accounting and management information systems, and law.
ucb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe Econom.admission: There is no exam: the selection criterion is passing the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) and the average obtained in this exam, within the available places. You submit the enrolment file at the faculty.

ucdc|Facultatea de Business.name: Faculty of Business
ucdc|Facultatea de Business.about: A faculty in Bucharest where you study Economics of Trade, Tourism and Services or Marketing. It prepares you for the world of business and marketing. The first programme can also be followed by distance learning.
ucdc|Facultatea de Business.admission: There is no exam: you submit your file, and places are filled in the order of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ucdc|Facultatea de Drept din Cluj- Napoc.name: Faculty of Law in Cluj-Napoca
ucdc|Facultatea de Drept din Cluj- Napoc.about: The law faculty of the university that operates in Cluj-Napoca. You study Law for 4 years, in full-time or distance courses. The faculty has existed since 1991.
ucdc|Facultatea de Drept din Cluj- Napoc.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: the only criterion is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal for the last place, the grade from the written Romanian exam counts.

ucdc|Facultatea de Limbi și Literaturi S.name: Faculty of Foreign Languages and Literatures
ucdc|Facultatea de Limbi și Literaturi S.about: A faculty in Bucharest, founded in 1999, where you study two languages and their literatures: English together with another modern language, or Romanian together with a modern language. The languages on the website include German, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese and Russian. You do practical work at cultural institutes, translation offices, publishing houses or foreign language centres.
ucdc|Facultatea de Limbi și Literaturi S.admission: There is no exam: you submit your file, and places are filled in the order of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ucdc|Facultatea de Științe ale Educației.name: Faculty of Educational Sciences
ucdc|Facultatea de Științe ale Educației.about: A faculty in Bucharest, founded in 2011, which trains teachers for pre-university education. The bachelor's programmes are Primary School Pedagogy, which lasts 3 years, and Early Education.
ucdc|Facultatea de Științe ale Educației.admission: First you take an eliminatory oral test of communication skills and aptitudes, graded admitted or rejected. If you pass it, places are filled in the order of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ucdc|Facultatea de Științe Economice din.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences in Cluj-Napoca
ucdc|Facultatea de Științe Economice din.about: A faculty of the university in Cluj-Napoca, with the 3-year programme Accounting and Management Information Systems. You learn accounting, taxation, financial analysis and audit, as well as the computer programs used in companies. You can study full-time or by distance learning.
ucdc|Facultatea de Științe Economice din.admission: There is no exam: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal for the last place, the grade from the written Romanian exam of the bac decides. You can enrol online.

ucdc|Facultatea de Științe Juridice și A.name: Faculty of Legal and Administrative Sciences "Momcilo Luburici"
ucdc|Facultatea de Științe Juridice și A.about: A faculty in Bucharest where you study Law or Public Administration. It prepares you for the judicial system, public administration or the private sector. Law can also be followed by distance learning.
ucdc|Facultatea de Științe Juridice și A.admission: There is no exam: you submit your file, and places are filled in the order of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ucv|Departamentul pentru Pregătirea Pers.name: Department for Teacher Training
ucv|Departamentul pentru Pregătirea Pers.about: It is the university department that deals with the psychopedagogical training of future teachers. Two bachelor's programmes are also run here: Psychology and Special Psychopedagogy, that is, working with children and adults who have special learning needs.
ucv|Departamentul pentru Pregătirea Pers.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. You also include in your file a motivation letter, which receives the grade admitted or rejected.

ucv|Facultatea de Agronomie.name: Faculty of Agronomy
ucv|Facultatea de Agronomie.about: Here you learn about growing plants and working in agriculture, about forests (forestry), about land measurement and cadastre and about food quality control. The Agriculture programme can also be followed part-time.
ucv|Facultatea de Agronomie.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the Romanian grade and the grade in the compulsory exam of the profile, from the bac, are taken into account.

ucv|Facultatea de Automatică, Calculatoa.name: Faculty of Automation, Computers and Electronics
ucv|Facultatea de Automatică, Calculatoa.about: Here you learn programming and computers, automation, multimedia systems, electronics, mechatronics and robotics. The Computers programme can be followed in Romanian or in English, and the faculty has laboratories and research centres for robotics, artificial intelligence and IT security.
ucv|Facultatea de Automatică, Calculatoa.admission: For Computers you take a written multiple-choice test in mathematics, which counts the most, alongside the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average; for the version in English you also take a written language test, graded admitted or rejected. For Automation and Applied Informatics and for Mechatronics – Applied Electronics you enter based on your file, with only the bac average.

ucv|Facultatea de Autovehicule, Ingineri.name: Faculty of Automotive, Technological and Mechanical Engineering
ucv|Facultatea de Autovehicule, Ingineri.about: Here you learn how cars are designed and built, how transport and traffic are organised, how parts are manufactured and how buildings are put up. It has courses in Craiova and in Drobeta-Turnu Severin, where sea and Danube navigation is also taught. On the university's website it still appears under its old name, Faculty of Mechanics.
ucv|Facultatea de Autovehicule, Ingineri.admission: You enter based on your file: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the bac Romanian grade and the high-school mathematics average are taken into account.

ucv|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
ucv|Facultatea de Drept.about: Here you learn the laws and how justice and state institutions work. It has two directions: Law, for those who want to become lawyers, judges, prosecutors or legal advisers, and Public Administration, which takes place in Craiova and in Drobeta-Turnu Severin.
ucv|Facultatea de Drept.admission: You enter based on your file: the admission average is the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal, the Romanian grade and the grade in the compulsory exam of the profile are taken into account.

ucv|Facultatea de Economie și Administra.name: Faculty of Economics and Business Administration
ucv|Facultatea de Economie și Administra.about: Here you learn how companies and money work: accounting, finance and banking, management, marketing, international business and economic informatics. Some programmes can also be followed by distance learning or in English, and a few are also held in Drobeta-Turnu Severin.
ucv|Facultatea de Economie și Administra.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If you choose a programme taught in English, you must also prove that you know the language, with a grade of admitted or rejected.

ucv|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Spo.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
ucv|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Spo.about: Here you train to be a sports teacher, a coach or fitness instructor, or a physiotherapist, that is, the specialist who helps people regain movement after accidents or illnesses. Courses take place in Craiova and in Drobeta-Turnu Severin.
ucv|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Spo.admission: For Physical Education and Sport you take a practical test, an applied course that counts the most, alongside the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Physiotherapy you take a written multiple-choice test in biology, to which the bac average is added.

ucv|Facultatea de Horticultură.name: Faculty of Horticulture
ucv|Facultatea de Horticultură.about: Here you learn about fruit trees, grapevines, vegetables and flowers, about laying out parks and gardens, about biology, environmental protection and about how food is processed. Graduates work in production, in laboratories, in research or in consultancy.
ucv|Facultatea de Horticultură.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the Romanian grade and the grade in the compulsory exam of the profile, from the bac, are taken into account.

ucv|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică și.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Power Engineering
ucv|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică și.about: Here you learn about electrical machines and installations, about energy production and transmission, about computers used in electrical engineering and about aircraft equipment. On its own website and in the admission documents it still appears under the name Faculty of Electrical Engineering.
ucv|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică și.admission: You enter based on your file: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal, the bac Romanian grade is taken into account.

ucv|Facultatea de Litere.name: Faculty of Letters
ucv|Facultatea de Litere.about: Here you study Romanian language and literature, foreign languages (English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Latin) and translation. Communication and public relations, training of primary school teachers and early-years educators, music, acting and cinematography are also studied here. Some programmes are also held in Drobeta-Turnu Severin.
ucv|Facultatea de Litere.admission: For languages and communication the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts; for languages you also submit a letter of intent. For the programmes for primary school teachers and early-years educators there is first an eliminatory oral test, then the bac average.
