For music, acting and cinematography you take practical aptitude tests.

ucv|Facultatea de Științe.name: Faculty of Sciences
ucv|Facultatea de Științe.about: Here you study mathematics, computer science and artificial intelligence, physics (including medical physics), chemistry and geography. Some programmes prepare you for laboratories and research, others for IT, tourism or becoming a teacher.
ucv|Facultatea de Științe.admission: For almost all programmes you enter through a file-based competition, with only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For the programme Chemistry – Biology there is first an eliminatory oral test, then a written multiple-choice test in chemistry and biology, which counts as much as the bac average.

ucv|Facultatea de Științe Sociale.name: Faculty of Social Sciences
ucv|Facultatea de Științe Sociale.about: Here you study history, philosophy, sociology, social work, political science and international relations and European studies. Students do practical work at partner institutions, for example at the Oltenia Museum, and can go abroad to study through Erasmus+.
ucv|Facultatea de Științe Sociale.admission: For Political Science, Social Work and Sociology you enter based on your file, with only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For the programme History – Philosophy there is first an eliminatory oral test (interview), then the bac average counts.

ucv|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.name: Faculty of Orthodox Theology
ucv|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.about: Here you train to become a priest, in Pastoral Orthodox Theology, or study art: painting and sacred art, that is, painting icons and churches. Sculpture appears in the official list of programmes but is not in the current admission offer.
ucv|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.admission: First there is an eliminatory interview: for theology, musical aptitudes and knowledge of dogmatic theology are checked, and for the art programmes knowledge of religion and a folder of ten works of your own. Those admitted are then ranked by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

ueb|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
ueb|Facultatea de Drept.about: You study Law: civil, criminal, constitutional, administrative, labour, commercial and European law. Besides these there are also courses related to the environment, such as environmental law. You can study full-time, part-time or by distance learning.
ueb|Facultatea de Drept.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal for the last places, the grades from the bac exams are compared and, if needed, a motivation interview is held.

ueb|Facultatea de Ecologie și Protecția.name: Faculty of Ecology and Environmental Protection
ueb|Facultatea de Ecologie și Protecția.about: You learn how water and land ecosystems work and how they can be protected: environmental impact assessment, monitoring the state of habitats, conserving resources and environmental legislation. The programme lasts 3 years, full-time or part-time. Graduates can work as ecologists.
ueb|Facultatea de Ecologie și Protecția.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal for the last places, the grades from the bac exams are compared and, if needed, a motivation interview is held.

ueb|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Spo.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
ueb|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Spo.about: The faculty has two bachelor's programmes: Physical Education and Sport, and Physiotherapy and Special Motricity. Full-time courses last 3 years, and seminars and practical work are done in small groups.
ueb|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Spo.admission: Besides your file you take a practical test: a motor test that checks your sports aptitudes. The admission average is made up of the grade in this test and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average; top athletes are exempt from the practical test.

ueb|Facultatea de Management Financiar.name: Faculty of Financial Management
ueb|Facultatea de Management Financiar.about: Here you study Finance and Banking, a programme that combines economic theory with practical applications. It can be followed full-time or part-time.
ueb|Facultatea de Management Financiar.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal for the last places, the grades from the bac exams are compared and, if needed, a motivation interview is held.

ueb|Facultatea de Psihologie.name: Faculty of Psychology
ueb|Facultatea de Psihologie.about: You study Psychology for 3 years, full-time or part-time. The faculty emphasises applied psychology and combines research with practice.
ueb|Facultatea de Psihologie.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal for the last places, the grades from the bac exams are compared and, if needed, a motivation interview is held.

ueb|Facultatea de Științele Comunicării.name: Faculty of Communication Sciences
ueb|Facultatea de Științele Comunicării.about: You study Communication and Public Relations: forms and channels of communication, effective communication techniques and notions of research in the field. The programme lasts 3 years, full-time or part-time, and prepares you for the profession of communication and public relations specialist.
ueb|Facultatea de Științele Comunicării.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal for the last places, the grades from the bac exams are compared and, if needed, a motivation interview is held.

ulbs|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
ulbs|Facultatea de Drept.about: Here you study Law or Public Administration and prepare for careers such as judge, prosecutor, notary or legal adviser. The law school in Sibiu has an old tradition: the city's first law academy was founded in 1844.
ulbs|Facultatea de Drept.admission: Admission is a file-based competition, with online enrolment: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, for both Law and Public Administration. There is no written exam.

ulbs|Facultatea de Inginerie.name: Faculty of Engineering
ulbs|Facultatea de Inginerie.about: Here you find many branches of engineering: computers, information technology, multimedia systems, electronics, electromechanics, mechatronics, robotics, machine building, transport, economic engineering, environment and textiles. The faculty continues the Faculty of Mechanics, founded in 1976.
ulbs|Facultatea de Inginerie.admission: For Computers, Information Technology and Multimedia Systems Engineering you take a written multiple-choice test in mathematics (algebra and analysis), which counts the most, alongside the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For the other programmes it is a file-based competition: the admission average is the bac average.

ulbs|Facultatea de Litere și Arte.name: Faculty of Letters and Arts
ulbs|Facultatea de Litere și Arte.about: Here you study languages and literatures (Romanian, English, German, French, Chinese), applied modern languages, information and documentation sciences, as well as theatre: acting, choreography and theatre studies (cultural management). The faculty organises conferences and theatre and literature festivals.
ulbs|Facultatea de Litere și Arte.admission: For the language programmes the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, after a foreign language check graded admitted/rejected (usually based on the bac exam). For Information Sciences and Theatre Studies only the bac average counts. For Acting and Choreography you take aptitude tests, the first eliminatory, and their grade counts the most.

ulbs|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
ulbs|Facultatea de Medicină.about: Here you train to become a doctor, a dentist, a pharmacist, a nurse, a dental technician or a medical rehabilitation specialist (balneology and physiotherapy). Medicine and Dental Medicine can also be studied in English.
ulbs|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: For the programmes in Romanian you enter through a written multiple-choice exam: Biology and Chemistry for Medicine and Dental Medicine, Chemistry for Pharmacy, Biology for General Nursing, Balneology and Physiotherapy, and Dental Technology. For Medicine and Dental Medicine in English you need a language certificate or take an eliminatory English test, then take an interview in English in Biology and Chemistry.

ulbs|Facultatea de Științe.name: Faculty of Sciences
ulbs|Facultatea de Științe.about: Here you study mathematics and computer science, biology, ecology and environmental protection, or physical education and sport. The faculty has research centres and publishes its own scientific journals.
ulbs|Facultatea de Științe.admission: For Mathematics and Computer Science, Computer Science, Biology and Ecology it is a file-based competition, by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Physical Education and Sport and for Sport and Motor Performance you take practical tests (an eliminatory test in a sports game and a competition test), which count the most, alongside the bac average.

ulbs|Facultatea de Științe Agricole, Ind.name: Faculty of Agricultural Sciences, Food Industry and Environmental Protection
ulbs|Facultatea de Științe Agricole, Ind.about: Here you learn how food is produced and controlled, how to run a business in public catering and agritourism, how the environment is protected in agriculture and how to work in the mountain area (mountain agriculture).
ulbs|Facultatea de Științe Agricole, Ind.admission: The admission average is entirely the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There are no additional written tests.

ulbs|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
ulbs|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you study economics and business: management, marketing, finance and banking, accounting and management information systems, business administration, economic informatics, trade, tourism and services. Some programmes are taught in English.
ulbs|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: The admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average; there is no written exam. If you choose a programme in English, you also pass an eliminatory language proficiency test, graded admitted/rejected.

ulbs|Facultatea de Științe Socio- Umane.name: Faculty of Social and Human Sciences
ulbs|Facultatea de Științe Socio- Umane.about: A faculty with many directions: psychology, primary school pedagogy, sociology, social work, human resources, journalism, communication and public relations, history, heritage, conservation and restoration, political science, international relations, security studies and Protestant theology.
ulbs|Facultatea de Științe Socio- Umane.admission: For most programmes it is a file-based competition, by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Psychology you take a written test of cognitive abilities. For Primary School Pedagogy you pass eliminatory aptitude tests (music, drawing, motor coordination, diction) and a written test. For Conservation and Restoration you have an interview with a folder of works.

ulbs|Facultatea de Teologie.name: Faculty of Theology
ulbs|Facultatea de Teologie.about: The Orthodox theology faculty of the university in Sibiu, named "Saint Andrei Șaguna". Here you study Pastoral Orthodox Theology, for those who want to become priests, or Religious Music.
ulbs|Facultatea de Teologie.admission: For Pastoral Theology you first pass an interview graded admitted/rejected (musical aptitudes and knowledge of theology), then the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Religious Music you also take a test of musical knowledge and aptitudes, which counts alongside the bac average. You need the bishop's blessing.

umc|Facultatea de Electromecanică Navală.name: Faculty of Naval Electromechanics
umc|Facultatea de Electromecanică Navală.about: The faculty trains engineers for merchant ships and related fields. Besides Naval Electromechanics and Electrical Engineering (which are also offered in English), it has programmes in electric power systems, telecommunications, environmental protection in industry and cyber security.
umc|Facultatea de Electromecanică Navală.admission: You take no exam: you enter with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For tuition-free places the bac average counts for the most part and, to a smaller extent, your mathematics grade from the bac. For the programmes in English an English test or a language certificate is also required.

umc|Facultatea de Navigație și Transport.name: Faculty of Navigation and Naval Transport
umc|Facultatea de Navigație și Transport.about: Here you train to work on board merchant ships or in transport and logistics. The bachelor's programmes are Navigation and Maritime and River Transport (also in English) and Engineering and Management in Transport. The faculty uses navigation simulators and a nautical base for practical work.
umc|Facultatea de Navigație și Transport.admission: You take no exam: you enter with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For tuition-free places the bac average counts for the most part and, to a smaller extent, your mathematics grade from the bac. For the programmes in English an English test or a language certificate is also required.

umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Asistență.name: Faculty of Nursing
umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Asistență.about: Here you train for medical careers such as general nurse, midwife, physiotherapist or dental technician. On the university's website the faculty is called "Faculty of Midwifery and Nursing". You study anatomy, physiology, ethics and communication and do practical work in hospitals and maternity hospitals.
umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Asistență.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without a written exam. The admission average is the average of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the overall average of the high-school years; if averages are equal, the bac average counts.

umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Farmacie.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Farmacie.about: Here you train to become a pharmacist, over five years of study: pharmaceutical chemistry, biochemistry, pharmacology, pharmaceutical technology. The faculty also has the Nutrition and Dietetics programme. Students work in laboratories and can join research projects.
umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Farmacie.admission: You take a written multiple-choice exam. For Pharmacy, the compulsory subject is Organic Chemistry, and you choose the second between Plant Biology and Human Anatomy and Physiology. For Nutrition and Dietetics, the exam is only in Biology.
examSubjects: Plant biology or Human anatomy and physiology (your choice)

umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Medicină.about: Here you train to become a doctor, over six years of study. You start with basic subjects such as anatomy, physiology and biochemistry, then move on to clinical training, in hospitals. The faculty has a tradition that begins in 1867.
umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: You take a written multiple-choice exam: Biology is the compulsory subject, and you choose the second subject between Physics and Chemistry.

umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Stomatolo.name: Faculty of Dental Medicine
umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Stomatolo.about: Here you train to become a dentist (stomatologist), over six years of study. Besides the medical subjects, you also learn about ethics, communication and how to run a practice. From the first semesters you do practical exercises in a simulated clinical environment.
umf-carol-davila|Facultatea de Stomatolo.admission: You take a written multiple-choice exam: Biology is the compulsory subject, and you choose the second subject between Physics and Chemistry.

umf-cluj|Facultatea de Asistență Medical.name: Faculty of Nursing and Health Sciences
umf-cluj|Facultatea de Asistență Medical.about: The faculty trains specialists who work alongside doctors. The General Nursing programme lasts four years and is offered in Cluj-Napoca and in Baia Mare. The other programmes last three years: Balneology, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation, Radiology and Imaging, Dental Technology, Nutrition and Dietetics, Medical Cosmetics and Cosmetic Product Technology.
umf-cluj|Facultatea de Asistență Medical.admission: For these programmes there is no written exam: admission is through an assessment of school performance. The admission grade is the average of the grades obtained in high school and the final Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade.

umf-cluj|Facultatea de Farmacie.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
umf-cluj|Facultatea de Farmacie.about: Here you learn how medicines are made, checked and used correctly. The Pharmacy bachelor's programme lasts five years and is taught in Romanian and French. The faculty also has a research centre that monitors the safety of medicines (pharmacovigilance).
umf-cluj|Facultatea de Farmacie.admission: For the programme in Romanian you take a written multiple-choice exam, in biology or organic chemistry. For the programme in French, admission is through an assessment of school results and personal achievements.

umf-cluj|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
umf-cluj|Facultatea de Medicină.about: Here you train to become a doctor. The Medicine programme lasts six years and is taught in Romanian, English and French; there is also a programme in English held in Novara, Italy, and a military medicine programme. After the bachelor's comes the residency, in which you choose your specialty.
umf-cluj|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: For the programme in Romanian you take a two-hour written multiple-choice exam in biology and organic chemistry. For the programmes in English and French, admission is through an assessment of school results and personal achievements.

umf-cluj|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.name: Faculty of Dental Medicine
umf-cluj|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.about: Here you train to become a dentist. The Dental Medicine programme lasts six years and has three study lines: in Romanian, in English and in French. After the bachelor's you can continue with a residency, a master's or a doctorate.
umf-cluj|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.admission: For the programme in Romanian you take a two-hour written multiple-choice exam in biology and organic chemistry. For the programmes in English and French, admission is through an assessment of school results and personal achievements.

umf-craiova|Facultatea de Asistență Medi.name: Faculty of Nursing
umf-craiova|Facultatea de Asistență Medi.about: It is the university's newest faculty, founded in 2008; however, nurses have been trained in Craiova since 1999. It has four bachelor's programmes: General Nursing, which lasts four years, and Balneology, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation, Radiology and Imaging, and Nutrition and Dietetics, three years each.
umf-craiova|Facultatea de Asistență Medi.admission: You take a written multiple-choice exam in biology (human anatomy and physiology). The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade does not count towards the admission average; it is used only as a tie-breaker when averages are equal.

umf-craiova|Facultatea de Farmacie.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
umf-craiova|Facultatea de Farmacie.about: The faculty was founded in 1996. It has two bachelor's programmes: Pharmacy, five years, in which you learn about medicines and how they are correctly prepared and dispensed, and Medical Cosmetics and Cosmetic Product Technology, three years. The lecture halls were recently modernised, and the laboratories have modern equipment.
umf-craiova|Facultatea de Farmacie.admission: You take a written multiple-choice exam. For Pharmacy there are two tests on the same day, organic chemistry and biology (your choice of human anatomy and physiology or botany); chemistry weighs more. For Medical Cosmetics there is a single test, in biology. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade counts only as a tie-breaker.
examSubjects: Biology (Human anatomy and physiology or Botany)

umf-craiova|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
umf-craiova|Facultatea de Medicină.about: Here you train to become a doctor: the Medicine programme lasts six years. The year has two semesters, with written or oral exams in each subject, and at the end you take the bachelor's exam. After graduating you can continue with a residency, a master's or a doctorate.
umf-craiova|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: For the programme in Romanian you take a written multiple-choice exam, with two tests on the same day: biology (human anatomy and physiology), which weighs the most, and organic chemistry. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade does not count towards the admission average; it is used only as a tie-breaker. For the programme in English there is no exam: the file is scored (high-school and bac grades and a motivation essay).

umf-craiova|Facultatea de Stomatologie.name: Faculty of Dental Medicine
umf-craiova|Facultatea de Stomatologie.about: The faculty has two bachelor's programmes: Dental Medicine, six years, in Romanian or in English, from which you graduate as a dentist, and Dental Technology, three years, in which you learn to make dental work in the laboratory. Both basic medical subjects and prosthodontics, endodontics, orthodontics, implantology and oral surgery are studied.
umf-craiova|Facultatea de Stomatologie.admission: For Dental Medicine in Romanian you take a written multiple-choice exam, with two tests on the same day: biology (human anatomy and physiology), which weighs the most, and organic chemistry. For Dental Technology there is a single test, in biology. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade counts only as a tie-breaker. For Dental Medicine in English there is no exam: the file is scored (high-school and bac grades and a motivation essay).

umf-iasi|Facultatea de Bioinginerie Medi.name: Faculty of Medical Bioengineering
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Bioinginerie Medi.about: It links engineering with medicine: you can study Bioengineering, Balneology, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation, or Audiology and Hearing Aid Fitting. The faculty was founded in 1994 and trains specialists who help diagnose, treat and rehabilitate patients.
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Bioinginerie Medi.admission: You enter through a competition with a single test, a multiple-choice test. For Bioengineering you choose between Mathematics and Human Anatomy and Physiology; for Balneology and Physiotherapy and for Audiology the test is in Human Anatomy and Physiology.

umf-iasi|Facultatea de Farmacie.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Farmacie.about: It trains pharmacists and also has the programmes Medical Cosmetics and Cosmetic Product Technology and Medical Chemistry. It is part of the medical university in Iași and offers, besides the bachelor's, a master's, a doctorate and a residency.
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Farmacie.admission: You enter through a competition with a written test, an eliminatory multiple-choice test: you need at least a grade of 5. For Pharmacy the test is in Organic Chemistry (compulsory) and, of your choice, Plant Biology or Human Anatomy and Physiology. For Medical Cosmetics and Medical Chemistry you choose a single subject out of these three. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average does not count towards the grade; it is used only as a tie-breaker.

umf-iasi|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Medicină.about: Here you learn to become a doctor. The faculty has existed since 1879, and students do practical work in the university hospitals of Iași. After the bachelor's you can continue with a residency and a doctorate.
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: You enter through a competition with a written test, an eliminatory multiple-choice test: you need at least a grade of 5. The test is in Human Anatomy and Physiology (compulsory) and, of your choice, Organic Chemistry or Physics. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average does not count towards the grade; it is used only as a tie-breaker.

umf-iasi|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.name: Faculty of Dental Medicine
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.about: It trains dentists, with the Dental Medicine programme in Romanian, French and English, and also has the programmes Dental Technology and Dental Prophylaxis Assistance. It started in 1945 as a section of the Faculty of Medicine and has been a faculty in its own right since 1965.
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.admission: You enter through a competition with a written test, an eliminatory multiple-choice test: you need at least a grade of 5. For Dental Medicine the test is in Human Anatomy and Physiology (compulsory) and, of your choice, Organic Chemistry or Physics. For Dental Technology and for Dental Prophylaxis Assistance you choose a single subject: Human Anatomy and Physiology or Organic Chemistry. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average does not count towards the grade; it is used only as a tie-breaker.

umf-iasi|Facultatea de Științe ale Sănăt.name: Faculty of Health Sciences
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Științe ale Sănăt.about: A new faculty, split off from the Faculty of Medicine. Here you study General Nursing, Nutrition and Dietetics or Radiology and Imaging, that is, careers in the medical team alongside the doctor.
umf-iasi|Facultatea de Științe ale Sănăt.admission: You enter through a competition with a written test, an eliminatory multiple-choice test: you need at least a grade of 5. For all three programmes you choose a single subject: Human Anatomy and Physiology or Organic Chemistry. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average does not count towards the grade; it is used only as a tie-breaker.

umfst|Facultatea de Economie și Drept.name: Faculty of Economics and Law
umfst|Facultatea de Economie și Drept.about: You study law, public administration or economics: accounting and management information systems, finance and banking, management, economics of trade, tourism and services. Law is also offered in Bistrița, and some programmes also have a distance-learning variant.
umfst|Facultatea de Economie și Drept.admission: There is no exam: the average of the high-school years (grades 9–11) counts, and the high-school average in a subject related to the programme, for example Romanian, history, mathematics or economics for Law and mathematics or computer science for the economics programmes.

umfst|Facultatea de Farmacie.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
umfst|Facultatea de Farmacie.about: Besides Pharmacy, the faculty has programmes in medical chemistry, technological chemistry, medical cosmetics, nutrition and dietetics and pharmacy assistance (in Bistrița). You learn how medicines and cosmetic products are made, checked and used.
umfst|Facultatea de Farmacie.admission: For Pharmacy you take a multiple-choice test in organic chemistry, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts a little. For cosmetics, nutrition and pharmacy assistance only the bac average counts. For the chemistry programmes the averages of the high-school years count, including in chemistry.

umfst|Facultatea de Inginerie și Tehnolo.name: Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology
umfst|Facultatea de Inginerie și Tehnolo.about: It trains engineers and computer scientists: automation and applied informatics, energetics, machine building, medical engineering, economic engineering, computer science (also in Hungarian) and architecture. Many programmes also have a dual variant.
umfst|Facultatea de Inginerie și Tehnolo.admission: For most programmes there is no exam: the average of the high-school years (grades 9–11) counts, and the high-school average in mathematics or, depending on the programme, in computer science or biology. For Architecture in English you take a practical drawing test and an eliminatory English test, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average is added to the grade of the drawing test.

umfst|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
umfst|Facultatea de Medicină.about: Here you become a doctor, a general nurse or a medical rehabilitation specialist (balneology and physiotherapy). General Nursing is also offered in Bistrița.
umfst|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: For Medicine you take a written test, a multiple-choice test in biology or chemistry, of your choice; its grade weighs the most, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average a little. For nursing and balneology and physiotherapy there is no exam: only the bac average counts.

umfst|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.name: Faculty of Dental Medicine
umfst|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.about: It trains dentists and dental technicians. Dental Medicine can also be followed in English, and dental technology takes place in Târgu Mureș and in Bistrița.
umfst|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.admission: For Dental Medicine you take a written test, a multiple-choice test in biology or chemistry, of your choice; its grade weighs the most, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average a little. For Dental Technology there is no exam: only the bac average counts.

umfst|Facultatea de Studii Medicale Inte.name: Faculty of International Medical Studies
umfst|Facultatea de Studii Medicale Inte.about: It is the faculty in which medicine is taught in foreign languages, for students from several countries: Medicine in English in Târgu Mureș and at the Hamburg campus (UMCH) and, more recently, Medicine in French in Târgu Mureș. All last six years.
umfst|Facultatea de Studii Medicale Inte.admission: There is no multiple-choice test as for medicine in Romanian: you submit your file online, it is assessed according to the criteria in the faculty's methodology, then you are scheduled for an online interview.

umfst|Facultatea de Științe și Litere „P.name: Faculty of Sciences and Letters "Petru Maior"
umfst|Facultatea de Științe și Litere „P.about: It has humanities and social programmes: history, languages and literatures, applied modern languages, communication and public relations, security studies, psychology, primary school pedagogy and physical education and sport.
umfst|Facultatea de Științe și Litere „P.admission: For most programmes the average of the high-school years counts and the high-school average in Romanian, history or a foreign language, depending on the programme. For letters, modern languages and pedagogy you also take an eliminatory oral communication test. For physical education the sports tests decide, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts a little.

umft|Facultatea de Asistență Medicală.name: Faculty of Nursing
umft|Facultatea de Asistență Medicală.about: It is a new faculty: its establishment was approved in 2024, for the 2024-2025 academic year. Here you train to become a general nurse (4 years, in Timișoara, Lugoj or Deva), or a specialist in balneology, physiotherapy and rehabilitation or in nutrition and dietetics (3 years each).
umft|Facultatea de Asistență Medicală.admission: You take a multiple-choice test in biology. The admission average is the average of the test grade and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

umft|Facultatea de Farmacie.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
umft|Facultatea de Farmacie.about: Here you learn to become a pharmacist: the Pharmacy programme lasts 5 years and can be followed in Romanian, French or English. The faculty also has 3-year programmes: Medical Cosmetics and Cosmetic Product Technology and Pharmacy Assistance.
umft|Facultatea de Farmacie.admission: You take a multiple-choice test in biology. The admission average is the average of the test grade and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Pharmacy in French or English, admission is handled separately, through the International section of the website.

umft|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
umft|Facultatea de Medicină.about: Here you train to become a doctor: studies last 6 years and can be followed in Romanian, English or French. It is the faculty with the most students and teachers in the university.
umft|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: You take a multiple-choice test with questions in biology and chemistry; the admission average is calculated only from the test score. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average is used only as a tie-breaker, when two candidates have the same average.

umft|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.name: Faculty of Dental Medicine
umft|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.about: Here you train to become a dentist: Dental Medicine lasts 6 years and can be followed in Romanian or English. The faculty also has two 3-year programmes: Dental Technology and Dental Prophylaxis Assistance.
umft|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.admission: For Dental Medicine you take a multiple-choice test in biology and chemistry, and the average is calculated from the test only. For Dental Technology and Dental Prophylaxis Assistance you take a multiple-choice test in biology, and the admission average is the average of the test grade and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

unarte|Facultatea de Arte Decorative și.name: Faculty of Decorative Arts and Design
unarte|Facultatea de Arte Decorative și.about: Here you learn the applied arts: mural art, textile arts, ceramics-glass-metal, design, fashion and stage design. In Design, for example, you work in three directions – graphic, product and environmental design – and do projects, models and prototypes.
unarte|Facultatea de Arte Decorative și.admission: You take practical tests: the first, usually drawing, is eliminatory (admitted/rejected), then for some specialisations a specialist test follows. At the end you have an interview in which you present your portfolio. The tests differ from one specialisation to another.

unarte|Facultatea de Arte Plastice.name: Faculty of Fine Arts
unarte|Facultatea de Arte Plastice.about: The faculty has departments of painting, sculpture, graphic art, photo-video and art pedagogy. In Painting, for example, you study drawing, colour and composition, easel painting techniques and computer image processing.
unarte|Facultatea de Arte Plastice.admission: You take an eliminatory test (usually drawing from life, graded admitted/rejected) and a specialist test, then an interview in which you present your portfolio. For Photography-Video the eliminatory test is a portfolio of photographs, followed by an interview.

unarte|Facultatea de Istoria și Teoria A.name: Faculty of Art History and Theory
unarte|Facultatea de Istoria și Teoria A.about: It has two directions. In Art History and Theory you study European and Romanian art from late Antiquity to today, plus museology, cultural management and curatorial studies. In Conservation and Restoration you learn to restore mural painting, painting on wood and sculpture and do practical work on restoration sites.
unarte|Facultatea de Istoria și Teoria A.admission: There are no drawing tests. The first test, eliminatory, is a letter of intent uploaded at enrolment (for Art History and Theory, together with a CV). An interview follows: for Art History based on the letter and a bibliography, for Conservation and Restoration based on a personal portfolio of works.

unatc|Facultatea de Film.name: Faculty of Film
unatc|Facultatea de Film.about: Here you learn the jobs behind a film: film and TV directing, cinematography, sound and editing, animation, photography, screenwriting and audiovisual communication. There is a lot of practical work, including on the film set.
unatc|Facultatea de Film.admission: Admission is through specialist tests, different for each programme: practical tests, an interview or a colloquium on film culture, and for some programmes written papers and a portfolio. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average does not replace the tests.

unatc|Facultatea de Teatru.name: Faculty of Theatre
unatc|Facultatea de Teatru.about: It trains people of the stage: actors, theatre directors, puppeteers, choreographers and set designers, as well as theatre scholars, that is, theatre journalists and cultural managers. Besides the bachelor's, it has many master's and doctoral programmes.
unatc|Facultatea de Teatru.admission: Admission is in stages, with different tests for each programme. For Acting, an eliminatory stage with poems and stories, then a practical test with monologues, improvisation and an interview. For Theatre Studies, an eliminatory written test, then an oral test with an interview. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts only as a tie-breaker.

unefs|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și S.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
unefs|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și S.about: The faculty trains physical education and sport teachers, coaches and sports managers. The bachelor's programmes are Physical Education and Sport, Sport and Motor Performance, Sport Management and Circus Arts. The university has teaching facilities for mountain sports in Parâng and for water sports in Eforie Nord.
unefs|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și S.admission: You first have a medical visit, then take an eliminatory practical physical education test: a general motor-skills course. For full-time programmes, the admission average is made up of the grade in this test and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade; for part-time programmes sports achievements count. For Circus Arts the course is graded only admitted/rejected, then you take tests of artistic skill and improvisation and an interview.

unefs|Facultatea de Kinetoterapie.name: Faculty of Physiotherapy
unefs|Facultatea de Kinetoterapie.about: Here you learn physiotherapy, that is, recovery through movement, in the bachelor's programme Physiotherapy and Special Motricity. On its website, the faculty presents itself as the only faculty in Romania dedicated solely to physiotherapy.
unefs|Facultatea de Kinetoterapie.admission: You first have a medical visit, then take an eliminatory practical physical education test: a general motor-skills course. The admission average is made up of the grade in this test and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade, which weighs more.

unibuc|Facultatea de Administrație și Af.name: Faculty of Administration and Business
unibuc|Facultatea de Administrație și Af.about: Here you learn how companies and public institutions work: business administration (also in English), marketing, public administration and economic cybernetics. The faculty also has programmes in Focșani and emphasises practical work and placements in companies and institutions.
unibuc|Facultatea de Administrație și Af.admission: There is no exam. The competition average is made up of the Romanian Language and Literature grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) (half) and the grade from another bac exam chosen by you (half). For the programme in English you also pass an eliminatory English test (admitted/rejected); you are exempt if you have a recognised language certificate or graduated from a bilingual English high school.

unibuc|Facultatea de Biologie.name: Faculty of Biology
unibuc|Facultatea de Biologie.about: You study the living world, from molecules and cells to organisms and ecosystems. The bachelor's programmes are Biology, Biochemistry and Ecology and Environmental Protection, and the faculty has departments of genetics, microbiology, botany, physiology and ecology.
unibuc|Facultatea de Biologie.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, with no written exam.

unibuc|Facultatea de Chimie.name: Faculty of Chemistry
unibuc|Facultatea de Chimie.about: You learn chemistry in the laboratory and in lectures, with four bachelor's programmes: Chemistry, Technological Biochemistry, Medical Chemistry and Pharmaceutical Chemistry. The subjects are also linked to biology, physics, medicine, pharmacy and materials science, and the faculty has seven research centres.
unibuc|Facultatea de Chimie.admission: There is no exam: the ranking is made only by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

unibuc|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
unibuc|Facultatea de Drept.about: Here you study law: the laws, how the state and courts work, public, private and criminal law. It is one of the university's oldest faculties and has full-time courses (also in English) and distance learning, plus research centres and student competitions.
unibuc|Facultatea de Drept.admission: You enter through an admission competition with written tests in Romanian, Economics and Critical Thinking. The faculty publishes the syllabus and bibliography every year.

unibuc|Facultatea de Filosofie.name: Faculty of Philosophy
unibuc|Facultatea de Filosofie.about: You study logic, ethics, aesthetics, epistemology, the history of ideas and the philosophy of language. In the third year you choose a module: theoretical philosophy, political and moral philosophy, or the history of philosophy and the philosophy of culture. It is one of the faculties with which the university started.
unibuc|Facultatea de Filosofie.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: you complete an admission form (graded admitted/rejected), and the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

unibuc|Facultatea de Fizică.name: Faculty of Physics
unibuc|Facultatea de Fizică.about: You learn physics in Măgurele, near the national physics research institutes. You can choose Physics (also in English), Computational Physics, Medical Physics or Technological Physics, a four-year engineering programme.
unibuc|Facultatea de Fizică.admission: You take a written test in a subject chosen by you (Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or Chemistry), which counts for more than the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, which is also taken into account. Winners of certain olympiads and competitions can be admitted directly.

unibuc|Facultatea de Geografie.name: Faculty of Geography
unibuc|Facultatea de Geografie.about: You study relief, climate, waters, cities and how people use the territory. The programmes are Geography, Tourism Geography, Environmental Geography, Cartography, Hydrology and Meteorology and Spatial Planning, with fieldwork at the university's stations; some programmes are also held in Focșani and Drobeta-Turnu Severin.
unibuc|Facultatea de Geografie.admission: You send a motivation letter (graded admitted/rejected), and the ranking is made only by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

unibuc|Facultatea de Geologie și Geofizi.name: Faculty of Geology and Geophysics
unibuc|Facultatea de Geologie și Geofizi.about: You learn about rocks, minerals, fossils and the structure of the Earth and about how underground resources are sought. The bachelor's programmes are Geology, Geophysics and Geological Engineering, with a lot of fieldwork, sometimes together with companies in the field.
unibuc|Facultatea de Geologie și Geofizi.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: only the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts.

unibuc|Facultatea de Istorie.name: Faculty of History
unibuc|Facultatea de Istorie.about: You study history from Antiquity to today, archaeology, the history of Romania and the history of international relations. Besides History, the faculty has the programmes Art History and International Relations and European Studies.
unibuc|Facultatea de Istorie.admission: You write a letter of intent (graded admitted/rejected) in which you introduce yourself and explain why you chose the programme, and the ranking is made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

unibuc|Facultatea de Jurnalism și Științ.name: Faculty of Journalism and Communication Sciences
unibuc|Facultatea de Jurnalism și Științ.about: You train for the print press, radio, television and online, for public relations or advertising. The bachelor's programmes are Journalism, Communication and Public Relations and Advertising, with practical work in newsrooms and agencies and with a TV studio and media laboratories.
unibuc|Facultatea de Jurnalism și Științ.admission: You take an eliminatory written exam, which counts the most: a multiple-choice test in Romanian (vocabulary, spelling, punctuation), a creativity topic and an argumentation topic. To this are added the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the bac Romanian grade.

unibuc|Facultatea de Limbi și Literaturi.name: Faculty of Foreign Languages and Literatures
unibuc|Facultatea de Limbi și Literaturi.about: You learn one or two foreign languages, with their literature and culture, from English, French and German to Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean or Swedish. You can also choose Translation and Interpreting, Applied Modern Languages, American Studies or Jewish Studies.
unibuc|Facultatea de Limbi și Literaturi.admission: Admission is based on your file. Depending on the department, either the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, or a mixed average: the grade from the written Romanian exam of the bac and the high-school averages in the foreign language. Check the rule for your department in the faculty's guide.

unibuc|Facultatea de Litere.name: Faculty of Letters
unibuc|Facultatea de Litere.about: You study Romanian language and literature together with a foreign language, or choose programmes such as Universal and Comparative Literature, Communication and Public Relations, Information and Documentation Sciences, European Studies, Ethnology or Managerial and Administrative Assistance.
unibuc|Facultatea de Litere.admission: Admission is a file-based competition, without an exam: the admission average is the average of the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the written Romanian Language and Literature exam of the bac.

unibuc|Facultatea de Matematică și Infor.name: Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science
unibuc|Facultatea de Matematică și Infor.about: You study mathematics, computer science (also in English) or Computers and Information Technology, a four-year programme. The faculty has laboratories for databases, networks, software development, mobile applications and robotics.
unibuc|Facultatea de Matematică și Infor.admission: For full-time courses you take a written test with two topics: one in Mathematics, compulsory, and one specialist topic (usually Computer Science; for Computers you can choose Physics, and for Mathematics a second mathematics topic). The score from the test and from olympiads and school competitions counts the most; the rest is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Computer Science by distance learning an oral test is taken instead of the written one.
examSubjects: Physics (only for Computers and Information Technology)

unibuc|Facultatea de Psihologie și Știin.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
unibuc|Facultatea de Psihologie și Știin.about: Here you study psychology (including Psychology – Cognitive Science, also in English) or train to work in education: Pedagogy, Special Psychopedagogy, Primary School Pedagogy and Early Education. Some programmes are also held in Focșani.
unibuc|Facultatea de Psihologie și Știin.admission: It differs by programme. For Psychology you take a written multiple-choice test of critical thinking, with no bibliography. For Pedagogy and Special Psychopedagogy the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Primary School Pedagogy and Early Education you pass an eliminatory aptitude test, then the bac average counts.

unibuc|Facultatea de Sociologie și Asist.name: Faculty of Sociology and Social Work
unibuc|Facultatea de Sociologie și Asist.about: You learn how society works and how people in difficulty can be helped. The programmes are Sociology (also in English), Human Resources and Social Work, with practical work in public institutions and non-governmental organisations.
unibuc|Facultatea de Sociologie și Asist.admission: You write a motivation essay (graded admitted/rejected). Then, for full-time courses, the average is made up of the bac Romanian grade and the grade from another bac exam chosen by you, in equal parts; for distance learning the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts.

unibuc|Facultatea de Studii Interdiscipl.name: Faculty of Interdisciplinary Studies
unibuc|Facultatea de Studii Interdiscipl.about: It is a faculty that brings together several fields. Its bachelor's programme, Public Health Services and Policies (Public Health), combines medicine, computer science, economics, sociology, geography, public policy and management.
unibuc|Facultatea de Studii Interdiscipl.admission: For Public Health Services and Policies, admission is a file-based competition, based only on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. The Robotics programme appears in the university's documents under the Faculty of Physics, where admission has a written test and the bac average.

unibuc|Facultatea de Științe Politice.name: Faculty of Political Science
unibuc|Facultatea de Științe Politice.about: You study how political decisions are made, how states work and relations between them. The Political Science programme can be followed in Romanian, English or French, and alongside it there are Security Studies and International Relations and European Studies (in English). Practical work is part of the programme.
unibuc|Facultatea de Științe Politice.admission: You write a short, original paper on a political subject, in the language of the programme you chose, graded admitted/rejected. The ranking is then made by the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

unibuc|Facultatea de Teologie Baptistă.name: Faculty of Baptist Theology
unibuc|Facultatea de Teologie Baptistă.about: You study Christian Baptist theology together with social work: systematic theology, Christian ethics and the interpretation of the Bible. Graduates can work in churches, in education, in non-governmental organisations or in social projects.
unibuc|Facultatea de Teologie Baptistă.admission: According to the faculty's website, admission is a file-based competition with an essay on a given Christian topic; the final grade is made up of the essay grade and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, with the essay weighing more. Check the tests for your year on the admission page.

unibuc|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.name: Faculty of Orthodox Theology
unibuc|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.about: You study Orthodox theology: Pastoral Theology (a four-year programme), Didactic Theology, Theology – Social Work and Sacred Art. The full name is Faculty of Orthodox Theology "Justinian Patriarhul"; it has its own library and an extension in Rome.
unibuc|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.admission: All candidates pass an aptitude interview (admitted/rejected). Then the grade is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and an interview in Dogmatic Theology; for Pastoral Theology there is also an eliminatory test of diction and musical aptitudes, and for Sacred Art, instead of the dogmatics interview, a practical drawing test.

unibuc|Facultatea de Teologie Romano-Cat.name: Faculty of Roman Catholic Theology
unibuc|Facultatea de Teologie Romano-Cat.about: You study Roman Catholic theology together with social work, in a three-year programme, with theology and social subjects and with specialist practical work; on request, the qualification can be recognised as equivalent to that of a social worker. The faculty is in the courtyard of Saint Joseph's Cathedral in Bucharest.
unibuc|Facultatea de Teologie Romano-Cat.admission: Admission is a file-based competition with an interview: the final grade is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the interview grade.

unitbv|Facultatea de Alimentație și Turi.name: Faculty of Food and Tourism
unitbv|Facultatea de Alimentație și Turi.about: Here you learn engineering for the food industry and for tourism: how food is made and checked, how to run a restaurant, a guesthouse or a tourism business. The programmes last four years and end with an engineer's diploma. The faculty has its own laboratories for practical work.
unitbv|Facultatea de Alimentație și Turi.admission: You enter based on your file: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, for all programmes. There is no written exam.

unitbv|Facultatea de Construcții.name: Faculty of Civil Engineering
unitbv|Facultatea de Construcții.about: It trains construction engineers: civil, industrial and agricultural buildings, roads, bridges and railways, building services. You study mathematics, physics, mechanics, strength of materials and computer-aided design, with many practical activities in laboratories. Studies last four years.
unitbv|Facultatea de Construcții.admission: You enter based on your file: half of the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, and the other half is the grade in the compulsory exam of the profile from the bac. There is no written exam.

unitbv|Facultatea de Design de Mobilier.name: Faculty of Furniture Design and Wood Engineering
unitbv|Facultatea de Design de Mobilier.about: You learn how furniture and other wooden products are designed and made, from doors and windows to musical instruments and toys. You study wood as a material (anatomy, chemistry, physics and mechanics), furniture design and technology. The programmes are engineering programmes and last four years.
unitbv|Facultatea de Design de Mobilier.admission: You enter based on your file: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, for both full-time and part-time study.

unitbv|Facultatea de Design de Produs și.name: Faculty of Product Design and Environment
unitbv|Facultatea de Design de Produs și.about: An engineering faculty with very different programmes: industrial design, mechatronics, medical engineering, optometry, renewable energy and environmental protection. You learn to design new products using the computer and to take into account materials, energy and the environment. The faculty was founded in 2010.
unitbv|Facultatea de Design de Produs și.admission: For almost all programmes you enter based on your file, with only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Mechatronics in the dual system, the bac average and the grade from an interview count equally, and for Industrial Design in English an oral language test is added, graded admitted/rejected.

unitbv|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
unitbv|Facultatea de Drept.about: Here you study Law for four years: civil law, criminal law, civil and criminal procedure, Roman law and European Union law. After graduating you can move towards careers such as lawyer, judge, prosecutor, notary or legal adviser. The programme exists full-time and part-time.
unitbv|Facultatea de Drept.admission: You enter based on your file: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the tie is broken by the grade from the written Romanian exam of the bac.

unitbv|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Mountain Sports
unitbv|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și.about: It trains physical education teachers, sports specialists and physiotherapists. Besides athletics, gymnastics and sports games, mountain sports such as alpine skiing, cross-country skiing, snowboarding and sledding are also studied here. Studies last three years.
unitbv|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și.admission: For Physical Education and Sport and for Sport and Motor Performance you take a sports test (testing of motor abilities), which counts as much as the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Physiotherapy the sports test is only admitted/rejected, and the average is made up of the bac and a written multiple-choice test. The medical visit is compulsory.

unitbv|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
unitbv|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.about: It trains engineers in computers, information technology, automation, robotics, electronics, telecommunications and electrical engineering. You learn programming, electrical circuits, electronics and how equipment is designed and automated. The programmes last four years, and one of them is taught in English.
unitbv|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.admission: You enter based on your file, without a written exam: your Mathematics grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) weighs more than the bac average. If you did not take Mathematics in the bac, the Physics grade is taken into account. For the programme in English an oral language test is added, graded admitted/rejected.

unitbv|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică.name: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering
unitbv|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică.about: It is one of the university's oldest faculties and trains engineers for the automotive industry and for transport. You study road vehicles (including hybrid and electric), transport and traffic engineering or mechanical engineering. The programmes last four years.
unitbv|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică.admission: You enter based on your file, without a written exam: for full-time programmes the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts and, with a somewhat smaller weight, your grade in Mathematics or Physics from the bac, of your choice. For part-time study only the bac average counts. For Road Vehicles in English an oral language test is added, graded admitted/rejected, if you do not have a certificate.

unitbv|Facultatea de Inginerie Tehnologi.name: Faculty of Technological Engineering and Industrial Management
unitbv|Facultatea de Inginerie Tehnologi.about: It continues the old Brașov faculty of Machine-Building Technology. You learn how industrial products are designed and made, with programmes such as machine-building technology, aerospace construction, digital production systems, quality engineering and economic engineering. Studies last four years.
unitbv|Facultatea de Inginerie Tehnologi.admission: You enter based on your file: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, for all programmes. There is no written exam.

unitbv|Facultatea de Litere.name: Faculty of Letters
unitbv|Facultatea de Litere.about: You study languages and literatures: Romanian, English, French, German and Chinese, in combinations of two. It also has the programmes Applied Modern Languages and American Studies (in English). You learn literature, linguistics and the chosen languages, and studies last three years.
unitbv|Facultatea de Litere.admission: You enter based on your file, with only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You must prove that you have studied the languages of the programme (high-school years or a language certificate); otherwise you take an online language test graded admitted/rejected. For American Studies an oral English test is taken, if you do not have a certificate.

unitbv|Facultatea de Matematică și Infor.name: Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science
unitbv|Facultatea de Matematică și Infor.about: Here you study Computer Science, Applied Computer Science (also in German) or Mathematics and Computer Science, for three years. The Mathematics and Computer Science programme prepares you mainly to teach mathematics and computer science. The faculty collaborates with IT companies, where students can do practical work.
unitbv|Facultatea de Matematică și Infor.admission: You enter based on your file, without a written exam: what counts the most is the higher of your Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grades in Mathematics and Computer Science, and the rest is the bac average; the profile of the high school changes the result slightly. If you took neither Mathematics nor Computer Science in the bac, you receive a grade of 0 for this part. For Applied Computer Science in German only the bac average counts, plus an oral language test.

unitbv|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
unitbv|Facultatea de Medicină.about: It trains doctors (six years of study), general nurses (four years), and specialists in balneology, physiotherapy and rehabilitation and in clinical laboratory work. For Medicine you enter through a written test, and for the other programmes based on your file.
unitbv|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: For Medicine you enter only through a competition: a multiple-choice test in Biology (grade 11) and Organic Chemistry (grades 10 and 11). For General Nursing, Balneology and Physiotherapy, and Clinical Laboratory you enter based on your file: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and, with a smaller weight, your annual high-school averages in Biology.

unitbv|Facultatea de Muzică.name: Faculty of Music
unitbv|Facultatea de Muzică.about: Here you study music performance (an instrument or singing) or the Music programme, from which you can become, for example, a choirmaster. You learn music theory and history, harmony, musical forms and you play a lot, alone and in ensembles. The faculty is an important place for the musical life of Brașov.
unitbv|Facultatea de Muzică.admission: You enter through practical aptitude tests, not with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average: an instrumental recital or vocal technique, performance and a test of music theory and solfeggio. In each test you must get at least a pass grade. For Music Performance – instruments in English an oral language test is added, graded admitted/rejected, if you do not have a certificate.

unitbv|Facultatea de Psihologie și Știin.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
unitbv|Facultatea de Psihologie și Știin.about: It trains psychologists, primary school teachers, early-years educators and specialists in special psychopedagogy. In Psychology you learn psychological assessment, counselling and research. Studies last three years; Psychology and Primary School Pedagogy can also be followed by distance learning.
unitbv|Facultatea de Psihologie și Știin.admission: You enter based on your file, with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Primary School Pedagogy, Early Education and Special Psychopedagogy an eliminatory test of communication and aptitudes is added, graded admitted/rejected; for Psychology there is no such test.

unitbv|Facultatea de Silvicultură și Exp.name: Faculty of Forestry and Forest Engineering
unitbv|Facultatea de Silvicultură și Exp.about: It is the university's oldest faculty and was for decades the only one in Romania training specialists for forests. You learn to care for and manage forests and game, to organise timber harvesting or to do land surveying and cadastre. The programmes are engineering programmes and last four years.
unitbv|Facultatea de Silvicultură și Exp.admission: You enter based on your file: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, full-time and by distance learning. If averages are equal, the bac grades are compared, starting with Mathematics and Biology.

unitbv|Facultatea de Sociologie și Comun.name: Faculty of Sociology and Communication
unitbv|Facultatea de Sociologie și Comun.about: It is one of the university's newer faculties. Here you study sociology, social work, human resources, communication and public relations or digital media (also in English). You learn how groups and organisations work, how to help people in difficulty and how new technologies change communication.
unitbv|Facultatea de Sociologie și Comun.admission: You enter based on your file: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, for all programmes. For Digital Media in English an oral language test is added, graded admitted/rejected, if you do not have a certificate.

unitbv|Facultatea de Știința și Ingineri.name: Faculty of Materials Science and Engineering
unitbv|Facultatea de Știința și Ingineri.about: You learn how the materials from which industrial products are made are obtained, processed and tested. The programmes are engineering programmes, last four years and include materials science, welding engineering and industrial safety engineering. Practical work takes place in the faculty's laboratories.
unitbv|Facultatea de Știința și Ingineri.admission: You enter based on your file: only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, for all programmes. If averages are equal, the bac grades are compared, starting with Mathematics and Physics.

unitbv|Facultatea de Științe Economice ș.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences and Business Administration
unitbv|Facultatea de Științe Economice ș.about: It is the university's largest faculty. You can study marketing, management, finance and banking, accounting, international business, economic informatics, business administration (also in English) or economics of trade, tourism and services. Studies last three years, and some programmes also exist by distance learning.
unitbv|Facultatea de Științe Economice ș.admission: You enter based on your file, with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For full-time programmes, the average is slightly reduced if you did not take the Mathematics exam in the bac; for distance learning the average counts as it is. For the programme in English an oral language test is added.

univnt|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
univnt|Facultatea de Drept.about: Here you study Law (full-time or by distance learning) or European and International Law. Besides the law subjects you also have economic and social subjects, and students take part in mock trials and pleading competitions. Graduates can become judges, lawyers, notaries or legal advisers.
univnt|Facultatea de Drept.admission: You take no exam: admission is through a competition based on the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, as at all the university's faculties.

univnt|Facultatea de Economie și Adminis.name: Faculty of Economics and Business Administration
univnt|Facultatea de Economie și Adminis.about: The faculty trains economists through two bachelor's programmes: Business Administration and Accounting and Management Information Systems. Both can be followed full-time or by distance learning, and students do work placements and can go on Erasmus mobilities.
univnt|Facultatea de Economie și Adminis.admission: You take no exam: admission is through a competition based on the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, as at all the university's faculties.

univnt|Facultatea de Relații internațion.name: Faculty of International Relations and Administration
univnt|Facultatea de Relații internațion.about: It has a single bachelor's programme, Public Administration, full-time or by distance learning. Besides the administration subjects you learn economics, law and political science and do practical work in public or private institutions.
univnt|Facultatea de Relații internațion.admission: You take no exam: admission is through a competition based on the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, as at all the university's faculties.

unmb|Facultatea de Compoziție, Muzicolog.name: Faculty of Composition, Musicology and Music Pedagogy
unmb|Facultatea de Compoziție, Muzicolog.about: Here you learn to write music, to conduct, to research music or to teach it: the programmes are Music Composition, Conducting, Musicology, Music (music pedagogy) and Religious Music. The university has symphony orchestras, choirs and jazz ensembles in which students can play.
unmb|Facultatea de Compoziție, Muzicolog.admission: You enter only on the basis of music tests, different for each programme: an eliminatory test (instrument, vocal, or ear and dictation), an aptitude test for the specialisation and tests of ear, solfeggio, theory, dictation or harmony. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) must be passed.

unmb|Facultatea de Interpretare Muzicală.name: Faculty of Music Performance
unmb|Facultatea de Interpretare Muzicală.about: The faculty for those who want to become instrumentalists or singers: you study a keyboard instrument, an orchestral instrument, guitar, pan flute, saxophone or accordion, or singing.
unmb|Facultatea de Interpretare Muzicală.admission: You enter based on music tests: an eliminatory test, a recital on your instrument or in singing and music theory tests; for instruments there are also tests of ear, solfeggio and dictation.

uoradea|Facultatea de Arte.name: Faculty of Arts
uoradea|Facultatea de Arte.about: Here you study either visual arts (painting, graphic art, decorative arts, design, fashion) or music (singing, instruments, music pedagogy). The faculty has two departments, Visual Arts and Music, and the teachers are musicians, visual artists and designers.
uoradea|Facultatea de Arte.admission: You enter based on aptitude tests. For music you take an eliminatory test of musical aptitudes and a specialist test (voice or instrument, plus a theory interview). For visual arts you present a portfolio of works, have an interview and take a practical drawing test.

uoradea|Facultatea de Construcții, Cadas.name: Faculty of Civil Engineering, Cadastre and Architecture
uoradea|Facultatea de Construcții, Cadas.about: You learn to design and build buildings, water and sewerage networks, to do land surveying and cadastre, or to become an architect. The faculty has departments of architecture, cadastre and civil engineering.
uoradea|Facultatea de Construcții, Cadas.admission: For construction and for land surveying and cadastre the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Architecture you send a portfolio of works (admitted/rejected), take an eliminatory drawing test and an interview, both graded, and the bac average is also taken into account.

uoradea|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
uoradea|Facultatea de Drept.about: You study law or public administration: the laws, and how courts and state institutions work. The faculty continues the tradition of the Law Academy founded in Oradea in 1780, and legal education was resumed here in 1992.
uoradea|Facultatea de Drept.admission: There is no written exam: the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average (the larger part) and the overall high-school graduation average. If averages are equal, the bac Romanian grade counts.

uoradea|Facultatea de Geografie, Turism.name: Faculty of Geography, Tourism and Sport
uoradea|Facultatea de Geografie, Turism.about: The faculty has two directions: geography (tourism geography, spatial planning, geoinformatics) and sport (physical education and sport, physiotherapy). Tourism Geography and Physiotherapy can also be followed in English.
uoradea|Facultatea de Geografie, Turism.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For physical education and physiotherapy you first take an eliminatory test of motor capacity (an applied course, graded admitted/rejected), and for the programmes in English you also have a conversation in English, also graded admitted/rejected.

uoradea|Facultatea de Informatică și Ști.name: Faculty of Computer Science and Sciences
uoradea|Facultatea de Informatică și Ști.about: Here you study computer science, mathematics, biology, chemistry or medical physics. The faculty has four departments: Biology, Chemistry, Physics and Mathematics and Computer Science.
uoradea|Facultatea de Informatică și Ști.admission: There is no exam. The admission average is the higher of the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from a bac exam related to the programme (for example mathematics or computer science for Computer Science, biology for Biology).

uoradea|Facultatea de Inginerie Electric.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology
uoradea|Facultatea de Inginerie Electric.about: The faculty trains engineers in computers, information technology, automation, electronics, telecommunications and electrical engineering. It has ten bachelor's programmes, six of them in IT, and works with companies for practical work and internships.
uoradea|Facultatea de Inginerie Electric.admission: The admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, with no exam. You can list several programmes, in order of preference. If averages are equal, the bac grade in mathematics counts, then the one in digital skills.

uoradea|Facultatea de Inginerie Energeti.name: Faculty of Energy Engineering and Industrial Management
uoradea|Facultatea de Inginerie Energeti.about: You learn about energy production and transmission (electric, solar, wind, hydro, thermal), about renewable energy and about knitwear and clothing technology. The faculty also has a programme in industrial economic engineering.
uoradea|Facultatea de Inginerie Energeti.admission: The admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, with no exam. If averages are equal, the bac grade in mathematics counts, then the digital skills result.

uoradea|Facultatea de Inginerie Manageri.name: Faculty of Managerial and Technological Engineering
uoradea|Facultatea de Inginerie Manageri.about: Here you become an engineer in the mechanical field: road vehicles, machine-building technology, mechatronics, robotics or economic engineering. Some programmes also have a variant in English or by distance learning.
uoradea|Facultatea de Inginerie Manageri.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Robotics in English you must prove that you know English (a certificate or a document showing you studied it in high school). If averages are equal, the mathematics grade counts.

uoradea|Facultatea de Istorie, Relații I.name: Faculty of History, International Relations, Political Sciences and Communication Sciences
uoradea|Facultatea de Istorie, Relații I.about: You study history, international relations and European studies, political science, security studies, journalism or communication. The faculty has three departments, and international relations can also be followed in English.
uoradea|Facultatea de Istorie, Relații I.admission: Admission is based on your file: the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For the programme in English you need a good English grade in high school or a language certificate. If averages are equal, the written Romanian grade counts.

uoradea|Facultatea de Litere.name: Faculty of Letters
uoradea|Facultatea de Litere.about: You study Romanian language and literature together with one foreign language, or two languages from among English, French and German. The faculty has three departments: Romanian, English and French-German.
uoradea|Facultatea de Litere.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. You must also prove that you know the foreign language, with the language skills exam of the bac or with a language certificate (admitted/rejected). Winners of the VERBUM competition for pupils, organised by the faculty, can ask for the prize to be recognised at admission.

uoradea|Facultatea de Medicină și Farmac.name: Faculty of Medicine and Pharmacy
uoradea|Facultatea de Medicină și Farmac.about: It trains doctors, dentists and pharmacists, as well as nurses, dental technicians and specialists in nutrition, radiology or medical rehabilitation. Medicine can also be followed in English.
uoradea|Facultatea de Medicină și Farmac.admission: For Medicine and Dental Medicine you take a multiple-choice test in biology and organic chemistry; for Pharmacy you choose between biology, organic chemistry and inorganic chemistry. For the programmes in English there is an eliminatory oral English test and an interview. For the other programmes (nursing, balneology and physiotherapy, nutrition, radiology, dental technology) there is no exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the overall high-school average count, in equal parts.

uoradea|Facultatea de Protecția Mediului.name: Faculty of Environmental Protection
uoradea|Facultatea de Protecția Mediului.about: Despite its name, what you mostly learn here is agriculture, horticulture, landscape architecture, animal science, forestry and food product engineering. The faculty has eleven bachelor's programmes and five departments.
uoradea|Facultatea de Protecția Mediului.admission: The admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, with no exam. If averages are equal, the bac grade in Romanian language and literature counts.

uoradea|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
uoradea|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you learn applied economics: management, marketing, accounting, finance and banking, international business, business administration or economics of tourism and services. Some programmes are taught in English, and others also have a distance-learning variant.
uoradea|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: The admission average is the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, with no exam. For the programmes in English you must prove that you know English (a certificate or a document showing you studied it in high school). If averages are equal, the bac grade in mathematics counts.

uoradea|Facultatea de Științe Socio - Um.name: Faculty of Social and Human Sciences
uoradea|Facultatea de Științe Socio - Um.about: You study psychology, sociology, social work, human resources or train to be a primary school teacher or early-years educator. The faculty has three departments, and also a pedagogy programme in Beiuș and one in Hungarian.
uoradea|Facultatea de Științe Socio - Um.admission: The admission criterion is the average of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) exam, with no written exam. If averages are equal, the bac grade in Romanian counts.

uoradea|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.name: Faculty of Orthodox Theology "Bishop Dr. Vasile Coman"
uoradea|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.about: You study Pastoral Orthodox Theology, the programme that trains future priests; it lasts eight semesters, full-time. The faculty has operated in its current form since 1991 and continues the Theological Academy of Oradea, founded in 1923.
uoradea|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.admission: According to the admission guide, the criterion is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. If averages are equal, the overall average of the high-school years counts, then the written bac grade in Romanian. Check the faculty's regulations for any other conditions.

upa-iasi|Facultatea de Drept, Economie,.name: Faculty of Law, Economics, Political and Administrative Sciences
upa-iasi|Facultatea de Drept, Economie,.about: The faculty has three departments: Legal Sciences, Economic Sciences and Political Sciences. You can study Law, Political Science or an economics programme, such as Accounting and Management Information Systems, Finance and Banking or Marketing. The university also announces a new bachelor's programme, Local Police.
upa-iasi|Facultatea de Drept, Economie,.admission: You take no exam. You submit your file (you can also do it online), and the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the written Romanian Language and Literature exam of the bac, in equal parts.

upa-iasi|Facultatea de Psihologie, Știin.name: Faculty of Psychology, Educational Sciences and Social Work
upa-iasi|Facultatea de Psihologie, Știin.about: Here you study Psychology or Social Work, three years each. In Psychology you work in specialist laboratories and do practical work in institutions in Iași. In Social Work you learn how to help families, children, older people or people with disabilities and can choose modules such as anti-drug counselling or probation counselling.
upa-iasi|Facultatea de Psihologie, Știin.admission: You take no exam.
