You submit your file (you can also do it online), and the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the written Romanian Language and Literature exam of the bac, in equal parts.

upb|Facultatea de Antreprenoriat, Ingine.name: Faculty of Entrepreneurship, Business Engineering and Management
upb|Facultatea de Antreprenoriat, Ingine.about: Here you learn engineering together with management: how to run a business, marketing, finance, human resources and project management. It is designed for those who want a career in business or want to start their own company. In the laboratories you work with business simulation software.
upb|Facultatea de Antreprenoriat, Ingine.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in a second subject that you choose from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Automatică și Calculat.name: Faculty of Automatic Control and Computers
upb|Facultatea de Automatică și Calculat.about: Here you learn computers and information technology: programming, computer architecture, software applications and artificial intelligence. In automatic control you study applied informatics, control systems for robots and industrial processes, and automation. Theory goes hand in hand with a lot of practical work.
upb|Facultatea de Automatică și Calculat.admission: You enter through a written exam with two tests, taken on the same day: Mathematics and, of your choice, Physics or Computer Science. The exam has the greatest weight, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average also counts, to a smaller extent.

upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Electronică, C.name: Faculty of Electronics, Communications and Computers
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Electronică, C.about: The faculty is in Pitești, at the Pitești University Centre of the Bucharest Polytechnic. Here you learn computers, applied electronics, telecommunications networks and software, and electromechanics.
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Electronică, C.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in a second subject that you choose from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Electronică, Telecomun.name: Faculty of Electronics, Telecommunications and Information Technology
upb|Facultatea de Electronică, Telecomun.about: Here you learn electronics, microelectronics, telecommunications and computer engineering: from circuits and devices to telecommunications networks and software. The faculty also has communication programmes, such as Digital Media and Journalism.
upb|Facultatea de Electronică, Telecomun.admission: For the engineering programmes you enter through a written exam in Mathematics and in Physics or Computer Science, plus the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For the communication sciences programmes (Digital Media, Journalism) you enter through a file-based competition, with your high-school averages in Romanian and in a subject of your choice, plus the bac average.

upb|Facultatea de Energetică.name: Faculty of Power Engineering
upb|Facultatea de Energetică.about: Here you learn how energy is produced, transmitted and distributed: conventional and nuclear power plants, renewable energy, electrical networks. In recent years the programmes also emphasise environmental protection and the digitalisation of the energy sector. The faculty has existed since 1950.
upb|Facultatea de Energetică.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in Physics or Computer Science, of your choice, count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Ingineria Sistemelor B.name: Faculty of Biotechnical Systems Engineering
upb|Facultatea de Ingineria Sistemelor B.about: Here you learn engineering related to agriculture, food and the environment: machinery and installations for agriculture and the food industry, food product engineering, applied informatics in environmental engineering and mechatronics for biotechnical systems.
upb|Facultatea de Ingineria Sistemelor B.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in a second subject that you choose from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Aerospațială.name: Faculty of Aerospace Engineering
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Aerospațială.about: Here you learn how aircraft and spacecraft are designed, built and operated: aerospace construction, propulsion systems, aviation equipment, air navigation, aeronautical design and management. The faculty continues the Polytechnic's aviation section, which started in 1933.
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Aerospațială.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in Physics or Computer Science, of your choice, count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Chimică și B.name: Faculty of Chemical Engineering and Biotechnologies
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Chimică și B.about: Here you learn chemistry applied in industry: organic substances and petrochemistry, food chemistry and biochemical technologies, polymers, oxide materials and nanomaterials, pharmaceutical engineering and environmental protection. The Polytechnic's chemistry courses have a tradition that begins in 1867.
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Chimică și B.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in two subjects chosen from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.about: Here you learn how electrical systems are designed and work: electrical machines and drives, power electronics, measuring instruments and data acquisition. Besides the electrical side you also do a lot of computer science, for design and the programs used in engineering.
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in Physics or Computer Science, of your choice, count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Industrială.name: Faculty of Industrial Engineering and Robotics
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Industrială.about: Here you learn how industrial products are designed and made: machine-building technology, digital production systems, robotics, welding, industrial logistics and quality engineering. There are also programmes in applied informatics in industrial engineering and in economic engineering.
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Industrială.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in a second subject that you choose from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Inginerie în Limbi Str.name: Faculty of Engineering in Foreign Languages
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie în Limbi Str.about: Here you study engineering with all courses taught in a foreign language: English, French or German. You can choose between computers and information engineering, electronics, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering or economic engineering. The faculty also receives students from other countries.
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie în Limbi Str.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in the subjects required for the chosen field (usually Mathematics and a second subject of your choice) count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.name: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Mechatronics
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.about: Here you learn mechanical engineering and mechatronics: thermal systems and equipment, hydraulic and pneumatic machines, industrial equipment, precision mechanics. You work with computer-aided design, simulations and laboratory measurements. The faculty also has programmes in industrial design, economic engineering and optometry.
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in a second subject that you choose from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Medicală.name: Faculty of Medical Engineering
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Medicală.about: Here you learn the engineering behind medicine: medical devices and systems, biomaterials and software used in hospitals. The medical training part is done together with the "Carol Davila" University of Medicine and Pharmacy. The faculty was founded in 2010.
upb|Facultatea de Inginerie Medicală.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in a second subject that you choose from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Mecanică și Te.name: Faculty of Mechanics and Technology
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Mecanică și Te.about: The faculty is in Pitești, at the Pitești University Centre of the Bucharest Polytechnic. Here you learn about road vehicles, transport and traffic engineering, machine-building technology and industrial economic engineering. The faculty has existed since 1969 and combines engineering with economics.
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Mecanică și Te.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in a second subject that you choose from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Știința și Ingineria M.name: Faculty of Materials Science and Engineering
upb|Facultatea de Știința și Ingineria M.about: Here you learn about the materials things are made of: metals and alloys, but also modern materials such as composites, powders or shape-memory materials. The faculty comes from the Polytechnic's metallurgy tradition and also has programmes in medical engineering, environmental engineering and economic engineering.
upb|Facultatea de Știința și Ingineria M.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in two subjects chosen from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe ale Ed.name: Faculty of Educational Sciences, Social Sciences and Psychology
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe ale Ed.about: The faculty is in Pitești, at the Pitești University Centre of the Bucharest Polytechnic. Here you can study psychology, social work, journalism, human resources and pedagogy, for those who want to become primary school teachers or early-years educators. Some pedagogy programmes are also held in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Slatina, Alexandria and Câmpulung.
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe ale Ed.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Romanian Language and Literature and in a second subject of your choice count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb|Facultatea de Științe Aplicate.name: Faculty of Applied Sciences
upb|Facultatea de Științe Aplicate.about: Here you learn mathematics, physics and computer science used in engineering. The programmes are Mathematics and Applied Computer Science in Engineering, Engineering Physics and Computer Security and Data Science. The faculty was founded in 2005 and has its own research centres and laboratories.
upb|Facultatea de Științe Aplicate.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in a second subject that you choose from the faculty's list count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe Econom.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences and Law
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe Econom.about: The faculty is in Pitești, at the Pitești University Centre of the Bucharest Polytechnic. Here you can study finance and banking, accounting and management information systems, management, business administration, public administration and law. It trains specialists for the economic and legal fields and for public administration.
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe Econom.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Romanian Language and Literature and in a second subject of your choice count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe, Educa.name: Faculty of Sciences, Physical Education and Computer Science
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe, Educa.about: The faculty is in Pitești, at the Pitești University Centre of the Bucharest Polytechnic. Here you can study biology, chemistry, mathematics, computer science, ecology and environmental engineering, horticulture, as well as nursing, physiotherapy or physical education and sport. It trains teachers and specialists in health, sport, computer science and the environment.
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Științe, Educa.admission: For most programmes you enter through a file-based competition, with your high-school averages in two subjects of your choice and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Physical Education and Sport you take sports tests, and for General Nursing you also take a written test in Biology (human anatomy and physiology).

upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Teologie, Lite.name: Faculty of Theology, Letters, History and Arts
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Teologie, Lite.about: The faculty is in Pitești, at the Pitești University Centre of the Bucharest Polytechnic. Here you can study Romanian and foreign languages, applied modern languages, history, Orthodox theology with social work, music, sacred art and acting. It continues the humanities and arts tradition of the University of Pitești.
upb-pitesti|Facultatea de Teologie, Lite.admission: For theology, letters, applied modern languages and history you enter through a file-based competition, with your high-school averages and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Music and Acting you take aptitude tests (for example musical dictation and solfeggio, and improvisation and performance of a text, respectively), and for Sacred Art you take a drawing test.

upb|Facultatea de Transporturi.name: Faculty of Transport
upb|Facultatea de Transporturi.about: Here you learn about vehicles and how transport is organised: road vehicles and their propulsion systems, railway vehicles, traffic engineering, electronics and remote control in transport. Graduates work in the design and operation of vehicles, in traffic safety and in intelligent transport systems.
upb|Facultatea de Transporturi.admission: You enter through a file-based competition: your high-school averages (grades 9-11) in Mathematics and in Physics or Computer Science, of your choice, count, together with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no written exam.

upet|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.name: Faculty of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering
upet|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.about: Here you become an engineer in computers, automation and applied informatics, electromechanics, energetics, transport or machine building. You work in laboratories for programmable controllers, electronics, electrical machines, robotics and 3D printing. Electromechanics can also be followed at the Horezu extension.
upet|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.admission: You take no admission exam. The admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from one written bac exam: for engineering, mathematics (or the third written exam, if you did not take mathematics).

upet|Facultatea de Mine.name: Faculty of Mines
upet|Facultatea de Mine.about: It is the university's oldest faculty, founded in 1948. Here you study mining engineering, mine surveying, mine construction, environmental protection in industry or safety in industry. The business engineering and management programme operates in Deva.
upet|Facultatea de Mine.admission: You take no admission exam. The admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from one written bac exam: for engineering, mathematics (or the third written exam, if you did not take mathematics).

upet|Facultatea de Științe Economice, Ad.name: Faculty of Economic, Administrative and Social Sciences
upet|Facultatea de Științe Economice, Ad.about: The faculty, founded in the 1993–1994 academic year, has programmes in accounting, finance and banking, management, economics of trade, tourism and services, public administration, sociology and social work. Public Administration can also be followed in Deva.
upet|Facultatea de Științe Economice, Ad.admission: You take no admission exam. The admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from one written bac exam, usually the third written exam (of your choice); if you did not take it, mathematics or history is taken into account.

upg|Facultatea de Ingineria Petrolului ș.name: Faculty of Petroleum and Gas Engineering
upg|Facultatea de Ingineria Petrolului ș.about: Here you learn how oil and gas are sought, extracted, transported and stored. The programmes are Petroleum and Gas Engineering, Geology of Petroleum Resources, and Transport, Storage and Distribution of Hydrocarbons, with work placements at oil companies.
upg|Facultatea de Ingineria Petrolului ș.admission: You enter with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, without a specialist exam; candidates are ranked in descending order of their averages.

upg|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.name: Faculty of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering
upg|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.about: It trains engineers for oil and petrochemical equipment, product design, electromechanics, automation and applied informatics, computers and economic engineering. You work in laboratories with modern equipment, including for 3D printing.
upg|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.admission: You enter with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, without a specialist exam; candidates are ranked in descending order of their averages.

upg|Facultatea de Litere și Științe.name: Faculty of Letters and Sciences
upg|Facultatea de Litere și Științe.about: It has very different programmes: languages and literatures (Romanian, English, French), educational sciences, public administration, psychology and computer science. It is the right faculty if in Ploiești you want something other than engineering or economics.
upg|Facultatea de Litere și Științe.admission: For most programmes the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Psychology you take a multiple-choice test of critical thinking. For the educational sciences programmes and the languages and literatures programmes you also take an eliminatory aptitude test (for languages, an oral presentation in English or French).

upg|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
upg|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you study economics and business: accounting, finance and banking, management, trade and tourism, commodity science, economic informatics and economic communication in business. All bachelor's programmes last three years, and some can also be followed by distance learning.
upg|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: You enter with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, without a specialist exam; candidates are ranked in descending order of their averages.

upg|Facultatea de Tehnologia Petrolului.name: Faculty of Petroleum Technology and Petrochemistry
upg|Facultatea de Tehnologia Petrolului.about: Here you learn chemical engineering: how oil is processed in refineries, how food safety is controlled and how the environment is protected in industry. You study a lot of chemistry and work in laboratories.
upg|Facultatea de Tehnologia Petrolului.admission: You enter with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, without a specialist exam. For the programme Oil Processing and Petrochemistry taught in English, a language proficiency test is also taken.

upt|Facultatea de Arhitectură și Urbanis.name: Faculty of Architecture and Urban Planning
upt|Facultatea de Arhitectură și Urbanis.about: Here you learn to design buildings, to fit out interiors and to plan cities. The faculty has the Architecture programme, lasting six years, and the Furniture and Interior Design programme, lasting three years. Students work on real projects and take part in architecture competitions.
upt|Facultatea de Arhitectură și Urbanis.admission: Admission has assessment tests: you submit a portfolio, take a practical test and an interview, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average is added to the grade with a smaller weight.

upt|Facultatea de Automatică și Calculat.name: Faculty of Automation and Computers
upt|Facultatea de Automatică și Calculat.about: The faculty trains engineers in computers, information technology and automation: programming, networks, artificial intelligence, robotics and cyber security. The Computers programme can also be followed in English. Studies last four years.
upt|Facultatea de Automatică și Calculat.admission: Admission is through a knowledge assessment test: you choose a test in mathematics or computer science, or an online test based on a portfolio of achievements. The test grade counts the most, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average has a smaller weight.

upt|Facultatea de Construcții.name: Faculty of Civil Engineering
upt|Facultatea de Construcții.about: Here you learn to design and build buildings, roads, bridges, railways and water works, as well as building services. There is also a land surveying and cadastre programme. Civil engineering can be studied in Romanian, English or German.
upt|Facultatea de Construcții.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without an exam: candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

upt|Facultatea de Electronică, Telecomun.name: Faculty of Electronics, Telecommunications and Information Technologies
upt|Facultatea de Electronică, Telecomun.about: The faculty trains engineers in electronics, telecommunications and information technology, with topics such as microelectronics, communication networks, the Internet of Things and artificial intelligence. Studies last four years; you can also study in English or by distance learning.
upt|Facultatea de Electronică, Telecomun.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without an exam: what counts the most is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade in mathematics, physics or computer science, to which the bac average is added. For distance learning only the bac average counts.

upt|Facultatea de Inginerie Chimică, Bio.name: Faculty of Chemical Engineering, Biotechnologies and Environmental Protection
upt|Facultatea de Inginerie Chimică, Bio.about: Here you study chemical engineering, environmental engineering and food product engineering: how substances are obtained, how water is treated and how the environment is protected. Studies last four years, and Chemical Engineering can also be followed in English. Students work in research laboratories.
upt|Facultatea de Inginerie Chimică, Bio.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without an exam: candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

upt|Facultatea de Inginerie din Hunedoar.name: Faculty of Engineering of Hunedoara
upt|Facultatea de Inginerie din Hunedoar.about: It is the faculty of the Timișoara Polytechnic that operates in the town of Hunedoara. Here you study road vehicles, electrical engineering and computers, environmental engineering, engineering and management or industrial informatics. Studies last four years and have links with companies in the area.
upt|Facultatea de Inginerie din Hunedoar.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without an exam: candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

upt|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică și.name: Faculty of Electrical and Power Engineering
upt|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică și.about: The faculty trains engineers in electrical and power engineering: electric vehicles, power electronics, electricity transmission and distribution and renewable energy. Studies last four years and are in Romanian.
upt|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică și.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without an exam: candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

upt|Facultatea de Management în Producți.name: Faculty of Management in Production and Transport
upt|Facultatea de Management în Producți.about: The faculty combines engineering with management: you learn how major industries work, how a business is run and how production and logistics are organised. It has engineering and management programmes, four years, and a public administration programme, three years.
upt|Facultatea de Management în Producți.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without an exam: candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

upt|Facultatea de Mecanică.name: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering
upt|Facultatea de Mecanică.about: Here you study mechanical engineering, road vehicles, transport engineering, industrial engineering, materials engineering or medical engineering. Studies last four years, and Mechanical Engineering can also be followed in English. Students work on applied projects together with companies.
upt|Facultatea de Mecanică.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without an exam: candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

upt|Facultatea de Robotică, Inteligență.name: Faculty of Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Autonomous Systems
upt|Facultatea de Robotică, Inteligență.about: Here you learn to design and program robots and autonomous systems. The faculty has the Computer Science programme, three years, and mechatronics and robotics programmes, four years, including one in English on drone engineering and one on robotics in the dual system.
upt|Facultatea de Robotică, Inteligență.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) results. For Computer Science the bac grade in mathematics, computer science or physics counts the most (or an online test based on a portfolio), and for mechatronics and robotics the bac average. For the programme in English on drones, a bac grade (in mathematics, computer science or physics) and an interview count equally.

upt|Facultatea de Științe ale Comunicări.name: Faculty of Communication Sciences
upt|Facultatea de Științe ale Comunicări.about: The faculty has programmes in communication and public relations and in translation and interpreting (English, French, German). You learn to make PR strategies, run digital campaigns and translate specialist texts. Studies last three years.
upt|Facultatea de Științe ale Comunicări.admission: Admission is through a file-based competition, without an exam: candidates are ranked by their Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. You must prove that you know a foreign language (two for Translation and Interpreting), with a certificate or through an online language proficiency test.

usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Agricultur.name: Faculty of Agriculture
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Agricultur.about: Here you learn how plants are grown and how land is worked, as a future agronomist engineer. Besides Agriculture, the faculty also has the programmes Biology and Forestry, the latter about forests.
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Agricultur.admission: You take no exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts for the most part, plus the grade in a bac exam you choose from Romanian (or mother tongue), mathematics, chemistry, biology and geography.

usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Biotehnolo.name: Faculty of Biotechnologies
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Biotehnolo.about: You learn how microorganisms, plants and genetics are used in agriculture, in veterinary medicine and in the food industry. You study a lot of chemistry, biochemistry, microbiology and genetic engineering, and one programme is taught in English.
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Biotehnolo.admission: You take no exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts for the most part, plus the grade in a bac exam you choose from Romanian (or mother tongue), mathematics, chemistry, biology and geography.

usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Horticultu.name: Faculty of Horticulture
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Horticultu.about: You learn to work with plants: fruit trees, vegetables, grapevines and flowers. It has two programmes: Horticulture, which can also be followed by distance learning, and Landscape Architecture, where you learn to design green spaces and do floral art.
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Horticultu.admission: You take no exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts for the most part, plus the grade in a bac exam you choose from Romanian (or mother tongue), mathematics, chemistry, biology and geography.

usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Ingineria.name: Faculty of Animal Production Engineering and Management
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Ingineria.about: Here you learn about animal husbandry and the foods obtained from animals. The programmes are Animal Science, Agricultural Product Processing Technology, Consumer and Environmental Protection, Food Product Control and Expertise and Gastronomic Sciences.
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Ingineria.admission: You take no exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts for the most part, plus the grade in a bac exam you choose from Romanian (or mother tongue), mathematics, chemistry, biology and geography.

usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Îmbunătăți.name: Faculty of Land Reclamation and Environmental Engineering
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Îmbunătăți.about: Here you become an engineer for works related to land, water and construction: water management and land development, environmental protection in agriculture, construction, land surveying and cadastre. It also has a programme in circular engineering and green transition.
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Îmbunătăți.admission: You take no exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts for the most part, plus the grade in a bac exam you choose from Romanian (or mother tongue), mathematics, chemistry, biology and geography.

usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Management.name: Faculty of Management and Rural Development
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Management.about: You learn to run an agricultural business, a guesthouse or a restaurant: management, marketing, quality of products and services. It has two programmes, Agricultural Business Engineering and Management and Engineering and Management in Public Catering and Agritourism; they can also be followed by distance learning, and the first is also held in Călărași and Slatina.
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Management.admission: You take no exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts for the most part, plus the grade in a bac exam you choose from Romanian (or mother tongue), mathematics, chemistry, biology and geography.

usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Medicină V.name: Faculty of Veterinary Medicine
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Medicină V.about: Here you train to become a veterinarian. The programme lasts six years, combines theory with practice and can be followed in Romanian, English or French.
usamv-bucuresti|Facultatea de Medicină V.admission: For the programme in Romanian you take a written test in biology and chemistry, which counts the most, and the rest is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For the programmes in English and French there is no written test: the bac average counts and, a little, letters of recommendation or volunteering certificates; you also need a language certificate.

usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Agricultură.name: Faculty of Agriculture
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Agricultură.about: The university's oldest faculty, founded in 1869. Here you study agriculture, mountain agriculture, machinery and installations for agriculture and the food industry, biology or environmental engineering.
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Agricultură.admission: The admission average is entirely the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no exam.

usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Horticultură și.name: Faculty of Horticulture and Business in Rural Development
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Horticultură și.about: Here you learn about fruit trees, grapevines, vegetables and flowers (horticulture), about landscaping of green spaces (landscape architecture) and about business in the countryside: agricultural business, public catering, agritourism and tourism.
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Horticultură și.admission: The admission average is entirely the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no exam.

usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Medicină Veteri.name: Faculty of Veterinary Medicine
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Medicină Veteri.about: Here you train to become a veterinarian. Studies last 6 years, full-time only, and can be followed in Romanian, English or French. The faculty has a university veterinary hospital, with clinics for pets, horses, ruminants and exotic animals.
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Medicină Veteri.admission: For the line in Romanian the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts more, to which are added two short multiple-choice tests, in Biology (grade 11) and in Chemistry (grade 10), taken at the university. For the lines in English and French the bac average and volunteering in animal care and protection count.

usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Silvicultură și.name: Faculty of Forestry and Cadastre
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Silvicultură și.about: A new faculty, founded in 2022. Here you study Forestry (care and management of forests) or Land Surveying and Cadastre (measuring and mapping land).
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Silvicultură și.admission: The admission average is entirely the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, for all programmes. There is no exam.

usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Știința și Tehn.name: Faculty of Food Science and Technology
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Știința și Tehn.about: Here you learn how food is made, processed and checked. The bachelor's programmes are Food Product Engineering, Food Product Control and Expertise and Agricultural Product Processing Technology. The faculty was founded in 2012.
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Știința și Tehn.admission: The admission average is entirely the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. There is no exam.

usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Zootehnie și Bi.name: Faculty of Animal Science and Biotechnologies
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Zootehnie și Bi.about: Here you learn how farm animals are raised, fed and improved and how a farm is run (animal science). Biotechnologies, fish farming and animal behaviour and welfare are also studied here.
usamv-cluj|Facultatea de Zootehnie și Bi.admission: For Animal Science the admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Biotechnologies the bac average also counts, plus, to a small extent, a motivation essay.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Drept și Știin.name: Faculty of Law and Administrative Sciences
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Drept și Știin.about: Here you study law, European and international law, public administration or local police. The faculty trains future lawyers and people who work in state institutions and town halls.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Drept și Știin.admission: There is no written exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the highest grade from the written bac exams count. You must also pass a skills assessment test, graded only admitted or rejected.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Economie, Admi.name: Faculty of Economics, Administration and Business
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Economie, Admi.about: The faculty has economics and business programmes: management, accounting, finance and banking, business administration, tourism and services, international business and economic informatics. Mathematics and Computer Science and Managerial Assistance are also studied here. The faculty has a business incubation laboratory and student clubs, for example the Marketing Club.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Economie, Admi.admission: Admission is without a written exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the highest grade from one written bac exam count (for Mathematics and Computer Science, the grade in mathematics or computer science). You also complete a skills assessment form, graded admitted or rejected.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Educație Fizic.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Educație Fizic.about: Here you train to become a physical education teacher, a coach or a physiotherapist. The programmes are Physical Education and Sport, Sport and Motor Performance and Physiotherapy and Special Motricity.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Educație Fizic.admission: For Physical Education and for Sport you take a sports test in a discipline of your choice (for Physical Education you can instead choose a physical aptitude test), and the rest of the average comes from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Physiotherapy there is a motor course graded admitted or rejected, then the high-school average and the bac average count.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Inginerie Alim.name: Faculty of Food Engineering
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Inginerie Alim.about: The faculty trains engineers for the food industry: how food is made, how its quality is checked and how the consumer and the environment are protected. It also has a programme in engineering and management in public catering and agritourism. The bachelor's studies last four years.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Inginerie Alim.admission: There is no written exam: the admission average is made up of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the highest grade from the written bac exams. On the day of enrolment you also have a skills assessment interview, graded admitted or rejected.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Inginerie Elec.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Inginerie Elec.about: Here you study computers, automation and applied informatics, electronics, telecommunications, electrical systems and power engineering. The faculty has research laboratories and works with companies in the field. Engineering studies last four years.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Inginerie Elec.admission: Admission is based on the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grades, without a written exam. For the field Computers and Information Technology the bac grade in mathematics or computer science counts the most; for the other fields mostly the bac average counts. You also pass a computer use test, graded admitted or rejected.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Inginerie Meca.name: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Automotive and Robotics
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Inginerie Meca.about: The faculty trains engineers in mechanical engineering, machine-building technology, mechatronics, robotics and road vehicles. Studies last four years, and some programmes are also offered in the dual system. Students have circles in mechatronics and robotics and in vehicles.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Inginerie Meca.admission: There is no written exam: the admission average is calculated from the two highest grades from the written bac exams. You must also pass a skills assessment test, in the form of an interview, graded admitted or rejected.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Istorie, Geogr.name: Faculty of History, Geography and Social Sciences
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Istorie, Geogr.about: Here you can study history, geography, tourism geography, international relations and European studies, philosophy, social work or human resources. The faculty has research centres and a map archive.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Istorie, Geogr.admission: Admission is without a written exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the highest grade from the written bac exams count, in equal parts. On the day of enrolment you also pass a skills assessment test, graded admitted or rejected.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Litere și Știi.name: Faculty of Letters and Communication Sciences
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Litere și Știi.about: The faculty has programmes in languages and literatures (Romanian, English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Ukrainian), in communication and public relations, digital media and a programme in cinematography, photography and media. It has a creative writing centre and organises translation competitions.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Litere și Știi.admission: For the language and communication programmes the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the written Romanian exam count, and at enrolment you have an interview graded admitted or rejected. For Cinematography, Photography, Media you submit a portfolio and take an oral test and a written one (a film analysis), in addition to the bac average.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Medicină și Șt.name: Faculty of Medicine and Biological Sciences
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Medicină și Șt.about: Here medicine, general nursing, balneology, physiotherapy and rehabilitation, nutrition and dietetics, dental technology, biology and biochemistry are studied. The faculty has simulation laboratories, an anatomy and dissection laboratory and a dental technology laboratory with 3D printing.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Medicină și Șt.admission: For Medicine you take a multiple-choice test in biology (human anatomy and physiology) and, of your choice, organic chemistry or physics. For General Nursing you take a multiple-choice test in biology, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average also counts. For the other programmes admission is based on your file: the bac average and the average of the high-school years.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Psihologie și.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Psihologie și.about: The faculty trains future primary school teachers and early-years educators (Primary School Pedagogy, Early Education) and has a Psychology programme. Bachelor's studies last three years.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Psihologie și.admission: First you pass an eliminatory test, graded admitted or rejected: communication and aptitudes for the programmes for primary school teachers and early-years educators, cognitive abilities for Psychology. Then the admission average is made up of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and a bac grade: for Early Education the Romanian grade, and for Primary School Pedagogy and Psychology the highest grade among Romanian, mathematics and psychology.

usv-suceava|Facultatea de Silvicultură.name: Faculty of Forestry
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Silvicultură.about: The faculty trains forestry engineers: how the forest is cared for, how timber is harvested and used and how nature is protected. It has the Forestry programme, four years (full-time and by distance learning), and the Ecology and Environmental Protection programme, three years.
usv-suceava|Facultatea de Silvicultură.admission: There is no written exam: the admission average is made up of the two highest grades from the written bac exams. On the day of enrolment you also have a skills testing interview, graded admitted or rejected.

usvt|Facultatea de Agricultură.name: Faculty of Agriculture
usvt|Facultatea de Agricultură.about: Here you learn how plants are grown and protected, as well as biology, environmental protection in agriculture, land surveying and cadastre or agricultural machinery. Most programmes are engineering programmes and last 4 years, and Biology lasts 3 years. The faculty has a tradition of more than 80 years.
usvt|Facultatea de Agricultură.admission: You take no exam: an admission average is calculated in which the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts the most and, to a smaller extent, the average of the high-school years.

usvt|Facultatea de Bioingineria Resursel.name: Faculty of Animal Resources Bioengineering
usvt|Facultatea de Bioingineria Resursel.about: You learn about animal husbandry (animal science), biotechnologies and food production. The bachelor's programmes last 4 years and include practical work at partner farms and companies. The faculty started as a Faculty of Animal Science and moved to Timișoara in 1955.
usvt|Facultatea de Bioingineria Resursel.admission: You take no exam: an admission average is calculated in which the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts the most and, to a smaller extent, the average of the high-school years.

usvt|Facultatea de Horticultură, Silvicu.name: Faculty of Horticulture, Forestry and Plant Biotechnologies
usvt|Facultatea de Horticultură, Silvicu.about: Here you study horticulture, landscape architecture, forestry, genetic engineering or applied laboratory sciences. The programmes last 4 years and combine courses with laboratory work and practical work. Landscape Architecture can also be followed in English.
usvt|Facultatea de Horticultură, Silvicu.admission: You take no exam: an admission average is calculated in which the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts the most and, to a smaller extent, the average of the high-school years.

usvt|Facultatea de Inginerie Alimentară.name: Faculty of Food Engineering
usvt|Facultatea de Inginerie Alimentară.about: You learn how food is produced, controlled and checked: Food Product Engineering, Food Product Control and Expertise and Consumer and Environmental Protection. The programmes last 4 years, and Food Product Engineering can also be followed in English.
usvt|Facultatea de Inginerie Alimentară.admission: You take no exam: an admission average is calculated in which the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts the most and, to a smaller extent, the average of the high-school years.

usvt|Facultatea de Management și Turism.name: Faculty of Management and Rural Tourism
usvt|Facultatea de Management și Turism.about: The faculty trains specialists for agricultural business, rural tourism, public catering and agritourism. The bachelor's programmes are engineering and management programmes, last 4 years and combine economics and management with notions of agriculture and hospitality.
usvt|Facultatea de Management și Turism.admission: You take no exam: an admission average is calculated in which the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts the most and, to a smaller extent, the average of the high-school years.

usvt|Facultatea de Medicină Veterinară.name: Faculty of Veterinary Medicine
usvt|Facultatea de Medicină Veterinară.about: Here you become a veterinarian: you learn about animal health and veterinary public health. Studies last 6 years and can be followed in Romanian, English or French. The faculty has its own veterinary clinics, where you do practical work.
usvt|Facultatea de Medicină Veterinară.admission: You take no exam: an admission average is calculated in which the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts the most and, to a smaller extent, the average of the high-school years. In your file you need a medical certificate stating "Fit for Veterinary Medicine".

utcb|Facultatea de Căi Ferate, Drumuri ș.name: Faculty of Railways, Roads and Bridges
utcb|Facultatea de Căi Ferate, Drumuri ș.about: Here you become an engineer for transport infrastructure: roads, motorways, bridges and railways. You learn to design, build and maintain them. Graduates work in design, construction and consultancy firms, and many students work with such firms from their time at the faculty.
utcb|Facultatea de Căi Ferate, Drumuri ș.admission: There is no exam. The admission average is the average of the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the bac grade in Mathematics, but it cannot be lower than the bac average; if you did not take Mathematics in the bac, only the overall average counts.

utcb|Facultatea de Construcții Civile, I.name: Faculty of Civil, Industrial and Agricultural Buildings
utcb|Facultatea de Construcții Civile, I.about: Here you become a building construction engineer: you learn to design structures, run a building site and manage construction works. The programmes are Civil, Industrial and Agricultural Buildings, Urban Engineering and Regional Development and Engineering and Management in Construction. Graduates work in design, execution, management and public administration.
utcb|Facultatea de Construcții Civile, I.admission: There is no exam. The admission average is the average of the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the bac grade in Mathematics, but it cannot be lower than the bac average; if you did not take Mathematics in the bac, only the overall average counts.

utcb|Facultatea de Geodezie.name: Faculty of Geodesy
utcb|Facultatea de Geodezie.about: Here you learn to measure and represent land and buildings: surveying, cadastre, maps and 3D models. You work with total stations, GPS, drones and laser scanners and with GIS and CAD programs. The bachelor's programme is called Land Surveying and Cadastre and lasts four years.
utcb|Facultatea de Geodezie.admission: There is no exam. The admission average is the average of the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the bac grade in Mathematics, but it cannot be lower than the bac average; if you did not take Mathematics in the bac, only the overall average counts.

utcb|Facultatea de Hidroinginerie și Man.name: Faculty of Hydrotechnical Engineering and Water Resources Management
utcb|Facultatea de Hidroinginerie și Man.about: Here you become an engineer for everything related to water: dams, dikes, hydroelectric plants, water supply networks, sewerage and wastewater treatment plants. You learn to design, build and operate them. The faculty also has the programme Automation and Applied Informatics, where you study programming and control systems.
utcb|Facultatea de Hidroinginerie și Man.admission: There is no exam. The admission average is the average of the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the bac grade in Mathematics, but it cannot be lower than the bac average; if you did not take Mathematics in the bac, only the overall average counts.

utcb|Facultatea de Inginerie a Instalați.name: Faculty of Building Services Engineering
utcb|Facultatea de Inginerie a Instalați.about: Here you learn about the installations that make a building work: heating, ventilation and air conditioning, water and sewerage, electricity, lighting and fire protection. The programmes are Building Services (in Romanian or in French) and Installations and Equipment for Atmosphere Protection. Building services education in Bucharest has a tradition of more than 75 years.
utcb|Facultatea de Inginerie a Instalați.admission: There is no exam. The admission average is the average of the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the bac grade in Mathematics, but it cannot be lower than the bac average. For the programme in French you need proof that you know the language or you take a language test graded admitted or rejected.

utcb|Facultatea de Inginerie în Limbi St.name: Faculty of Engineering in Foreign Languages
utcb|Facultatea de Inginerie în Limbi St.about: Here you study Civil Engineering taught in English or in French. The faculty also has the programme Translation and Interpreting (English plus French, German or Spanish), where you train as a translator and interpreter, including for technical, economic and legal texts.
utcb|Facultatea de Inginerie în Limbi St.admission: There is no exam. For Civil Engineering, the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the bac grade in Mathematics; for Translation and Interpreting, from the bac average and the grade in Romanian. For the programmes taught in a foreign language you also need proof that you know the language; if you do not have it, you take a language test graded admitted or rejected.

utcb|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.name: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics in Construction
utcb|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.about: Here you study the machines and robots used in construction. The programmes are Technological Equipment for Construction and Mechatronics, where mechanics is combined with automation and programming. Graduates design and maintain machinery and mechatronic systems.
utcb|Facultatea de Inginerie Mecanică și.admission: There is no exam. The admission average is the average of the overall Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the bac grade in Mathematics, but it cannot be lower than the bac average; if you did not take Mathematics in the bac, only the overall average counts.

utcn|Facultatea de Arhitectură și Urbani.name: Faculty of Architecture and Urban Planning
utcn|Facultatea de Arhitectură și Urbani.about: Here you learn to design buildings and urban spaces. The faculty has a single programme, Architecture, which lasts six years and combines the bachelor's with the master's. It also has a model-making and digital fabrication workshop for students.
utcn|Facultatea de Arhitectură și Urbani.admission: You take an assessment test in drawing, which lasts three hours and counts the most in the admission average. The rest of the average comes from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

utcn|Facultatea de Automatică și Calcula.name: Faculty of Automatic Control and Computers
utcn|Facultatea de Automatică și Calcula.about: Here you learn programming, computers and automatic systems. Studies last four years, in two fields: Computers and Information Technology and Automatic Control, Applied Informatics and Intelligent Systems. You choose your specialisation from the third year, and some programmes are also offered in English.
utcn|Facultatea de Automatică și Calcula.admission: You take a three-hour written multiple-choice test in mathematics, which counts the most. To the average are added the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and, if you choose this formula, the bac grade in mathematics, physics or computer science.

utcn|Facultatea de Autovehicule rutiere,.name: Faculty of Road Vehicles, Mechatronics and Mechanics
utcn|Facultatea de Autovehicule rutiere,.about: Here you learn how cars, transport systems, thermal equipment and mechatronic equipment are designed and work. Studies last four years, and Mechatronics can also be followed in English. The faculty also has programmes in Alba Iulia.
utcn|Facultatea de Autovehicule rutiere,.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam. The admission average is the higher of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and an average in which the bac grade in one subject (mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry or economics) counts more than the overall average.

utcn|Facultatea de Construcții.name: Faculty of Civil Engineering
utcn|Facultatea de Construcții.about: Here you learn to design and build buildings, roads, bridges, railways and hydrotechnical works, as well as to do land surveying and cadastre. Studies last four years, and a civil engineering programme is also offered in English. It has a programme in Baia Mare as well.
utcn|Facultatea de Construcții.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam. The admission average is the higher of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and an average in which the bac grade in one subject (mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry or economics) counts more than the overall average.

utcn|Facultatea de Electronică, Telecomu.name: Faculty of Electronics, Telecommunications and Information Technology
utcn|Facultatea de Electronică, Telecomu.about: Here you learn electronics, telecommunications and microelectronics: how the circuits, devices and networks through which we communicate are designed. Studies last four years, and there is also a programme in economic engineering in the electrical field. You choose your specialisation from the third year.
utcn|Facultatea de Electronică, Telecomu.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam. The admission average is the higher of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and an average in which the bac grade in one subject (mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry or economics) counts more than the overall average.

utcn|Facultatea de Ingineria Materialelo.name: Faculty of Materials and Environmental Engineering
utcn|Facultatea de Ingineria Materialelo.about: Here you learn what the materials used in industry are made of, how they are processed and how the environment is protected in factories. Studies last four years, in two fields: materials engineering and environmental engineering. You choose your specialisation from the third year.
utcn|Facultatea de Ingineria Materialelo.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam. The admission average is the higher of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and an average in which the bac grade in one subject (mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry or economics) counts more than the overall average.

utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie.name: Faculty of Engineering
utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie.about: A faculty of the North University Centre in Baia Mare, where you study engineering in several directions: computers, electronics, electromechanics, energetics, machine building, materials and environmental protection. Studies last four years, and you choose your specialisation from the third year.
utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam. The admission average is the higher of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and an average in which the bac grade in a chosen subject, for example mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry, biology or geography, counts more.

utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie a Instalați.name: Faculty of Building Services Engineering
utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie a Instalați.about: Here you learn how the installations in a building are designed and fitted. The faculty has a single bachelor's programme, Building Services, which lasts four years.
utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie a Instalați.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam. The admission average is the higher of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and an average in which the bac grade in one subject (mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry or economics) counts more than the overall average.

utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering
utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.about: Here you learn about electrical machines and installations, energy production and transmission, measurements and medical equipment. Studies last four years, and you choose your specialisation from the third year. The faculty also has programmes in Bistrița.
utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie Electrică.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam. The admission average is the higher of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and an average in which the bac grade in one subject (mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry or economics) counts more than the overall average.

utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie Industrială.name: Faculty of Industrial Engineering, Robotics and Production Management
utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie Industrială.about: Here you learn to design and manufacture products, to build and use robots and to run processes in a factory. Studies last four years; some programmes are also offered in English or German. You choose your specialisation from the third year.
utcn|Facultatea de Inginerie Industrială.admission: You enter through a file-based competition, without an exam. The admission average is the higher of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and an average in which the bac grade in one subject (mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry or economics) counts more than the overall average.

utcn|Facultatea de Litere.name: Faculty of Letters
utcn|Facultatea de Litere.about: A faculty of the North University Centre in Baia Mare, with very different humanities programmes: languages and literatures, applied modern languages, journalism and communication, philosophy, ethnology, social work, pedagogy, painting and Orthodox theology. Studies last three or four years, depending on the programme.
utcn|Facultatea de Litere.admission: For most programmes you enter through a file-based competition, with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Visual Arts you take drawing and colour tests, which count the most. For Primary School Pedagogy you take an eliminatory aptitude test, which counts as much as the bac average. For Theology you take an eliminatory oral test, graded admitted or rejected.

utcn|Facultatea de Științe.name: Faculty of Sciences
utcn|Facultatea de Științe.about: A faculty of the North University Centre in Baia Mare, where you can study mathematics and computer science, biology, chemistry, food product engineering or economics programmes, such as management, economics of the firm and economic informatics.
utcn|Facultatea de Științe.admission: You enter through a file-based competition. The admission average is the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average or an average in which an additional grade counts more: the bac grade in a subject close to the programme or the grade from the competition organised by the faculty.

utgjiu|Facultatea de Inginerie.name: Faculty of Engineering
utgjiu|Facultatea de Inginerie.about: Here you learn engineering: machine building, energy, automation and applied informatics, medical engineering or engineering and management in public catering and agritourism. The Design programme, from the field of visual arts, is also here. The faculty has existed since the university was founded and has its own laboratories.
utgjiu|Facultatea de Inginerie.admission: There is no written exam: the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the first written bac exam. For Design you first pass two eliminatory tests: a drawing from life and an interview with a portfolio of works.

utgjiu|Facultatea de Științe ale Educați.name: Faculty of Educational Sciences, Law and Public Administration
utgjiu|Facultatea de Științe ale Educați.about: Here you can study law (full-time or by distance learning), public administration, international relations and European studies, English and Romanian language and literature or primary school pedagogy, for those who want to become primary school teachers.
utgjiu|Facultatea de Științe ale Educați.admission: Admission is a file-based competition: the average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the first written bac exam. For Primary School Pedagogy you first pass an eliminatory test of communication and aptitudes (diction, music and drawing), from which graduates of a pedagogical high school are exempt.

utgjiu|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
utgjiu|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you learn economics: finance and banking, accounting, management, economic informatics, trade, tourism and services, business communication. Students can do work placements and take part in competitions and research projects on economic topics.
utgjiu|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: There is no exam: the admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average (the larger part) and the grade from the first written bac exam.

utgjiu|Facultatea de Științe Medicale și.name: Faculty of Medical and Behavioural Sciences
utgjiu|Facultatea de Științe Medicale și.about: Here you train for careers in health and sport: general nursing, pharmacy assistance, physiotherapy and special motricity, physical education and sport. The training combines courses with practical work, and the faculty has its own sports facilities.
utgjiu|Facultatea de Științe Medicale și.admission: The admission average is calculated from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the first written bac exam. Before that you pass an eliminatory test (admitted/rejected): three sports tests for Physical Education and Physiotherapy, and a multiple-choice test for General Nursing and Pharmacy Assistance.

utm|Facultatea de Asistență Medicală – T.name: Faculty of Nursing – Târgu Jiu
utm|Facultatea de Asistență Medicală – T.about: A faculty in Târgu Jiu that trains nurses: General Nursing studies last 4 years, full-time. It is the university's newest faculty and has lecture halls and specialist laboratories.
utm|Facultatea de Asistență Medicală – T.admission: You take a multiple-choice test in biology. The admission average is made up mostly of the test grade, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average has a small weight.

utm|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
utm|Facultatea de Drept.about: It trains future lawyers, in Bucharest; Law can be followed full-time or by distance learning. The faculty has existed since 1990 and has a student circle on the history of law, a summer school and specialist practical work.
utm|Facultatea de Drept.admission: You take no exam: the admission average is made up of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the written Romanian exam of the bac.

utm|Facultatea de Drept și Științe Econo.name: Faculty of Law and Economic Sciences - Târgu Jiu
utm|Facultatea de Drept și Științe Econo.about: A faculty in Târgu Jiu with two directions: Law (4 years, full-time or by distance learning) and Accounting and Management Information Systems (3 years, full-time).
utm|Facultatea de Drept și Științe Econo.admission: You take no exam: the admission average is made up of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the written Romanian exam of the bac.

utm|Facultatea de Farmacie.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
utm|Facultatea de Farmacie.about: It trains future pharmacists: studies last 5 years, full-time. You work a lot in laboratories (pharmaceutical chemistry, microbiology, botany) and do practical work in pharmacies and at medicine manufacturers.
utm|Facultatea de Farmacie.admission: You take a multiple-choice test in chemistry. The admission average is the average of the test grade and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

utm|Facultatea de Informatică.name: Faculty of Computer Science
utm|Facultatea de Informatică.about: Here you study Computer Science (full-time or by distance learning) or Artificial Intelligence, a programme taught in English. You learn programming, data structures, cloud and machine learning and work in an artificial intelligence and robotics laboratory.
utm|Facultatea de Informatică.admission: You take no exam: the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts, with the greatest weight, and the average of the high-school years.

utm|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
utm|Facultatea de Medicină.about: It has two full-time programmes: Medicine, 6 years, for future doctors, and General Nursing, 4 years. The faculty has operated since 1990, and clinical practice takes place in hospitals with which it has agreements.
utm|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: For Medicine you take a multiple-choice test in biology and, of your choice, in chemistry or physics. For General Nursing you take a multiple-choice test in biology, and the admission average is made up of the test grade and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

utm|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.name: Faculty of Dental Medicine
utm|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.about: It trains dentists (Dental Medicine) and dental technicians (Dental Technology). The practical part is very important and takes place in the university's dental care clinical centre.
utm|Facultatea de Medicină Dentară.admission: For Dental Medicine you take a multiple-choice test in biology and, of your choice, in chemistry or physics. For Dental Technology you take a multiple-choice test in biology, and the admission average is made up of the test grade and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

utm|Facultatea de Psihologie.name: Faculty of Psychology
utm|Facultatea de Psihologie.about: Here you study Psychology for 3 years, full-time or by distance learning. Graduates can move towards clinical psychology, psychotherapy, human resources or school counselling, and students can go abroad to study through Erasmus+.
utm|Facultatea de Psihologie.admission: You take a multiple-choice test in psychology, based on the high-school syllabus. The admission average is the average of the test grade and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

utm|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
utm|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: It has 3-year programmes: Finance and Banking, Accounting and Management Information Systems (both full-time or by distance learning) and Business Administration (full-time). The faculty has existed since 1990 and offers practical work at banks, audit firms and insurance companies.
utm|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: You take no exam: the admission average is made up of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the written Romanian exam of the bac.

utm|Facultatea de Științele Educației, C.name: Faculty of Educational Sciences, Communication and International Relations
utm|Facultatea de Științele Educației, C.about: It has three 3-year, full-time bachelor's programmes: Communication and Public Relations, International Relations and European Studies and Primary and Preschool Pedagogy. You do work placements and can go to study at universities abroad.
utm|Facultatea de Științele Educației, C.admission: The admission average is made up of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade from the written Romanian exam of the bac. For Pedagogy there is another eliminatory test: a motivation interview and a check of diction and musical abilities.

uvt|Facultatea de Arte și Design.name: Faculty of Arts and Design
uvt|Facultatea de Arte și Design.about: Here you study visual arts and design: painting, graphic art, sculpture, photography-video, decorative arts, conservation and restoration, environmental design, object design, fashion and digital game art (in English).
uvt|Facultatea de Arte și Design.admission: Admission has two practical tests taken at the faculty: an eliminatory test and a specialist test, in the programme you chose. The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts only as a tie-breaker; for the programme in English the language is also checked.

uvt|Facultatea de Chimie, Biologie, Geog.name: Faculty of Chemistry, Biology, Geography
uvt|Facultatea de Chimie, Biologie, Geog.about: You study the natural and Earth sciences: biology, biochemistry, chemistry, medical chemistry, geography, tourism geography, geoinformatics and applied forensic sciences. It also has double programmes for future teachers, such as Chemistry – Biology.
uvt|Facultatea de Chimie, Biologie, Geog.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts more, to which is added the grade in the UVT language skills and reasoning test (a multiple-choice test of vocabulary and logic). For the double programmes for teachers there is also an eliminatory communication test.

uvt|Facultatea de Drept.name: Faculty of Law
uvt|Facultatea de Drept.about: You learn the laws and how they are applied. It has the Law programme, four years, and the bilingual Romanian-English programme European and International Law.
uvt|Facultatea de Drept.admission: The admission average is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade in the language skills and reasoning test. For the bilingual programme you also take an English test.

uvt|Facultatea de Economie și de Adminis.name: Faculty of Economics and Business Administration
uvt|Facultatea de Economie și de Adminis.about: The university's economics faculty: accounting, finance and banking, management, marketing, economic informatics, international business, trade and tourism. Some programmes can be followed in English, German or French, and a few also by distance learning.
uvt|Facultatea de Economie și de Adminis.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts more, to which is added the grade in the FEAA test, a multiple-choice test of economic reasoning and logic. For the programmes in foreign languages you also take an online language test.

uvt|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Spo.name: Faculty of Physical Education and Sport
uvt|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Spo.about: It trains sports teachers, coaches and physiotherapists. The programmes are Physical Education and Sport, Sport and Motor Performance and Physiotherapy and Special Motricity (also in English).
uvt|Facultatea de Educație Fizică și Spo.admission: You take sports tests (a motor assessment test, and for Sport and Motor Performance also a test of sporting skill), which are added to the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Physiotherapy you take a physical test and a written test in biology, and the bac average also counts; for the programme in English, instead of biology you take a language test (admitted/rejected).

uvt|Facultatea de Fizică și Matematică.name: Faculty of Physics and Mathematics
uvt|Facultatea de Fizică și Matematică.about: You study physics and mathematics: Physics, Computational Physics, Medical Physics, Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science and the double programme Physics – Chemistry, for future teachers. Graduates work in research, in schools, in hospitals or in technology companies.
uvt|Facultatea de Fizică și Matematică.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) results count more (the average or the best grade in a relevant subject), to which a written test is added: a multiple-choice test in mathematics or computer science for Mathematics, the UVT reasoning test for Physics. For Physics – Chemistry you also first take an eliminatory communication interview.

uvt|Facultatea de Informatică.name: Faculty of Computer Science
uvt|Facultatea de Informatică.about: You learn programming and computer science. It has the Computer Science programme (in Romanian, in English and by distance learning) and the Artificial Intelligence programme, in English.
uvt|Facultatea de Informatică.admission: You take a written test in mathematics or computer science, of your choice, which counts for half; the other half comes from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) (the average or the grade in mathematics or computer science). For the programmes in English there is also an eliminatory language test.

uvt|Facultatea de Litere, Istorie, Filos.name: Faculty of Letters, History, Philosophy and Theology
uvt|Facultatea de Litere, Istorie, Filos.about: The humanities faculty: languages and literatures (Romanian, English, French, German, Russian, Serbian, classical languages and others), applied modern languages, history, philosophy and Pastoral Orthodox Theology.
uvt|Facultatea de Litere, Istorie, Filos.admission: You take written tests that count the most: a language test for the language programmes, a specialist knowledge test for History and Philosophy; the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average is added. For Theology you take a multiple-choice test in dogmatics and a test of musical aptitudes.

uvt|Facultatea de Muzică și Teatru.name: Faculty of Music and Theatre
uvt|Facultatea de Muzică și Teatru.about: It trains musicians and actors. In music there are the programmes Music Performance – Instruments, Music Performance – Singing and Music, and in theatre Performing Arts (acting), in Romanian and in German.
uvt|Facultatea de Muzică și Teatru.admission: Admission is through practical tests, with an eliminatory test at the start. For music, performance, theory, solfeggio and dictation tests follow, and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts a little; for acting you take tests of improvisation, stage aptitudes, monologue and storytelling.

uvt|Facultatea de Psihologie și Științe.name: Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences
uvt|Facultatea de Psihologie și Științe.about: You study how people think and learn. The programmes are Psychology, Psychology – Cognitive Science (in English), Pedagogy, Special Psychopedagogy and Primary School Pedagogy.
uvt|Facultatea de Psihologie și Științe.admission: For most programmes the language skills and reasoning test and the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average count. For Primary School Pedagogy you take a musical aptitude test (admitted/rejected) and a Romanian test; for the programme in English the language is also checked.

uvt|Facultatea de Sociologie și Asistenț.name: Faculty of Sociology and Social Work
uvt|Facultatea de Sociologie și Asistenț.about: You study society and how people in difficulty can be helped. The bachelor's programmes are Social Work (full-time and by distance learning), Sociology and Human Resources.
uvt|Facultatea de Sociologie și Asistenț.admission: The admission average is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average and the grade in a multiple-choice test of vocabulary and reasoning.

uvt|Facultatea de Științe ale Guvernării.name: Faculty of Governance and Communication Sciences
uvt|Facultatea de Științe ale Guvernării.about: It prepares you for administration, politics, international relations and communication. The programmes are Public Administration, Political Science, International Relations and European Studies, Security Studies, Communication and Public Relations, Journalism, Advertising and Digital Media.
uvt|Facultatea de Științe ale Guvernării.admission: The admission average is made up in equal parts of the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) grade in Romanian language and literature and the grade in the language skills and reasoning test (multiple-choice test).

uvvg|Facultatea de Farmacie.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
uvvg|Facultatea de Farmacie.about: Here you learn to become a pharmacist or a specialist in nutrition and dietetics. The faculty presents itself as the first private pharmacy faculty in Romania, and practical work takes place in partner pharmacies, mostly in Arad and the surrounding area.
uvvg|Facultatea de Farmacie.admission: For Pharmacy you take a written multiple-choice test, in person, in Biology – Botany (grade 9). For Nutrition and Dietetics you enter with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, with no written test.

uvvg|Facultatea de Medicină.name: Faculty of Medicine
uvvg|Facultatea de Medicină.about: It trains doctors, with the Medicine programme in Romanian, English and French, as well as nurses, physiotherapists and biologists. Clinical practice takes place in partner hospitals in Arad and the region, and the study groups are small.
