uvvg|Facultatea de Medicină.admission: For Medicine you take a written multiple-choice test, in person, in Biology and Chemistry. For General Nursing, Balneology, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation and Biology you enter with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

uvvg|Facultatea de Stomatologie.name: Faculty of Dental Medicine
uvvg|Facultatea de Stomatologie.about: Here you learn to become a dentist or a dental technician. The faculty was founded in 1991, and students do practical work in the university's own clinics in Arad, in small groups.
uvvg|Facultatea de Stomatologie.admission: For Dental Medicine you take a written multiple-choice test, in person, in Biology and Chemistry. For Dental Technology you enter with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average.

uvvg|Facultatea de Științe Economice, In.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences, Computer Science and Engineering
uvvg|Facultatea de Științe Economice, In.about: It brings together three directions: economics and business (accounting, management, marketing, business administration, tourism), economic informatics and forestry. It has programmes in Arad, but also in Satu Mare, Zalău, Marghita, Baia Mare and Sebiș, with practical work at partner companies.
uvvg|Facultatea de Științe Economice, In.admission: You enter only with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average, without a written exam. The admission average must be at least 5.

uvvg|Facultatea de Științe Juridice.name: Faculty of Legal Sciences
uvvg|Facultatea de Științe Juridice.about: Here you study Law (in Arad and in Baia Mare) or Local Police. The faculty was founded in 1990 and presents itself as the first private law faculty in Romania; the teachers include lawyers, judges, notaries and legal advisers.
uvvg|Facultatea de Științe Juridice.admission: You enter only with the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average; candidates are ranked by this average, which must be at least 5.

uvvg|Facultatea de Științe Socio- Umane.name: Faculty of Social and Human Sciences and Physical Education and Sport
uvvg|Facultatea de Științe Socio- Umane.about: It has programmes about people and society: Psychology, Primary School Pedagogy, Applied Modern Languages, Security Studies and Physical Education and Sport. Practical work takes place in partner schools, hospitals and sports clubs in Arad.
uvvg|Facultatea de Științe Socio- Umane.admission: The Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. In addition, for Physical Education and Sport you take a practical test of physical aptitude, and for Primary School Pedagogy you upload a motivation essay; both are graded admitted or rejected.

valahia|Facultatea de Drept și Științe A.name: Faculty of Law and Administrative Sciences
valahia|Facultatea de Drept și Științe A.about: Here you learn the laws and how justice and state institutions work. It has two bachelor's programmes: Law, for future lawyers, judges or legal advisers, and Public Administration, for those who want to work in town halls and other institutions.
valahia|Facultatea de Drept și Științe A.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the grade in Romanian and then the grade in the exam specific to the profile, from the bac, are taken into account.

valahia|Facultatea de Ingineria Material.name: Faculty of Materials Engineering and Mechanics
valahia|Facultatea de Ingineria Material.about: Here you learn about the materials things around us are made of (metals, new materials), about factory machinery and about the economic side of an industrial business. The bachelor's programmes are Materials Science, Equipment for Industrial Processes and Economic Engineering in the Mechanical Field.
valahia|Facultatea de Ingineria Material.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the grade in the exam specific to the profile and then the grade in Romanian, from the bac, are taken into account.

valahia|Facultatea de Ingineria Mediului.name: Faculty of Environmental Engineering and Food Science
valahia|Facultatea de Ingineria Mediului.about: Here you learn how the environment is protected in agriculture, how agricultural products are processed and how to check whether food is safe. It also has a rarer programme, Mountain Agriculture, about agriculture and life in mountain areas.
valahia|Facultatea de Ingineria Mediului.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the grade in the exam specific to the profile and then the grade in Romanian, from the bac, are taken into account.

valahia|Facultatea de Inginerie Electric.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Information Technology
valahia|Facultatea de Inginerie Electric.about: Here you learn automation and applied informatics, electronics, telecommunications, electrical engineering and power engineering. It is the right faculty if you like computers, circuits and how electricity is produced and used.
valahia|Facultatea de Inginerie Electric.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the grade in the exam specific to the profile and then the grade in Romanian, from the bac, are taken into account.

valahia|Facultatea de Științe Economice.name: Faculty of Economic Sciences
valahia|Facultatea de Științe Economice.about: Here you learn how companies and money work: accounting, finance and banking, management, marketing, trade and tourism and business administration. The Business Administration programme is taught in English.
valahia|Facultatea de Științe Economice.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For the programme taught in English you must also show that you know the language, with a recognised certificate or through a test graded admitted or rejected.

valahia|Facultatea de Științe Politice,.name: Faculty of Political Sciences, Letters and Communication
valahia|Facultatea de Științe Politice,.about: Here you study Romanian language and literature together with a foreign language (English or French) or journalism. It is suitable if you like reading, writing and communicating and see yourself as a teacher, journalist or communication professional.
valahia|Facultatea de Științe Politice,.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the grade in Romanian and then the grade in the exam specific to the profile, from the bac, are taken into account.

valahia|Facultatea de Științe și Arte.name: Faculty of Sciences and Arts
valahia|Facultatea de Științe și Arte.about: Here you study mathematics and computer science, physics, chemistry or music. The faculty has two departments: one of advanced sciences and technologies and one of arts.
valahia|Facultatea de Științe și Arte.admission: For Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Music there is first an eliminatory practical test, on an instrument or in singing, then an oral test in music theory and solfeggio, which counts more than the bac average.

valahia|Facultatea de Științe și Inginer.name: Faculty of Sciences and Engineering (Alexandria)
valahia|Facultatea de Științe și Inginer.about: It is the faculty of "Valahia" University that operates in the town of Alexandria, in Teleorman county. Here you can study trade, tourism and services, public administration, agriculture or multimedia systems engineering, without moving to Târgoviște.
valahia|Facultatea de Științe și Inginer.admission: Only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. If averages are equal, the grades in Romanian and in the exam specific to the profile, from the bac, are taken into account.

valahia|Facultatea de Științe Umaniste.name: Faculty of Humanities
valahia|Facultatea de Științe Umaniste.about: Here you study history, geography and tourism geography, as well as physical education and sport or physiotherapy, that is, recovery through movement. The faculty has three departments: History, Geography and Physical Education and Sport.
valahia|Facultatea de Științe Umaniste.admission: For History and Geography only the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average counts. For Physical Education and Sport and for Physiotherapy you also take a practical test, an applied course: for sport the test counts more, for physiotherapy the bac average counts more.

valahia|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.name: Faculty of Orthodox Theology and Educational Sciences
valahia|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.about: It has two directions: Pastoral Orthodox Theology, for those who want to become priests, and Primary School Pedagogy, for future primary school teachers. The faculty has a department for each.
valahia|Facultatea de Teologie Ortodoxă.admission: For Theology you first pass a psychological examination and a check of musical aptitudes, then take a written exam that counts as much as the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac) average. For Pedagogy there is an eliminatory oral test of communication, then the bac average counts.
